We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
**transform the future of healthcare**
, you’ll find your purpose here.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function of Position**
The Learning Management Systems (LMS) Administrator 3 is responsible for the administration and maintenance of the company’s learning system technology to deliver online training to internal and/or external customers. Assists with data migrations, working with IT and outside vendors to test and troubleshoot systems issues; supports development of processes, content generation and loading; maintains training and user profile records; coordinates calendaring and enrollment, tracking, assessments, reporting and customer communications for learning events. In companies with training teams, may serve as a subject matter expert, training the community of business users to maximize the utilization of system features to create and manage learning events, training modules, assessments, and reports.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**

* Develops knowledge of Intuitive’s LMS support model and system functionality.
* Escalate support issues as necessary.
* Provide training and support to users, such as instructors and learners, on how to effectively use the LMS and its features.
* Perform intermediate content management and configuration within LMS with assistance from LMS Admin Level 4 or IT.
* Assist with creation of user stories & UAT business scripts and support UAT business testing.
* Participate in LMS process improvement initiatives Support curriculum development and content management for assigned Business Units (BUs).
* Own content management within the LMS for assigned BUs.
* Act as consultant for BU Training Operations, BU Trainers, & BU Content Owners to ensure efficient program integration with LMS.
* Help train more junior LMS Admins.
* Utilizes Agile/Veeva workflow in ongoing implementation tasks.
* Ensure the product complies with all global legal and regulatory obligations.
* Monitoring, follow-up, and close out of LMS support incidents.
* Run system reports.
* Complete special projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills and Experience**

* Advanced ability to troubleshoot and resolve LMS technical issues quickly.
* Coordinate and execute multiple tasks, such as implementing learning programs, software updates, and system enhancements.
* Maintain and upgrade the system to maximize functionality and upload new content.
* Strong communication skills to work effectively in a team, assign tasks, track progress, and handle client requests.
* Strong customer service skills to support the ticketing system and interact with users and stakeholders effectively.
* Intermediate experience with LMS content management, issue troubleshooting, and tier 2 support.
* Experience training end users in LMS features and functionality.
* Ability to work well with a team and independently.
* Interpersonal and analytical skills.
* Ability to learn and grow.

**Required Education And Training**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent; vocational training and/or equivalent work experience.

**Working Conditions**

* Flexible to scheduling changes and periodic adjustments for global support and collaboration purposes.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Typically requires 2-4 years of related experience.

title: Oracle PaaS / VBCS Technical Support (AMS)
description:
**Job Description: Oracle Technology – PaaS (VBCS)**

**Role: Oracle PaaS / VBCS – AMS Technical Support**

**Role Description**

An Oracle PaaS (VBCS) Senior Associate responsible for providing L2/L3 technical support, maintenance, troubleshooting, and enhancements for Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) applications and Oracle Fusion SaaS extensions within a Managed Services environment. The role requires strong technical knowledge of Oracle Visual Builder, Visual Builder Studio (VB Studio), REST APIs, JavaScript, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and Oracle Cloud application integrations. The candidate will troubleshoot application defects, resolve integration failures, implement minor enhancements, optimize application performance, and ensure the stability of Oracle Cloud extensions.

* Level: Experienced Professional, independently manage assigned technical support workstreams, troubleshoot complex application issues, perform code analysis, develop fixes and enhancements, coordinate technical deployments, and ensure timely resolution of incidents within agreed SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Application Production Support: Provide L2/L3 support for Oracle VBCS applications, Visual Builder Studio extensions, and Oracle Cloud PaaS solutions.

* Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate JavaScript errors, page rendering issues, UI defects, application performance problems, and service connection failures.

* VBCS Configuration & Maintenance: Support Business Objects, Service Connections, Page Flows, Action Chains, Variables, Business Rules, and application configurations.

* Oracle Fusion Extensions: Troubleshoot and maintain Oracle Fusion SaaS extensions developed through Oracle Visual Builder Studio, including Redwood-aligned applications.

* REST API & Integration Support: Diagnose REST API failures, authentication issues, payload errors, and connectivity problems involving Oracle Fusion Cloud and external systems.

* Enhancements & Defect Fixes: Develop and test minor enhancements, technical fixes, UI improvements, and application modifications using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Oracle JET components.

* Deployment & Release Management: Support Git version control, CI/CD pipelines, VB Studio deployments, release validation, and environment migration.

* OIC Integration Support: Coordinate troubleshooting of integration failures involving Oracle Integration Cloud, REST services, and external applications.

* Incident & Problem Management: Perform RCA, document technical solutions, monitor recurring issues, and maintain support knowledge articles.

* Oracle Quarterly Updates: Assess application compatibility with quarterly Oracle Fusion Cloud releases and support regression testing and defect remediation.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Experience: Oracle technical development/support, with hands-on experience in Oracle VBCS and Visual Builder Studio.

* Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of Oracle Visual Builder, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Oracle JET, REST APIs, and JSON.

* Oracle Cloud Knowledge: Experience supporting Oracle Fusion SaaS extensions, Oracle PaaS applications, and Redwood UX.

* Integration Skills: Working knowledge of OIC, REST/SOAP services, OAuth authentication, and Oracle Fusion APIs.

* DevOps & Deployment: Experience with Git, CI/CD, VB Studio deployments, and application troubleshooting.

* Managed Services: Experience in L2/L3 production support, defect analysis, performance optimization, RCA, and technical incident management.

description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)**
is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

title: Technical Support Engineer – Slurm
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 30 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and dynamic people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing—an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. NVIDIANs immerse themselves in a diverse, supportive environment that encourages everyone to do their best work. Join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
Slurm is a critical workload manager for many of the world’s most demanding AI and high-performance computing environments. We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer dedicated to supporting Slurm for NVIDIA’s customers. You will join a dedicated team of Slurm subject-matter guides, owning sophisticated support cases and helping customers run reliable, efficient, and highly scalable clusters. This role requires extensive production experience with Slurm and the ability to diagnose issues across the scheduler and the surrounding Linux, networking, storage, authentication, database, and GPU infrastructure.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own Slurm support cases from initial investigation through resolution for customers running production AI and HPC clusters.
* Diagnose complex problems involving slurmctld, slurmd, slurmdbd, job scheduling, node management, resource allocation, accounting, authentication, and high availability.
* Solve Slurm configuration and policy features, including partitions, reservations, priorities, fair-share, quality of service, backfill, preemption, GRES/TRES, cgroups, and job constraints.
* Investigate performance, reliability, and scalability issues using logs, diagnostic data, configuration analysis, reproductions, and source-level debugging when required.
* Isolate problems across Slurm and its surrounding dependencies, including Linux, MUNGE, databases, networking, parallel storage, containers, GPUs, and cluster-management systems.
* Advise customers on Slurm configuration, upgrades, operational practices, managing system resources, and safe recovery from production incidents.
* Collaborate with engineering teams by producing clear technical descriptions, reproducible test cases, and well-supported defect reports.
* Develop guides, knowledge-base articles, diagnostic tools, and internal training that strengthen Slurm expertise across the support organization.

**What We Need To See**

* BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Slurm in production HPC or AI environments including business-critical outage incidents.
* Expert-level understanding of Slurm architecture, daemons, configuration, scheduling behavior, accounting, resource management, and failure modes.
* Capacity to identify sophisticated Slurm incidents independently and guide them to a technically sound resolution.
* In-depth Linux system-administration and solve experience, including systemd, cgroups, authentication, networking, and database-backed services.
* Experience operating Slurm across multi-user clusters with complex scheduling policies and heterogeneous compute resources.
* Strong analytical and research skills, showing proficiency in distinguishing Slurm defects from configuration, integration, infrastructure, and workload problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn detailed technical findings into clear explanations and actionable recommendations.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience supporting large-scale Slurm environments containing thousands of nodes or GPUs.
* Experience diagnosing scheduler performance, job-throughput, controller-load, and database-scaling issues.
* Familiarity with Slurm source code, plugins, SPANK, Lua job-submit plugins, or upstream issue investigation.
* Experience with containers and HPC integration technologies such as Pyxis, Enroot, Apptainer, or Singularity.
* Previous experience integrating Slurm with NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Bright Cluster Manager, or another cluster-management platform.

title: Product Support Engineer
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Product Support at Sprinto is not about forwarding queries or closing as many tickets as possible. It is about understanding why something is not working and helping the customer move forward with confidence.
  
  
When a customer encounters an integration failure, unexpected API behaviour, configuration issue or confusing product workflow, you will investigate the problem, identify what is happening and own the issue through resolution.
  
  
You will work with browser developer tools, APIs, integrations, logs and cloud environments. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Compliance teams.
  
  
This is an early-career role with a steep learning curve. You will develop technical depth while learning how a global SaaS product operates in real customer environments.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
**Solve real technical problems :**
Investigate product, integration and configuration issues rather than relying only on predefined responses. Reproduce problems, test hypotheses and identify the most likely cause.
  
  
**Become fluent in modern SaaS systems :**
Develop practical knowledge of APIs, HTTP requests, browser behaviour, authentication, cloud integrations and the systems that connect Sprinto with a customer's technology environment.
  
  
**Own the customer's experience:**
Communicate clearly throughout the investigation. Help customers understand what happened, what is being done and what they should do next - without overwhelming them with unnecessary technical detail.
  
  
**Work closely with Product and Engineering:**
Collect the right evidence, isolate issues and create precise escalations that help engineering teams act quickly. Over time, you will learn to distinguish between product defects, configuration problems, integration failures and expected behaviour.
  
  
**Improve more than one interaction:**
Identify recurring patterns and turn them into better documentation, troubleshooting playbooks, product feedback or process improvements. A strong solution should help the next customer before they encounter the same problem.
  
  
**Build expertise in trust and security:**
Learn how businesses implement frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR and HIPAA, and how Sprinto connects with their cloud infrastructure, identity systems and business applications.
  
  
**The kind of builder we're looking for -**
You'll likely thrive in this position if:
  
  
  

* You are a recent engineering graduate or have up to one year of relevant experience.
* Loves enjoy understanding how products and systems work - not merely following instructions.
* Comfortable about unfamiliar problems by breaking them down and testing possibilities.
* You have a working understanding of APIs, HTTP, client-server architecture and databases.
* Can explain a technical problem clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Very comfortable asking questions, researching independently and learning from incomplete information.
* Excited about taking ownership of an issue and follow it through instead of treating escalation as the end of your responsibility.
* You care about the customer's experience as much as the technical correctness of the answer.
* You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively in a remote environment.
* You respond well to feedback and demonstrate visible learning from one problem to the next.

Prior experience in Product Support is not required. We care more about your learning agility, problem-solving ability, communication and technical curiosity.
  
  
**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Escalation Support Engineer
description:
**What makes us Qlik?**
A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.
  
  
Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.
  
  
**The Senior Escalation Support Engineer Role**
At Qlik, our
**Escalation Support Engineers**
are technical problem-solvers who take ownership when customers face complex, business-critical challenges. As a
**Senior Escalation Support Engineer**
, you will lead high-impact escalations across the Qlik and Talend portfolio, provide trusted technical guidance to customers, and coordinate closely with Support, R&D, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success and Account teams.
  
  
Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will drive root-cause analysis, identify recurring issues, influence product improvements, mentor other engineers and help reduce customer risk. You will also contribute to Qlik Advanced Support through proactive technical guidance, remediation sessions, knowledge sharing and awareness of customers’ critical projects.
  
  
**What makes this role interesting?**

* Lead technically complex, high-severity escalations for strategic and business-critical customers.
* Become a recognized technical authority and subject matter expert across the Support organization.
* Collaborate with global Support, R&D, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success and Account teams.
* Influence product reliability by identifying recurring issues, defects and improvement opportunities.
* Coach and mentor engineers, share knowledge, and contribute to proactive Advanced Support engagement.

**Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact**

* Own escalations end to end, establish investigation direction, coordinate resources and drive issues through resolution.
* Perform deep troubleshooting across logs, traces, diagnostics, performance data, system behavior and integrated technologies; reproduce issues where possible and identify root cause and sustainable remediation.
* Partner directly with customers during critical incidents, communicate findings and action plans clearly, set expectations and provide regular updates.
* Work with R&D and Engineering by providing clear problem statements, reproduction steps, diagnostic evidence and business impact; validate fixes and communicate outcomes.
* Identify customer environment and deployment risks; support proactive technical sessions, remediation, retrospectives and preventive recommendations.
* Mentor Support Engineers and SMEs, lead knowledge-sharing and case reviews, and create reusable troubleshooting guides, technical articles and lessons learned.
* Lead or contribute to major-incident RCA, corrective and preventive actions, and improvements to support processes and product supportability.

**We’re Looking For a Teammate With**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years in enterprise technical support, escalation engineering, system administration or a related technical field, including complex customer escalations and business-critical production issues.
* Experience as a senior technical SME or equivalent technical leadership role, working with global customers and distributed teams.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills across complex, multi-layered environments.
* Strong database and SQL knowledge, including DDL, DML and TCL; experience with one or more RDBMS such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Strong Linux/Unix command-line troubleshooting; experience analyzing logs, traces, system metrics, network behavior and application diagnostics.
* Experience with data integration, replication, Change Data Capture (CDC), performance troubleshooting or production-critical data platforms is highly desirable.
* Experience with Qlik and/or Talend Data Integration products and complex product architectures is highly desirable.
* Talend product knowledge across Talend Studio DI, Talend Big Data, Talend ESB, Talend Administration Center, Talend Data Preparation & Data Stewardship, Talend Remote Engine and Talend Master Data Management (MDM) is an advantage.
* Ability to lead complex escalations independently, remain calm under pressure and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent customer-facing, written and verbal communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, with a passion for coaching engineers and sharing technical knowledge.

**The location for this role is:**
Bangalore, India.
  
  
(This is an India-based opportunity supporting Qlik’s APAC customer base and global Support organization. Customer engagement and working hours may vary based on business requirements, including collaboration across time zones and participation in critical production incidents) LI-APAC
  
  
**Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities!**
**More About Qlik And Who We Are**
Find out more about ‘Life at Qlik’ on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page.
  
  
**What else do we offer?**

* Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs.
* Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness.
* Flexible, diverse, and international work environment.

Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra “change the world” day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs
  
  
If you need assistance applying for a role due to a disability, please submit your request via email to accessibilityta@qlik.com. Any information you provide will be treated according to Qlik’s Recruitment Privacy Notice. Qlik may only respond to emails related to accommodation requests.
  
  
Qlik is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Qlik via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Qlik. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Qlik as a result of the referral or through other means.

title: Ent Apps Service Reliability Advisor
description:

2026-19791

27/10/2026
**Location**
Bengaluru, India
**Category**
IT
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Collaboration Platform & Service Reliability Engineer to join our globally distributed Enterprise IT team, supporting the stability, security, performance, and continuous improvement of Arm's collaboration platforms and business-critical applications.
  
  
The role combines specialist SharePoint Online and Microsoft Power Platform expertise with Service Reliability Centre (SRC) engineering, improving AIOps, observability, and automation to enhance application availability and operational resilience.
  
  
Working closely with application, infrastructure, and engineering teams, you will contribute to the evolution towards a proactive Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) operating model, focusing on incident prevention, intelligent monitoring, automation, and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The position is based in our Bengaluru office, working on a rotational shift pattern within a 24x7x365 operating model to support business-critical services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide specialist Level 2 and Level 3 operational support for SharePoint Online, Microsoft Power Platform, and associated collaboration services, ensuring service stability and timely issue resolution.
* Administer, secure, and optimize SharePoint Online environments, including site administration, access management, governance, and platform configuration.
* Support Microsoft Power Platform services, including Power Apps and Power Automate, covering administration, environment management, governance, and fix.
* Monitor, investigate, and resolve incidents affecting business-critical enterprise applications using Dynatrace and other AIOps and observability platforms.
* Collaborate with application owners, engineering teams, and third-party suppliers to expand monitoring coverage, establish alert thresholds, and onboard applications into SRC support.
* Drive proactive monitoring, root cause analysis, and preventive actions to improve application performance, availability, and service reliability.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts, operational runbooks, and monitoring processes to reduce manual intervention, enhance AIOps capabilities, and improve operational efficiency.
* Contribute to the adoption of SRE practices, including service health monitoring, reliability metrics, and continuous service improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in enterprise platform administration, application operations, or service reliability engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Dynatrace, including application monitoring, dashboard configuration, alert management, diagnostics, and performance analysis.
* Strong hands-on experience in SharePoint Online administration and fix, including site management, permissions, security, governance, and platform configuration.
* Practical experience supporting Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate, including administration, fix, and environment management.
* Experience in enterprise application operations, incident management, performance monitoring, and root cause analysis, with a proactive approach to identifying and driving service reliability improvements.
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and operational automation, with experience developing and maintaining scripts to streamline administrative and support processes.
* Understanding of ITIL-aligned service management processes and experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow.

**"Nice to Have" Skills and Experience:**

* Understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), AIOps, and observability practices, including service health indicators and reliability objectives.
* Experience supporting enterprise business applications and SaaS platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Slack, or Zoom, including their onboarding into monitoring and observability platforms.
* Experience with Python, JavaScript, Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, or other relevant scripting and integration technologies.
* Knowledge of advanced Power Platform governance, Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies, and application lifecycle management.
* Experience developing automated operational responses and integrating monitoring platforms with incident management processes.
* Exposure to DevOps practices, cloud technologies, and continuous service improvement methodologies!

You will collaborate with industry leaders and innovators, contributing to flawless service builds that improve our global operations. We provide an encouraging and inclusive environment that encourages continuous learning and professional growth. Your success is our success, and together we can build services that compete on the world stage!

title: Senior Lead - QC System - Empower
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Lead - QC System - Empower will deliver and support Empower (CDS) solutions for Quality Control (QC) laboratories. The role includes project work and BAU support, platform delivery, upgrades, automation, L2/L3 support, version upgrades and practical exposure to automation capabilities.
  
  
The role diagnoses complex issues using logs, metrics, interfaces, data flows and system behaviour and implements approved corrective actions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Empower solution delivery and configuration**

* Configure and support Empower projects, methods, processing methods, reports and user security for QC labs.
* Translate QC and analytical requirements into Empower configurations following defined standards.
* Maintain Empower master data, templates and configuration items in line with global governance.
* Configuration and scripts held under version control, peer review before release, scripted or automated regression tests, and test evidence kept with the change.

**Projects and modernization**

* Contribute to the design and execution of Empower Citrix to Azure migration (environment build, cutover planning, testing and rollout).
* Support Empower version upgrades (assessment, remediation, regression testing, deployment).
* Work with infrastructure and platform teams to optimise performance, scalability and resilience in Azure.
* Participate in integration work (e.g. LIMS, instruments, archival solutions) as part of modernisation projects.

**Automation and optimisation**

* Use Empower automation capabilities (e.g. custom calculations, processing workflows, scheduling, scripts/macros where applicable) to streamline QC operations.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and standardise analytical workflows.
* Document and share reusable automation patterns and best practices within the team.
* Uses approved AI assistants to build and test Empower configuration and scripts and checks the output before submitting it for review.

**BAU support and operations**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for incidents, problems and service requests related to Empower.
* Perform root cause analysis for complex issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Deliver small enhancements and configuration changes through formal change management.
* Support periodic maintenance activities, including patching, housekeeping and performance tuning.
* Follow GxP, data integrity and quality procedures in all Empower changes and support activities.

**Key Relationships / Customers**
**Business and Site Stakeholders**

* Manufacturing, Quality, Laboratory, Supply Chain and MSAT stakeholders
* Site engineers, automation teams, super users and key users
* Business Process Owners and operational risk owners

**Digital & Technology Stakeholders**

* Product Managers and Product Owners
* Solution and Enterprise Architects
* Engineering, DevOps, Data and Integration teams
* Service Managers, Cyber Security and Infrastructure teams
* Validation, Quality and technical assurance teams

**Other**

* Technology vendors
* System integrators and specialist engineering partners
* Managed service and support providers

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences or a relevant technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Empower CDS administration and configuration in QC / GMP environments.
* Experience supporting or implementing QC/analytical lab systems (preferably Empower) under GxP.
* Practical exposure to at least one of:
* Empower environment migrations (Citrix, virtualised or cloud-hosted setups).
* Empower version upgrades, including testing and validation.
* Empower automations (processing workflows, custom calculations, scripts, or scheduling tools).
* Good understanding of QC lab processes, chromatographic workflows and data integrity principles.
* Knowledge of CSV, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and data integrity (ALCOA+) in the context of CDS systems.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based service management and working with global support models.
* Exposure to scripting or automation tools used alongside Empower or other QC systems.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate architecture and product direction into clear technical designs and implementation activities.
* Clear technical writing and disciplined maintenance of specifications, designs, test evidence and configuration records.
* Understanding of interfaces, workflows, data, environments, monitoring and operational support.
* Awareness of security, quality, validation, data integrity, resilience and change controls.
* Ability to collaborate across global business, site, engineering, architecture, product, service and supplier teams.
* Continuous-improvement mindset with emphasis on standardisation, reuse, automation and knowledge sharing.

**#AGTech**
**#GSK-LI**

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

title: Remote Desktop Support Service L3
description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.
  
  
When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The
**Remote Desktop Support Services - L3 Engineer**
provides expert-level technical support for complex and critical incidents within the global IT service operation. This role is responsible for resolving issues escalated beyond Level 2 support, minimizing reliance on third-party vendors through deep technical expertise, and ensuring uninterrupted IT service delivery within a global Follow-the-Sun support model.
  
  
The position plays a key role in Incident, Change, Problem, and Major Incident Management, while also driving automation initiatives, maintaining infrastructure documentation, and serving as a senior technical resource and mentor for the wider IT support team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Complex Incident Resolution & Remote IT Support
* Own and resolve highly complex incidents escalated from L2 support involving infrastructure, servers, networks, and business-critical applications.
* Provide advanced remote and onsite (deskside) support requiring deep technical troubleshooting or physical intervention.
* Perform systematic root cause analysis to eliminate recurring issues and improve service stability.
* Manage and coordinate escalations with third-party vendors, hardware providers, and technology partners, ensuring timely resolution.
* Support Major Incident Management activities by providing technical expertise, investigation support, stakeholder updates, and coordination assistance.
* Troubleshoot across multiple technology layers including: Windows Endpoints Windows Server Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft 365 Services DNS, DHCP VPN and Remote Access Technologies LAN, WAN, and Wi-Fi Networks Virtualization Platforms Endpoint Management Solutions
* Work closely with application owners and vendors to resolve infrastructure-related application failures.
* Restore services rapidly while ensuring permanent resolution and prevention of repeat incidents.
* Change & Problem Management
* Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews and provide technical risk assessments when required.
* Review proposed infrastructure and system changes, identifying potential impacts and risks.
* Lead or contribute to Problem Management investigations.
* Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) following major incidents.
* Monitoring & Infrastructure Alert Management
* Monitor global infrastructure alerts during assigned coverage periods.
* Validate system-generated events and determine their impact and priority.
* Route actionable incidents to the appropriate support teams and ensure timely follow-up.
* Assist in maintaining proactive monitoring practices to reduce business disruption.
* CMDB & Knowledge Management
* Maintain the accuracy and integrity of Configuration Management Database (CMDB) records.
* Identify and resolve configuration item discrepancies.
* Develop, review, and maintain technical Knowledge Base (KB) articles.
* Validate L1 and L2 documentation for technical accuracy and completeness.
* Promote knowledge sharing and continuous service improvement.
* Automation & Service Improvement
* Identify repetitive operational activities suitable for automation.
* Design, develop, and implement approved scripting and automation solutions.
* Reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and contribute to cost optimization initiatives.
* Support continuous improvement programs and operational excellence objectives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
KPI Measurement Complex Incident Resolution Rate Percentage of L3 tickets resolved without vendor escalation SLA Compliance Rate Percentage of L3 incidents resolved within agreed SLA timelines Net Promoter Score (NPS)Customer satisfaction score from post-resolution surveys (Target: ≥ 40)Vendor Escalation Rate Percentage of incidents requiring third-party engagement Monitoring Alert Coverage Rate Percentage of alerts reviewed, validated, and classified within target timelines CMDB Update Compliance Percentage of tickets closed with accurate CMDB updates Knowledge Base Contribution Number of approved KB articles created or reviewed monthly Automation Savings Contribution Measurable cost savings and efficiency gains through automation initiatives
  
  
**Required**
Qualifications & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* 4-6 years of experience in: Advanced Technical Support Systems Administration Infrastructure Engineering Enterprise Service Operations
* Strong technical expertise in: Server Administration Networking Endpoint Management Microsoft Technologies Enterprise Infrastructure Services
* Solid understanding of ITIL v4 practices, particularly: Incident Management Change Management Problem Management
* Experience with: ITSM Platforms CMDB Administration Monitoring Tools Scripting and Automation Technologies
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable
  
  

* Additional language proficiency (Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, or other major business languages).
* Experience supporting global, multi-region IT environments operating under a Follow-the-Sun model.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL® 4 Foundation (or higher)
* Microsoft Azure Certification
* Microsoft Windows Server Certification
* CompTIA Network+
* CompTIA Security+
* Cisco CCNA (or equivalent networking certification)

Key Competencies
  
  

* Deep Technical Expertise
* Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
* Structured Problem Solving
* Change Risk Assessment
* Major Incident Management
* Proactive Monitoring & Service Reliability
* Automation & Continuous Improvement
* Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
* Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
* Coaching and Technical Mentorship
* Customer Service Orientation
* Strong Communication Skills

**Working at ALS**
The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.
  
  
Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.
  
  
At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.
  
  
We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.
  
  
**Everyone Matters**
ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.
  
  
ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request.
  
  
**Eligibility**
To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Please apply on-line and provide a resume & cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

Revenera helps product executives build better products, accelerate time to value and monetize what matters. Flexera saves customers billions of dollars in wasted technology spend.

title: Technical Support Engineer II
description:
**Company Overview**
Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.
  
  
As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.
  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000 customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.
  
  
**Why Join Planview?**
At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.
  
  
Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Technical Support Engineer I independently provides technical support to standard customers and internal teams for Portfolios, serving as the primary contact for a defined set of accounts and cases. In this role, you will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across your assigned products, investigate root causes, and act as a liaison between customers and the engineering team for escalated issues. Success is measured by case resolution quality, SLA performance, customer satisfaction, and your growing ability to own increasingly complex problems end-to-end.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Customer Support & Case Management**

* Independently provide technical support to standard customers and internal teams for Portfolios via phone, email, ticketing system, and web-based tools.
* Accurately log all customer cases, interactions, and resolutions in the case management system (e.g., Salesforce, Jira).
* Manage issues from initial contact through final resolution and follow-up, maintaining full accountability throughout the support lifecycle.
* Prioritize tickets according to severity and SLA commitments, beginning to make independent judgments on case urgency.

**Technical Troubleshooting & Resolution**

* Troubleshoot and resolve all technical issues for your assigned products, applying judgment within defined processes and procedures.
* Investigate root causes of technical problems and implement effective, documented solutions.
* Escalate complex issues to higher-level engineers or development teams, providing clear reproduction steps, environment details, and initial findings.
* Act as a liaison between customers and engineering teams for escalated issues.

**Product Knowledge & Continuous Improvement**

* Build expertise beyond foundational knowledge and apply it to the team's objectives and customer outcomes.
* Stay current on product releases, feature changes, known issues, and system updates.
* Contribute to technical notes, knowledge base articles, and support documentation.
* Collect and communicate customer feedback and recurring issue patterns to improve product quality and support processes.

**Collaboration & Mentoring**

* Maintain internal networks and build relationships with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.
* Seek out opportunities to provide input on objectives and processes based on observations and customer needs.
* As needed, participate in on-call or skeleton crew rotation.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years of experience in technical support, software support, IT support, or a closely related customer-facing role.
* Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in enterprise software or SaaS environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience using ticketing or case management systems (e.g., Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, Dynamics 365, or similar).
* Solid diagnostic and problem-solving skills with a systematic, analytical approach.
* Proven ability to manage multiple issues simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and meeting SLA commitments.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional global team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Familiarity with SaaS applications support models and multi-tenant environments.
* Experience with enterprise databases and SQL querying (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL).
* Experience working with REST/SOAP APIs and API testing tools such as Postman and curl.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies and frameworks, including Agile, Waterfall, and SAFe®.
* Experience with identity and access management concepts (SSO, OAuth, RBAC, SAML).
* Knowledge of the Planview product ecosystem (e.g., prior use or administration of Planview solutions).
* Relevant technology certifications (Microsoft, AWS, ITIL, or similar).

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Willing to accept and adapt to change, showing flexibility and recovering relatively quickly from setbacks.
* Actively participates in team meetings and seeks out collaboration opportunities without always waiting to be prompted.
* Seeks feedback from colleagues and peers and integrates that feedback into their approach and work quality.
* Displays a willingness to develop conflict-resolution skills and facilitate productive discussions with customers and colleagues.
* Shows increasing initiative in clear-cut situations; follows instructions and guidelines to complete assigned tasks.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and organized, with the ability to begin prioritizing work independently.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a growing ability to build relationships with customers, colleagues, and cross-functional partners.
* Committed to continuous learning, with intellectual curiosity to expand product and technical knowledge.
* Comfortable engaging with AI-assisted tools to accelerate research, issue diagnosis, and knowledge base contributions.

Technical Skillset (Product-Specific)
  
  
**Must Have**

* [Required skill #1 — Example: Hands-on experience troubleshooting issues in a SaaS web application, including using browser developer tools to analyze network requests, console errors, and authentication flows.
* [Required skill #2 — Example: Working knowledge of SQL — ability to write and execute queries to investigate data issues, validate configuration records, or reproduce customer-reported problems.
* [Required skill #3 — Example: Ability to test and interpret REST API requests and responses using tools such as Postman or curl, sufficient to investigate integration and data sync issues reported by customers.
* [Required skill #4 — Example: Experience using log analysis tools (e.g., Event Viewer, HAR files, or AWS CloudWatch) to investigate and document application issues for escalation to engineering.
* [Required skill #5 — Example: Proficiency with the team's primary case management platform (e.g., Salesforce Service Cloud, Jira, Zendesk, or ServiceNow) for logging, prioritizing, and managing customer cases through resolution.

**Nice to Have**

* [Preferred skill #1 — Example: Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS, including familiarity with cloud-hosted application support and multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* [Preferred skill #2 — Example: Understanding of authentication and security concepts including SSO, OAuth, RBAC, SAML, and SSL/TLS certificates. Relevant for any product supporting enterprise identity management.
* [Preferred skill #3 — Example: Scripting or coding experience in one or more languages such as JavaScript, Python, or PowerShell — particularly valuable for integration-heavy product teams.
* [Preferred skill #4 — Example: Ability to leverage AI-assisted tools (e.g., Planview Anvi, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate troubleshooting, draft knowledge base articles, and improve case resolution speed.

**Benefits At Planview**
At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:
  
  

* Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
* Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
* Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
* Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
* Employee Referral bonus program.
* Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
* Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!
  
  
**AI Use in Recruitment**
Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. If you require further information or would like to exercise your rights under applicable privacy laws, please submit your request at the Planview Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) Portal.

description:
**Calling all originals:**
At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.
  
  
**Summary Of The Role**
You will support Levi Strauss & Co.’s 24/7 IT Service Management Command Center by monitoring enterprise systems, validating alerts, performing initial incident triage, and escalating issues quickly to the right technical teams. Working with senior technicians, Incident Managers, Service Desk teams, and infrastructure and application specialists, you will help maintain service availability, accurate operational visibility, and a positive user experience across critical business systems.
  
  
**About The Job**

* Monitor enterprise tools and dashboards in real time, validate alerts, assess severity and business impact, initiate approved runbooks, and perform first-level troubleshooting where possible.
* Create and maintain accurate incident records, operational dashboards, shift logs, and handover documentation, while escalating incidents to L2/L3 and application teams in line with established procedures and service levels.
* Provide clear and timely updates during alerts and incidents, support the Incident Manager during high-priority events, and contribute to runbook updates, knowledge articles, known-error records, post-incident reviews, and continuous improvement.
* Real-time monitoring and alert triage — monitor enterprise tools/dashboards; validate alerts; prioritize by severity and impact; initiate runbooks according to defined protocols \*
* Escalation and coordination — engage L2/L3 and application teams per escalation matrices; provide timely updates; support the Incident Manager during high-priority events \*
* Incident logging and documentation — create/update tickets with accurate categorization, impact/urgency assessment, timelines, operational dashboards, and shift logs \*
* Basic troubleshooting and request handling — perform first-level diagnostics for common hardware/software issues and standard requests within defined scripts and runbooks
* Continuous improvement and operational hygiene — contribute to runbook updates, known error records, knowledge articles, tool health checks, post-incident reviews, and training
* Shift handover quality and coverage readiness — maintain clear shift notes, handover documentation, and operational continuity across rotations
* Stakeholder communication and operational visibility — provide concise technical and non-technical updates that support incident visibility and response coordination
* Command Center collaboration and responsiveness culture — collaborate with senior technicians, technical teams, and peers to support reliable incident response

**About You**

* 4+ years of experience in IT support, technical support, or a Command Center or monitoring environment.
* Experience with incident monitoring, alert validation, initial troubleshooting, incident logging, categorization, prioritization, and timely escalation using defined protocols and runbooks.
* Working knowledge of ITIL Incident Management and Request Management, with experience maintaining accurate incident records, operational dashboards, and shift handovers.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate with Service Desk, infrastructure, application, security operations, and vendor teams.

**Nice to have**

* ITIL, CompTIA A+, Network+, ITSM, or similar technical certification.
* Experience with enterprise ticketing and monitoring platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, Remedy, or comparable tools.
* Prior experience in a 24/7 Command Center environment, knowledge-management activities, post-incident reviews, or AI-enabled support improvement.

**Benefits**
We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.
  
  
**Here's a Small Snapshot**

* Complimentary preventive health check-up for you & your spouse
* OPD coverage
* Best in class leave plan including paternity & family care leaves
* Counselling sessions to prioritize mental well-being
* Exclusive discount vouchers on Levi’s products

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to empowering individuals from all walks of life to achieve their professional goals with us, regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, or genetic information. We actively seek and encourage applications from diverse candidates, including those with disabilities, and offer accommodations throughout the selection process upon request.*

Bengaluru, India

Full time

title: Senior IT Operations Lead – India
description:
****Who we are****

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over seventeen million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings.

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.

****Purpose of the Role****

:

The Senior IT Operations Lead is a hands-on player-coach role, responsible for providing high-quality IT support and technical delivery while helping to lead and coordinate day-to-day IT operations for the local team in India.

This is not primarily a people-management position. Approximately 70–80% of the role will remain hands-on, covering day-to-day IT operations, technical troubleshooting, project work, security improvements, automation and other IT initiatives.

The role is suited to someone who can work autonomously, take ownership of issues and projects, communicate clearly, and ensure incidents, risks and operational concerns are properly investigated, documented, escalated and resolved.

A key part of the role is understanding not only what our IT policies, controls and processes require, but why they exist and the risks they are designed to address. This includes areas such as device security, hardware disposal, asset management, identity and access management, onboarding, offboarding and compliance-related activities.

The successful candidate will be expected to support users and maintain day-to-day IT services, while also having the technical capability and judgement to investigate more complex problems, improve existing systems and processes, and contribute to wider IT, security and automation projects.

****Role Overview:****

The Senior IT Operations Lead will act as a senior point of contact for local IT activities, working closely with the IT Manager, wider IT team, Infrastructure, Security and other internal departments.

The role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

This person will also provide additional technical capability for wider IT initiatives. They may be asked to investigate an existing system or process, assess whether it can be improved, automate a manual activity, review a technical or security configuration, or take ownership of a defined part of a larger project.

The expectation is not that the individual will already know the answer to every technical problem. They should, however, be capable of taking an objective, researching and investigating it independently, understanding the current configuration and requirements, evaluating possible solutions, and presenting a considered recommendation or implementation plan.

When incidents occur, the Senior IT Operations Lead will be expected to gather accurate information, perform appropriate troubleshooting, document what has been checked, identify impact, escalate appropriately and provide clear updates to the relevant teams.

The role will also help provide operational resilience for the India IT function, ensuring knowledge, capability and responsibility are not concentrated with a single local resource.

****Key Responsibilities****

****IT Support and Service Delivery****

* Provide high-quality 1st, 2nd and, where appropriate, 3rd line support to users.
* Support users across macOS, Windows, Linux, mobile devices, collaboration tools and office systems.
* Manage and resolve tickets through the IT ticketing system, ensuring clear updates, ownership and timely resolution.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes, including account setup, device preparation, access changes and equipment return.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, video conferencing, meeting room and general office IT issues.
* Support MDM-managed and non-MDM-managed devices.
* Act as a senior escalation point for more complex technical and operational issues.
* Take ownership of issues through to resolution rather than relying on detailed step-by-step direction.
* Work collaboratively with the wider IT, Infrastructure and Security teams where issues cross technical or regional boundaries.

****Technical Projects, Automation and Continuous Improvement****

* Work with the IT Manager on technical projects and wider IT initiatives alongside day-to-day operational responsibilities.
* Take ownership of defined project activities from investigation and planning through to implementation and documentation.
* Review existing systems, configurations and processes and identify opportunities to improve security, reliability, efficiency or manageability.
* Investigate technical requirements independently and provide evidence-based recommendations.
* Identify repetitive or manual IT processes that could be improved or automated.
* Build, maintain or improve scripts and lightweight automation using appropriate technologies and APIs.
* Test changes appropriately and ensure technical improvements are documented and supportable.
* Review existing implementations rather than assuming that the current configuration is necessarily the best configuration.
* Contribute to improvements across IT platforms, identity and access management, endpoint management and other enterprise systems.

****Incident Ownership and Communication****

* Take ownership of technical issues and ensure they are properly investigated before escalation.
* Clearly document troubleshooting steps, findings, business impact, affected users, timelines and actions taken.
* Escalate issues to the IT Manager, Infrastructure, Security or other departments with enough detail for effective follow-up.
* Provide clear written and verbal updates during incidents.
* Follow up on incidents to ensure root cause, lessons learned and any required process improvements are captured.
* Recognise when an issue can be resolved independently and when escalation or additional expertise is required.

****Security, Compliance and Controls****

* Support and take ownership of relevant IT controls associated with
  ****SOC 2, ISO 27001 and internal security requirements****

  .
* Play an active role in supporting SOC 2 audit activities within India, including ensuring required processes are followed and appropriate evidence is available.
* Support the implementation and ongoing operation of new IT controls as responsibilities and compliance requirements evolve.
* Understand the purpose and intent behind controls rather than treating them solely as procedural requirements.
* Ensure hardware is handled securely throughout its lifecycle, including wiping, return, reuse, recycling or destruction.
* Assist with IT audits, asset audits, access reviews and evidence gathering where required.
* Confidently explain IT processes and controls and provide appropriate supporting evidence during audits or compliance reviews.
* Identify and raise concerns where processes or technical configurations create unnecessary security or operational risk.
* Work with the IT Manager and Security team to identify opportunities to strengthen existing technical controls.

****Local IT Ownership and Team Support****

* Act as a senior IT presence within the India office and take ownership of local IT operational matters.
* Help prioritise and coordinate day-to-day activities within the local IT team.
* Provide guidance, technical support and mentoring to other IT support staff.
* Delegate appropriate activities while remaining actively involved in technical and operational delivery.
* Review work where appropriate and help maintain a consistent standard of quality.
* Build effective working relationships with local teams and other business stakeholders.
* Coordinate with local suppliers and vendors where required.
* Ensure local processes are completed correctly and supported by appropriate documentation and evidence.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, clear communication and continuous improvement.
* This is a
  ****hands-on leadership role rather than a traditional management position****

  . Leadership within the role comes from technical capability, judgement, ownership, mentoring and the ability to drive work through to completion.

****Key Systems and Platforms****

* You do not need to have experience with every system listed below but should have strong experience with similar enterprise IT tools and the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Google Workspace, including Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Admin Console.
* Google Meet and video conferencing.
* Slack for day-to-day communication and collaboration.
* Atlassian Jira for ticketing, support workflows and project tracking.
* Confluence for internal documentation and process guides.
* Microsoft Office 365 support where required.
* Apple Business Manager, including Automated Device Enrolment / DEP.
* MDM administration, preferably Iru (Kandji), Jamf, Google Workspace MDM or similar.
* Primarily macOS, iOS, iPadOS and Android devices. We also manage Windows and Linux endpoints.
* IT asset management systems; Snipe-IT experience is desirable but not essential.
* Identity, authentication and access management technologies.
* APIs and scripting technologies ideally Bash Shell or Python.

****Knowledge, Skills and Experience****

****Essential****

* Strong written and spoken English is essential for effective cross-regional communication and collaboration.
* Strong experience in IT support, IT operations, systems administration, desktop support or endpoint support.
* Experience supporting mostly macOS, Linux and Windows environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work through unfamiliar technical issues methodically and independently.
* Ability to take ownership of technical work without requiring continuous supervision or detailed step-by-step instruction.
* Good understanding of onboarding, offboarding, account management and device lifecycle management.
* Experience using enterprise ticketing and work-management platforms such as Jira Service
* Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice or similar.
* Good understanding of identity, authentication, access management and IT security principles.
* Understanding of device security, encryption, least privilege, MFA and secure asset handling.
* Experience administering enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Ability to investigate an existing technical configuration, identify potential improvements and communicate recommendations clearly.
* Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and professionally to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail when documenting issues, maintaining evidence and following IT processes.
* Ability to balance day-to-day operational responsibilities with project and improvement work.
* Ability to provide guidance and technical leadership to other team members.

****Desirable****

* Experience administering Google Workspace.
* Experience with Apple Business Manager and MDM platforms.
* Experience supporting Linux users.
* Experience with Slack, Jira, Confluence and Google Meet hardware.
* Experience with IT asset management systems.
* Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar compliance frameworks.
* Experience scripting in Bash, Python, PowerShell or similar.
* Experience working with REST APIs or SaaS integrations.
* Experience automating IT administration or operational processes.
* Experience with SSO, SAML, SCIM or other identity and provisioning technologies.
* Experience supporting wireless networks, meeting rooms, AV systems, access control or security camera systems.
* Experience contributing to technical or security improvement projects.

****Interview Process****

Stage 1 - Call with a talent acquisition team member (30 minutes)

Stage 2 - Call with the tech team (45 minutes)

Stage 3 - Technical Test

Stage 4 - Final call with Hiring manager and tech team

****What’s in it for you?****

* Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhs
* Life Insurance / Accidental cover
* Gratuity as per law
* PF as per law
* 18 days paid leave + 6 sick day leave (Yearly)
* 10 declared holidays (Yearly)
* 5 fully paid Selfie Days - for your own personal development, volunteering, charity events, etc
* Quarterly Team and company activities, Social clubs.
* Continuous learning opportunities (Annual Training budgets, conferences etc)

title: Product Support Specialist

This role involves troubleshooting issues, assisting clients, and ensuring smooth system functionality.

title: Technical Support Engineer (L2 Application Support)
description:
About the job

Position: Technical Support Engineer (L2 Application Support)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled Technical Support Engineer to support our FinTech and Payment Platform. The ideal candidate should have hands-on knowledge of web application architecture, strong troubleshooting abilities, and experience investigating production issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.

This role acts as a bridge between Customer Support and Engineering by identifying root causes, resolving production issues, and ensuring high platform availability while providing excellent client support.

Key Responsibilities

* Investigate and resolve production issues reported by clients and internal teams.
* Provide Level-2 technical support for web applications, APIs, and payment systems.
* Analyse application logs, debug frontend, backend, API, and database issues.
* Perform SQL-based data validation and troubleshoot transaction-related issues.
* Monitor application health, services, queues, and production environments.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and document recurring issues.
* Coordinate with Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Operations teams for issue resolution.
* Validate production fixes and perform post-deployment verification.
* Communicate technical updates and resolutions to clients professionally.
* Ensure incidents are resolved within defined SLAs.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of Node.js, Express.js, React.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Laravel (PHP).
* Experience working with REST APIs, JWT/OAuth authentication, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, SQL queries, joins, data validation, and basic query optimisation.
* Hands-on experience with Postman, browser developer tools, application logs, Git, Linux commands, and production debugging.
* Good understanding of HTTP protocols, networking concepts, JSON/XML, and application monitoring.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with FinTech, Payment Gateways, Banking APIs, UPI/Card/Wallet transactions.
* Knowledge of Redis, Queues (RabbitMQ/Bull), Docker, AWS/Azure, CI/CD, and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana, ELK Stack, CloudWatch, or Prometheus.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and support a 24×7 rotational production environment.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in Technical Support, Application Support, Production Support, or Software Support.
* Experience supporting production web applications is highly preferred.

Success Metrics

* Meet SLA, FRT, and MTTR targets.
* Deliver timely issue resolution and accurate Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Minimise recurring production incidents and downtime.
* Maintain high client satisfaction through effective technical support and communication.
