title: Collaboration Platforms Administrator
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And Role**
We’re excited to bring on a Collaboration Platforms Administrator based in Bangalore, India. As part of eBay’s Global Collaboration Services organization, this support-focused role will provide day-to-day operational support for our enterprise collaboration ecosystem, with primary responsibility for email services, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Slack, in addition to other services managed by the Collaboration Platforms team. The position will work as part of a global team of 10 direct peers supporting collaboration services at enterprise scale. We rely on this person to help keep these platforms operating securely, reliably, and efficiently, serving as a key point of ownership for L3 requests, troubleshooting, and escalations. This role will partner closely with IAM, Helpdesk Support, Security, Procurement, Collaboration Platforms Engineering, and business stakeholders to support service reliability, user needs, and ongoing platform operations.
  
  
Experience supporting collaboration and messaging platforms in a large global enterprise environment (20,000+ users).
  
  
Experience administering Slack Enterprise Grid in a large enterprise environment. Experience with Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Google Workspace Admin APIs, or similar administrative automation tools. Experience implementing or supporting AI governance, enterprise AI capabilities, AI-powered automation, and collaboration platform integrations.
  
  
The ITSS Collaboration Platforms team enables eBay employees to communicate, collaborate, and work securely across the globe.
  
  
We administer and support enterprise messaging and collaboration technologies including Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Slack Enterprise Grid, Google Workspace, Cisco Cloud Email Security, and a portfolio of SaaS collaboration applications. Our team focuses on delivering secure, reliable, and scalable messaging and collaboration services while driving operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
As a Collaboration Platform Administrator, you will provide operational support and administration for our collaboration ecosystem. You'll work closely with engineers, security teams, service owners, business partners, and vendors to troubleshoot issues, implement platform improvements, support integrations, and ensure our messaging and collaboration services remain highly available, secure, and scalable.
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Administer and support enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms including Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Slack Enterprise Grid, Google Workspace, Cisco Cloud Email Security, and other SaaS collaboration services.
* Manage and troubleshoot enterprise email services, including mail flow, message hygiene, transport rules, mail routing, connectors, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and email authentication technologies such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Support enterprise email security by administering Cisco Cloud Email Security policies, investigating phishing and spoofing incidents, analyzing message traces, and partnering with Information Security on email-related threats and escalations.
* Perform day-to-day platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, incident response, and service restoration while meeting established service level objectives.
* Support platform security through identity management, access controls, data protection policies, and security best practices. Configure and support collaboration applications such as Monday.com, Figma, Lucid Software, Smartsheet, Calendly, Zoom, and related productivity platforms.
* Implement and maintain integrations between collaboration platforms using APIs, automation tools, and third-party applications.
* Support AI-enabled capabilities across collaboration platforms, including AI assistants, workflow automation, MCP servers, approved third-party AI integrations, and emerging AI technologies.
* Create and maintain automation using PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, or similar technologies to improve operational efficiency.
* Develop operational reporting, dashboards, and metrics to improve service health, platform adoption, email deliverability, and operational efficiency.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in change management activities, platform upgrades, testing, and production deployments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Security, Identity, Infrastructure, Compliance, Legal, Vendor Support, and business stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues.
* Partner with service owners and vendors to evaluate new features, validate platform changes, and support the rollout of enhancements that improve security, reliability, and the employee collaboration experience.
* Participate in a global follow-the-sun weekday operational support rotation, providing on-call coverage during assigned regional business hours and ensuring seamless support through coordinated handoffs across global teams.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience administering enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms in large-scale environments.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack Enterprise Grid, and enterprise email infrastructure.
* Experience administering enterprise email security platforms such as Cisco Cloud Email Security (IronPort), Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of enterprise mail flow, SMTP, message routing, connectors, transport rules, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and email security best practices.
* Experience troubleshooting complex email delivery issues, message trace analysis, phishing investigations, and mail routing problems.
* Experience supporting SaaS collaboration platforms such as Monday.com, Figma, Lucid Software, Smartsheet, Calendly, Zoom, or similar technologies.
* Experience supporting identity and access management technologies, including SSO, SAML, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, and enterprise authentication.
* Experience working with REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, Google Workspace APIs, Slack APIs, automation platforms, or scripting languages such as PowerShell or Google Apps Script.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools, AI agents, MCP servers, workflow automation, and enterprise governance of AI capabilities.
* Experience using monitoring, reporting, or log analysis tools such as Splunk or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple cloud platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and support both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment while maintaining a strong customer service focus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting collaboration and messaging platforms in a large global enterprise environment (20,000+ users).
* Experience administering Slack Enterprise Grid in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Google Workspace Admin APIs, or similar administrative automation tools.
* Experience implementing or supporting AI governance, enterprise AI capabilities, AI-powered automation, and collaboration platform integrations.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

title: Digital Workplace Operations Lead
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
As an Advisor, Operations Lead within the Digital Workplace team, you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for the operational health, governance, and continuous improvement of Cargill's endpoint and collaboration environment. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution — you will translate roadmap priorities into operationally sound, day-to-day practices while acting as a trusted subject matter expert across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and global service partners.
  
  
You will bring structure to complexity, data to decisions, and clarity to a fast-moving transformation — all without direct reports, but with significant influence across the teams and leaders you partner with.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Operational Excellence

+ Own and improve Digital Workplace operations, covering device lifecycle, provisioning, depot management, endpoint governance, and collaboration platforms.
+ Track KPIs and SLAs, identify risks, and drive improvements with cross-functional teams.
+ Maintain standardized procedures and act as an escalation point, ensuring timely, accountable resolution of complex operational issues across stakeholders.

* Collaboration Platform Governance

+ Support governance of the Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint permissions, OneDrive, Teams lifecycle, and security groups.
+ Collaborate with Security and IAM teams to ensure data protection and access control.
+ Drive attestation, automation, and audits, while aligning with Entra ID and HR systems to ensure accurate, compliant access governance.

* Governance & Compliance

+ Support the design and execution of governance frameworks for endpoint access, device compliance, collaboration platform policies, and Digital Workplace standards in alignment with Cargill's security and IT requirements.
+ Partner with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure operational practices meet internal policy and external regulatory requirements across a global footprint.

* Program & Stakeholder Support

+ Collaborate with program teams to ensure operational readiness and seamless transition to steady-state operations.
+ Advise leadership with data-driven insights on service health and transformation progress.
+ Engage stakeholders and end users to gather feedback, drive change, and promote adoption of modern workplace tools across a global workforce.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead operational improvement initiatives using structured problem-solving to enhance efficiency and service quality.
+ Identify and implement automation opportunities across workflows in partnership with engineering teams.
+ Stay updated on Microsoft 365, Nexthink, and PCaaS trends, translating emerging capabilities into actionable operational recommendations for leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field — or equivalent work experience.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, Digital Workplace, or endpoint management in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing device lifecycle, provisioning processes, and endpoint governance at scale (10,000+ devices preferred).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 platform operations, including SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Exchange/mail governance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize operational data into actionable insights and executive-ready communications.
* Proven ability to work effectively across matrixed, global organizations and manage multiple priorities without direct authority.
* Experience with ITSM frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and operational reporting tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Windows 365 (W365), Entra ID (Azure AD), and/or Nexthink.
* Familiarity with PCaaS (PC as a Service) operating models and global vendor management.
* Experience designing or operating SharePoint permissions governance programs, including oversharing remediation, attestation workflows, and automated access controls.
* Experience supporting large-scale technology transformation programs, particularly mid-flight rather than greenfield.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent.
* Microsoft 365 certifications (e.g., MS-700, MS-900, or equivalent) a plus.
* Demonstrated experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).

**Competencies for Success**

* Operational Rigor — You bring discipline and structure to ambiguous environments, translating strategy into repeatable, scalable processes that hold up across a global, multi-industry organization.
* Stakeholder Influence — As a senior IC, you earn trust and drive alignment without formal authority, communicating clearly across engineering teams, business leaders, and end users alike.
* Breadth & Curiosity — You're comfortable owning both device operations and collaboration platform governance — and you actively seek to connect the dots between them.
* Ownership Mindset — You take accountability for outcomes, follow through on commitments, and proactively surface issues before they become problems.
* Data-Driven Thinking — You use metrics and evidence to drive decisions, tell compelling stories, and demonstrate operational value to leadership.

title: Global Telecom Support
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Mobility Telecom, Network Operations & Major Incident Lead will provide end-to-end technical and operational leadership for a global retail telecom and network environment supporting Mobility and E-Mobility services.
  
  
The role will act as a senior technical authority and operational integrator across internal support teams, network and telecom suppliers, application teams, service providers, business stakeholders and incident-management functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining network stability, leading the resolution of complex incidents, coordinating major incidents, overseeing infrastructure changes, driving root-cause analysis and improving the overall reliability, security and performance of the service.
  
  
The role requires strong ownership across a highly integrated support landscape where telecom, network, payment, loyalty, site systems and central applications cannot be managed as isolated service components.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Accountabilities**
**1. Global Telecom and Network Operations**

* Provide senior technical and operational leadership for global Mobility and E-Mobility telecom infrastructure.
* Maintain end-to-end oversight of network connectivity and associated infrastructure across retail sites, backbone services, data centres, third-party networks and externally managed connectivity services.
* Monitor the health, availability, performance and security of the telecom environment using enterprise and vendor monitoring platforms.
* Analyse monitoring alerts, operational events and service degradation indicators to determine business impact and initiate the appropriate response.
* Ensure incidents affecting routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN tunnels and associated connectivity components are correctly triaged and assigned.
* Maintain ownership of complex operational issues until resolution or until a complete and formally accepted handover has been performed.
* Support a global, follow-the-sun operating model, including participation in on-call, weekend and public-holiday support arrangements.
* Provide technical guidance to operations teams handling site-level, multi-site and infrastructure-wide disruptions.

The contract identifies global telecom monitoring, real-time infrastructure visibility, incident notification and escalation as core components of the service. It also covers routers, switches, firewalls, VPN tunnels, load balancers, backbone infrastructure and vendor-managed telecom services.
  
  

* Incident and Major Incident Management
* Lead the technical response for high-impact single-site, multi-site and global service incidents.
* Coordinate incident bridges involving network suppliers, telecom providers, application teams, site-support teams, service managers and business stakeholders.
* Perform initial and advanced technical triage to establish incident scope, affected services, market impact, urgency and priority.
* Ensure incidents contain sufficient diagnostic and business-impact information before escalation.
* Coordinate the creation and progression of incident and major-incident records in the relevant service-management platform.
* Manage P3 and P4 major incidents and support the designated incident-command function during P1 and P2 major incidents.
* Establish clear ownership across resolver groups and ensure suppliers engage within their contractual responsibilities.
* Schedule and lead technical calls when required to accelerate investigation and recovery.
* Maintain an accurate incident chronology, including decisions, actions, ownership, dependencies and restoration progress.
* Confirm service restoration through monitoring tools, resolver-group evidence or confirmation from the reporting party before closure.
* Ensure incident, recovery and closure communications are distributed to the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
* Support incident managers by translating complex technical findings into clear operational and business-impact statements.

The scope requires first-level incident management, major incident management, prioritisation, ticket creation, supplier escalation, technical-call coordination, service-restoration confirmation and communications throughout the incident lifecycle.
  
  

* Advanced Troubleshooting and Technical Investigation
* Lead technical investigation of complex, recurring or high-impact telecom and network issues.
* Perform full-stack troubleshooting across the network path, including routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, traffic flows, network security controls and dependent services.
* Use packet-capture and network-analysis tools to isolate faults at packet and protocol level.
* Analyse network traffic, device events, application logs, site-system logs and monitoring data to identify hard-to-detect issues.
* Develop and test technical hypotheses using available operational evidence.
* Coordinate cross-supplier troubleshooting where ownership or fault location is unclear.
* Determine whether failures originate within site infrastructure, telecom connectivity, network backbone, security services, vendor platforms, application services or third-party interfaces.
* Produce clear technical findings, recommended remediation actions and risk assessments.
* Provide technical direction to less-experienced engineers and operations analysts during critical incidents.

The contract specifically requires advanced troubleshooting, traffic analysis, packet-level investigation, knowledge of multiple routing protocols, network design expertise and analysis of site-system and application logs.
  
  

* Root-Cause and Problem Management
* Lead Root Cause Analysis for significant telecom, network and third-party incidents.
* Ensure root-cause documentation clearly describes the failure, contributing factors, business impact, recovery actions and preventive measures.
* Challenge incomplete or unsupported root-cause statements provided by suppliers.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to verified completion.
* Raise and coordinate problem records for recurring or systemic issues.
* Use incident trends, operational data and recurring alert patterns to identify candidates for problem management.
* Facilitate technical reviews involving internal teams and external service providers.
* Ensure RCA documentation is completed within applicable operational timelines.
* Maintain traceability between incidents, problems, known errors, changes and improvement activities.
* Share lessons learned and incorporate agreed improvements into support procedures, monitoring rules and operational documentation.

The SWAT scope assigns responsibility for RCA leadership, documentation completion, supplier engagement, root-cause validation and accountability. The administrative support scope also includes problem management for supported operational platforms.
  
  

* Change, Migration and Implementation Support
* Assess telecom and network changes for technical risk, operational impact and business impact.
* Coordinate network changes, migrations and implementations with suppliers and delivery teams.
* Evaluate third-party changes that may affect Mobility services.
* Ensure relevant stakeholders review and approve changes before implementation.
* Create and distribute change notifications to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor the implementation of high-risk or business-critical changes.
* Coordinate technical support during change implementation and post-change validation.
* Verify that changes achieve the intended outcome without creating unacceptable service degradation.
* Support recovery or rollback activities when a change is unsuccessful.
* Ensure network, firewall, configuration, support and operational documentation is updated following implementation.
* Review project implementation plans for operational readiness, supportability and alignment with the existing environment.

The contract includes change coordination, third-party change-impact assessment, stakeholder approval, Change Notification Letters, implementation monitoring and technical support for network changes and migrations.
  
  

* Network Architecture and Design Assurance
* Act as a senior technical authority for the end-to-end Mobility telecom and network architecture.
* Review solution and network designs for reliability, availability, security, scalability, operability and supportability.
* Provide technical recommendations to project and delivery teams.
* Assess proposed changes against the existing telecom environment and relevant service dependencies.
* Architect, review or approve network designs within the candidate’s delegated authority.
* Identify operational risks, integration gaps, monitoring requirements and support-model deficiencies before production deployment.
* Ensure designs include appropriate diagnostic, failover, security, documentation and operational-support provisions.
* Support implementation teams during deployment, transition and early-life support.
* Ensure integration requirements across multiple suppliers and business partners are understood and coordinated.
* Promote standardisation and reduction of unnecessary technical complexity across the network landscape.

The SWAT team is defined as responsible for end-to-end technical architecture, multi-supplier process integration, project-impact assessment, technical recommendations, design review or approval and implementation support.
  
  

* Firewall, Security and Access Governance
* Provide senior oversight of firewall rules supporting the Mobility environment.
* Review firewall-rule changes for technical validity, security risk, business justification and implementation impact.
* Ensure access and infrastructure requests follow the required approval and governance processes.
* Review and manage third-party access requests relating to infrastructure, data-centre or service-support activities.
* Support access-control processes and periodic access reviews for relevant operational platforms.
* Coordinate with security, risk, infrastructure and supplier teams to resolve security-related network issues.
* Support compliance activities associated with Information Risk Management and Payment Card Industry requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records and technical documentation to support audit and compliance activities.
* Escalate non-compliance, uncontrolled access, unsupported connectivity or material security risks to the relevant stakeholders.
* Balance operational recovery requirements with security and access-control obligations during critical incidents.

The contract includes ownership of a significant portion of the firewall rule sets, third-party access management, infrastructure change requests and support for Information Risk Management and PCI compliance activities.
  
  

* Supplier and Stakeholder Management
* Act as the senior technical liaison between internal teams, business stakeholders, telecom providers, technology suppliers and third-party service providers.
* Establish clear technical and operational ownership across multi-supplier incidents.
* Hold suppliers accountable for investigation quality, contractual service obligations, recovery actions and root-cause deliverables.
* Escalate supplier-performance concerns through the appropriate operational and commercial channels.
* Obtain technical evidence from suppliers following incidents and changes.
* Challenge delays, unsupported conclusions and incomplete remediation plans.
* Coordinate dependencies between connectivity providers, managed-service suppliers, application teams and site-support teams.
* Provide concise updates to service management and business leadership.
* Maintain professional working relationships across geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams.
* Represent the telecom and network operations function in service reviews, project meetings, change reviews, incident reviews and technical governance forums.

The role descriptions require working across international teams, leading meetings, coordinating internal and external support entities and ensuring suppliers and vendors perform as required under their contracts.
  
  

* Monitoring and Service Improvement
* Drive proactive monitoring and early identification of telecom and service degradation.
* Review alerts, dashboards, thresholds and escalation paths to improve incident detection and response quality.
* Identify monitoring gaps across network, site, application and third-party services.
* Work with monitoring-service owners and suppliers to implement actionable alerts.
* Reduce alert noise, duplicate notifications and non-actionable events.
* Use operational data to identify reliability, performance and service-improvement opportunities.
* Lead network optimisation and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Recommend automation opportunities for repetitive triage, notification, reporting and evidence-gathering activities.
* Track the effectiveness of implemented improvements through operational measures and incident trends.
* Ensure monitoring procedures remain aligned with changes to technology, business services and supplier arrangements.

The scope references proactive monitoring through tools and vendors, operational-data analysis, corrective actions, network optimisation and continuous service improvement.
  
  

* Documentation and Operational Readiness
* Create, maintain and continuously improve end-to-end technical and operational documentation.
* Develop network diagrams, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, escalation matrices, process flows and incident-response playbooks.
* Maintain accurate records of network circuits, racks, devices, configurations, inventory, contacts and service dependencies where applicable.
* Ensure documentation supports rapid triage within demanding incident-response timelines.
* Review project support models, support decks and operational-readiness documentation.
* Validate that new services have complete monitoring, ticketing, access, contact, escalation and Minimum Data Set information before operational handover.
* Establish documentation standards and quality controls for the support organisation.
* Conduct periodic reviews to identify outdated business-critical information.
* Ensure changes to applications, infrastructure, suppliers and contacts are reflected promptly in operational documentation.
* Train team members in the effective use of documentation and service-management tools.

The contract requires standardised network and process documentation, project-onboarding documentation, escalation information, support-model review, and maintenance of network infrastructure and inventory records.
  
  

* Team Leadership and Capability Development
* Provide technical leadership, coaching and guidance to network engineers, incident analysts and operations personnel.
* Define expected quality standards for incident handling, communications, ticket updates, documentation and technical investigation.
* Review the quality of team deliverables and provide constructive feedback.
* Lead technical knowledge-sharing sessions and post-incident learning reviews.
* Develop team capability in troubleshooting, service management, network analysis and stakeholder communication.
* Support workload prioritisation during periods of high incident demand.
* Delegate activities based on risk, complexity, urgency and engineer capability.
* Encourage ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement across integrated support teams.
* Act as an escalation point for technical, process and supplier-related issues.
* Support service leadership with resource planning, operational reporting and resolution of day-to-day delivery concerns.

The contract’s supervisor and service-manager descriptions include team guidance, delivery standards, training, workload management, status reporting, process development and escalation of critical issues.
  
  

* Reporting and Executive Communication
* Prepare monthly service reports covering incidents, recurring issues, improvement activities, technical achievements, risks and upcoming changes.
* Communicate the value delivered by the telecom and network operations team.
* Provide clear updates during high-impact incidents without unnecessary technical jargon.
* Produce technical call summaries, incident recaps, change notices and stakeholder notifications.
* Translate technical events into business-impact statements suitable for senior stakeholders.
* Report material operational risks and unresolved supplier dependencies.
* Ensure reports are accurate, evidence-based and suitable for governance review.
* Maintain action logs and follow up outstanding commitments with internal teams and suppliers.

Monthly reporting of achievements, value-added contributions and upcoming Mobility activities is explicitly included in the SWAT responsibilities. Incident, major-incident and change communications are also included throughout the support scope
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education and Certifications**
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electronics, Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline.

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. As a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will be tasked with handling incoming customer cases submitted through the support portal, actively managing the inbound support queue, and providing real-time assistance via inbound customer chat. AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. title: Designated Support Engineer III
description:

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. title: Applications Engineering, Sr Staff Engineer
description:
**We Are:**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are:**
You are energized by motion—new problems, shifting priorities, and the kind of fast-paced environment where progress depends on clear thinking and calm execution. You don’t wait for perfect information before you act; you ask sharp questions, form a hypothesis, and move forward while keeping others aligned on what you’re learning. You thrive when the work is ambiguous and the stakes are real, because you enjoy turning complexity into something teams can rally around.
  
  
You approach challenges with a builder’s mindset. You’re curious, hands-on, and willing to experiment, but you’re equally disciplined about quality and follow-through. When something isn’t working, you don’t look for someone to blame—you look for the root cause, the simplest path to resolution, and the long-term fix that prevents repeat issues. You communicate with intention, adapting your message so engineers, partners, and stakeholders all walk away with the same understanding and next steps.
  
  
You’re the teammate people trust in the middle of pressure. You create space for collaboration, invite different viewpoints, and make others better by sharing context and giving credit freely. You take ownership naturally: when you see a gap, you close it; when you see an opportunity, you champion it. title: Technical Support Engineer (IT Infrastructure) - Bangalore (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Support Engineer at Flix, you'll be the first point of contact for IT infrastructure requests, helping employees across the globe stay productive through reliable service desk and on-site support. You'll be part of a globally distributed IT Infrastructure Support Team that owns and manages critical services — including the employee device lifecycle (Microsoft Intune/Autopilot), our Atlassian cloud environment, and technical event support.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Resolve employee IT requests efficiently via our ticketing system, providing a smooth and friendly support experience
* Manage the device lifecycle end-to-end — hardware procurement, provisioning, setup, asset tracking, and troubleshooting
* Support collaboration tools including Office 365, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and OneDrive
* Help employees get the most out of Atlassian tools such as Jira, Confluence, and JSM
* Create and maintain knowledge-base articles and IT documentation to support self-service and team efficiency
* Build hands-on experience with device management platforms and IT infrastructure tooling
* Collaborate with colleagues across global offices, contributing to team ceremonies and cross-functional projects

**What You Bring**

* A degree, certification, or vocational training in an IT-related field (e.g. Information Technology, Computer Science, or Information Systems)
* 2–4 years of experience in IT support, service desk, or technical customer support
* Solid working knowledge of Office 365 and standard workplace collaboration tools
* Comfort communicating clearly and patiently with non-technical users
* Curiosity and a genuine eagerness to learn new technologies and workflows
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft cloud technologies (Intune, Entra ID, Autopilot)
* Experience administering Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence, JSM)
* Experience supporting employees across multiple time zones or global offices (nice to have)

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Work from another location for up to 6 weeks per year, depending on your role
* Hybrid work model: Office-first with flexibility to balance work and life
* Life Cover: Insurance cover for employees
* Medical Cover: Hospitalisation and treatment cover for employees and eligible family members
* Accident Cover: Personal accident insurance for employee
* OPD Wallet: a fixed annual allowance for outpatient care — consultations, medicines, and more — for employee and eligible family members
* Wellness Allowance: a monthly wellness allowance credited to your Plum wallet, to spend on gym, yoga, fitness equipment, or any eligible wellness activity of your choice
* Meal Vouchers: Optional tax-exempt meal benefit under the Income Tax Act
* Wellbeing support: Access to confidential 1:1 counselling, stress management courses, and mental health resources
* Learning & Development: Language learning opportunities, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced Flix colleagues to accelerate your career

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link:
**Locations - Flix Career**
**Why Join Flix?**
At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  
  
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
  
  
If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia.
  
  
**What is this role all about?**
As a
**Senior Customer Experience Associate**
, you will take ownership of customer issues that require deeper technical troubleshooting, stronger understanding of client workflows, and coordination across multiple teams. You will work closely with customers, Implementation, Product, SRE and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve complex issues, manage escalations, and ensure a smooth customer experience.
  
  
The role combines
**customer engagement, technical problem-solving, issue ownership and operational discipline**
, while also contributing to better documentation and more effective support processes.
  
  
**Sounds interesting?**
**Here’s What You Will Do In This Role**
**Client Engagement**

* Build strong understanding of client workflows, business logic and use cases to provide context-aware technical support.
* Act as a reliable point of contact for complex customer issues, providing clear and timely updates throughout the resolution process.
* Understand the business impact and priority of customer issues and ensure the right level of escalation and follow-up.
* Provide solution-oriented guidance to customers by understanding their workflows, requirements, and business context.

**Technical Expertise**

* Investigate and troubleshoot complex application, API and integration issues, using available logs, API responses and system information to identify probable causes.
* Analyse issues logically, distinguish between configuration, integration and product-related problems, and provide complete technical information for further investigation where required.
* Raise and manage BUGs/CRs in JIRA with clear reproduction steps, business context and supporting technical information, and follow them through to closure.
* Collaborate with Product, SRE and Engineering teams on complex issues and validate fixes or resolutions before communicating closure to customers.
* Build and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, FAQs and troubleshooting guides covering client workflows, business context and recurring issues.
* Perform QA/QC checks and set up alert mechanisms to proactively identify and address potential issues and bugs.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Manage customer issues through triage, prioritisation, escalation, resolution and closure, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs.
* Coordinate with Implementation, Product, SRE and Engineering teams to drive complex issues to resolution and ensure clear ownership across teams.
* Support release, configuration or implementation-related activities where required, ensuring customer-impacting issues are identified and addressed proactively.
* Identify recurring support challenges and contribute to improvements in processes, documentation and ways of working.

**Business Acumen**

* Perform basic analysis of customer issues, support trends, and relevant operational data to identify patterns and areas for improvement.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track customer issues, support trends, SLAs, and other relevant metrics.
* Use data and dashboard insights to highlight recurring issues, operational gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Present relevant findings clearly to support discussions with Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders.

**What does success look like in this role?**
Success in this role means
**consistently resolving complex customer issues within defined SLAs, maintaining strong customer trust, providing accurate technical troubleshooting and escalation, and driving issues to closure through effective cross-functional collaboration.**
It also means building strong knowledge of customer workflows and contributing to documentation, process improvements and a more effective support experience.
  
  
**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**

* You have 3+ years of experience in Customer Experience, technical support, application support or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or CRM environment.
* You have experience handling complex customer issues and escalations and coordinating with technical teams for resolution.
* You are comfortable working with ticketing tools such as Freshdesk and issue-management tools, managing multiple priorities while meeting SLAs.
* You have a strong understanding of client workflows, business logic and SaaS product functionality.
* You have experience working with APIs, integrations or basic backend troubleshooting.
* You have experience creating or maintaining technical documentation, runbooks, FAQs or troubleshooting guides.
* You communicate clearly and professionally with both customers and technical/internal teams.

**What are the most critical skills for this role?**

* Strong technical troubleshooting and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate complex issues, identify probable root causes and provide clear information for escalation.
* Strong customer handling skills, with the ability to manage expectations during complex or high-priority issues.
* Ability to understand technical issues in the context of customer workflows and business impact.
* Strong ownership and follow-through on issues across multiple teams.
* Ability to document technical issues, solutions and recurring scenarios clearly and accurately.
* Strong prioritisation and time-management skills in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

**You Will Have An Advantage If You**

* Have hands-on experience with JIRA for BUG/CR tracking and escalation management.
* Have experience working with enterprise or high-volume SaaS customers.
* Have exposure to API testing/debugging tools such as Postman.
* Have experience creating technical runbooks, knowledge articles or troubleshooting documentation.
* Have worked closely with Product, Engineering, SRE or Implementation teams on customer issues.
* Have exposure to AI-powered SaaS products, chatbots or customer experience automation.
* Have exposure to dashboarding tools and analytics for tracking and analysing customer or operational data.
* Have exposure to prompt engineering and AI tools.

**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**

* You will work on a leading enterprise SaaS platform used by some of India's top brands, gaining exposure to complex customer environments and large-scale CX operations.
* You will deepen your technical troubleshooting, product and problem-solving skills by working on diverse customer challenges.
* You will work closely with Product, Engineering, SRE and Implementation teams, building strong cross-functional experience.
* You will develop a deeper understanding of enterprise customer workflows, SaaS products and technical support operations.
* You will be part of a fast-growing organization that values ownership, learning and career progression.

title: Senior IT Administrator (IT Infrastructure, Endpoint & Security)
description:
**Company Description**

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in the USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep, large-scale AI and ML solutions for the construction industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution, “Kaël” — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM models, deviation detection, and as-built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Senior IT Administrator to own day-to-day IT operations while building out a more mature infrastructure, identity, endpoint, and security backbone as Inkers scales. This role goes beyond frontline support — you will administer Microsoft 365 and endpoint/MDM environments end-to-end, strengthen identity and access management, support cloud administration across AWS/Azure, and bring structure to IT security and compliance practices. You will also mentor and support junior IT staff and act as the go-to escalation point for complex issues. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru.

**Responsibilities**

* Own Microsoft 365 administration — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive — including licensing, mail flow, retention policies, and PowerShell-driven automation.
* Lead identity and access management across Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including user provisioning/deprovisioning, security groups, MFA, and Conditional Access.
* Administer endpoint and MDM environments (Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro, or equivalent) across Windows, macOS, and iOS — device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app deployment.
* Provide IT support to employees for hardware, software, network, email, and system-related issues, and set up/configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, and other equipment.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers, and other network issues; support enterprise networking (e.g. Cisco Meraki) where applicable.
* Assist with AWS/Azure cloud monitoring, administration, and cost/performance optimisation.
* Maintain IT asset records, software licenses, and equipment inventories; maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting records.
* Perform system updates, antivirus/EDR checks, backups, and other security activities; support ISO 27001-aligned security and audit practices.
* Support CCTV, NVR, access-control systems, and other office/site IT infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors for internet, hardware, software, AMC, and other IT services.
* Own employee onboarding and offboarding, including system setup and access management.
* Track IT issues end-to-end and ensure timely resolution; act as the Level 2/3 escalation point for the IT function.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support, or System Administration.
* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux systems, plus computer hardware, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.
* Working knowledge of AWS/Azure or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with MDM/endpoint management (Intune, Jamf, or similar) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to information security practices and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) is a plus.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and handle multiple IT requirements.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.

title: Staff Technical Support Engineer - Platinum (Prisma Access)
description:

title: Identity Operations Engineer
description:

You will work closely with our US-based infrastructure and security team, clearing routine work ahead of the US business day and partnering with colleagues in Europe during their working hours.
  
  
This is a hands-on operational role with a clearly defined scope. Identity architecture, application integration, conditional access design, and network security are owned by our Lead Infrastructure & Security Engineer. * Own an assigned service desk queue against agreed response and resolution targets, maintaining accurate ticket records for all privileged actions.
* Document recurring tasks as runbooks so routine work can be performed consistently and handed off cleanly between regions.

* Experience administering Exchange Online, including PowerShell-based administration.

* PowerShell scripting sufficient to automate routine and bulk administrative tasks.

* Experience supporting United States and European stakeholders from a global capability or shared services center.
* Experience operating under formal change management and familiarity with ITIL practices.

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities:****
As a Senior Security Analyst – System Administration (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring the secure and compliant operation of our enterprise-critical IT systems, including SAP, B2B integrations, MES, and Baan (Infor LN). You will serve as the central point of contact for IT audit-related activities, working closely with internal teams, external auditors, and system stakeholders to ensure adherence to security and compliance standards.
  
  
In this position, you will combine your deep technical knowledge of system administration with your expertise in IT compliance to monitor, document, and enhance the security posture of our interconnected system landscape. You will contribute to audit readiness, security operations, and the continuous improvement of our Information Security Management System (ISMS) – all within a dynamic, production-oriented environment with complex integration between IT and OT systems.
  
  
If you are looking for a strategic and hands-on role at the intersection of IT security, compliance, and critical business systems, we invite you to join our international IT security team.
  
  
The System Admin SAP Security Analyst will work closely with the global ISOL (Industrial Solution) Team and their Manager to ensure the smooth operation and security of the SAP systems.
  
  
****Your Responsibilities****
**Audit & Compliance Support**

* Plan, coordinate, and support internal and external IT audits (e.g. ITGC, SOX, internal audit)
* Act as the interface between IT operations, application owners (SAP, B2B, MES, Baan), and auditors
* Track and implement audit findings and continuously improve audit readiness

* Evaluate security risks in the existing system landscape and develop appropriate mitigation strategies
* Maintain and optimize technical logging, monitoring, and reporting solutions

**Security Operations & ISMS Support**

* Contribute to the development and enhancement of the ISMS (according to ISO 27001 or BSI standards)
* Analyze security incidents and vulnerabilities, and coordinate remediation activities
* Define and maintain security policies and operational documentation

* Monitor and analyze security incidents, conducting audits and vulnerability assessments to identify and address potential risks and vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate with IT teams and external partners to ensure compliance with security standards. Manage relationships with external vendors and consultants for security-related projects and services.
* Stay up to date with the latest developments and trends in ISOL Landscape, Azure, and SAP, B2B MES, Baan security.
* Provide technical guidance and support to other team members as needed.

* Degree in (Business) Informatics, IT Security, Computer Sciences or comparable education
* SAP Certification
* Several years of professional experience in IT security, system administration, or IT audit with a focus on compliance
* Strong knowledge in administration and security of SAP systems, MES environments, and ideally Baan (Infor LN)
* Experience with B2B interfaces and secure operations (e.g. EDI, API management)
* Excellent English language skills

* Familiarity with IT security standards such as ISO 27001, BSI, ITIL, or COBIT

title: Senior Associate, Application Onboarding,  IAM
description:
**Role Overview**
The Application Onboarding Associate supports the onboarding of applications into SailPoint IdentityNow by gathering pre‑onboarding information, preparing documentation, and assisting with technical deployment activities. Working closely with project teams, senior analysts, application owners, and IT stakeholders, the role ensures consistent application onboarding processes, high‑quality data, and effective transition into BAU operations. This position contributes directly to platform maturity, audit readiness, and the overall success of the Identity Governance service.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collect, validate, and document pre‑onboarding information from application owners and stakeholders.
* Support the assessment and selection of appropriate onboarding methods and connector types (e.g., AD, CSV, API/web services).
* Assist in deploying and configuring applications within SailPoint IdentityNow under the direction of senior analysts.
* Execute Post‑Implementation Testing (PIT) activities including data validation, entitlement verification, and lifecycle checks.
* Perform routine data quality reviews, cleansing, and maintenance to ensure accuracy and integrity of identity data.
* Create or enhance scripts and tools to automate onboarding or data preparation tasks.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify new connector requirements, enhancements, and process improvements.
* Provide operational support and knowledge transfer on onboarding processes and standards.
* Generate and analyse onboarding and operational reports to identify trends, risks, and optimisation opportunities.
* Maintain process documentation, configuration notes, and audit evidence in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
* Stay current on IdentityNow capabilities, industry practices, and emerging Identity Governance technologies.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Computer Science or relevant field, or equivalent practical experience in IAM/security operations.
* Hands‑on experience with SailPoint IdentityNow or similar IGA solutions.
* Basic scripting or automation skills (Python, PowerShell, Java, or similar).
* Working knowledge of:

+ Active Directory and LDAP concepts
+ REST APIs, authentication methods, and data integrations
+ CSV‑based data ingestion

* Understanding of identity lifecycle management, access governance, and IAM principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and data‑quality skills.
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding activities in a project‑driven environment.
* Clear communication skills, with confidence engaging both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to follow standards, learn new technologies, and grow within an IAM/IGA operating model.

**Technical Skills**
**Identity & Access Management (IAM) Fundamentals**

* Understanding of joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle processes.
* Familiarity with entitlement models, roles, and access governance concepts.
* Awareness of access certifications and audit requirements.

**SailPoint IdentityNow & Application Integration**

* Experience or exposure to SailPoint IdentityNow or similar IGA platforms.
* Knowledge of onboarding components such as sources, aggregations, schemas, and entitlement discovery.
* Ability to support onboarding via:

+ AD/LDAP connectors
+ CSV connectors
+ REST API / web services integrations

**Technical Foundations**

* Understanding of AD groups, accounts, and permissions.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, data flows, authentication, and connectivity fundamentals.
* Basic networking knowledge (ports, protocols, dependencies).

**Automation & Scripting**

* Ability to adapt or create scripts for data preparation and onboarding automation.
* Comfortable working with structured data formats (CSV, JSON, XML).

**Testing, Data Quality & Operations**

* Experience performing PIT or functional testing activities.
* Strong focus on accuracy, consistency, and identifying data anomalies.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Ability to produce onboarding documents, technical notes, and process guides.
* Experience generating operational or audit‑relevant reports.

**Behavioural Competencies**
**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Works effectively with application owners, IT teams, and business users.
* Confident asking clarifying questions and validating assumptions.
* Able to explain technical concepts in clear, business‑friendly language.

**Attention to Detail**

* Methodical approach to testing, documentation, and data validation.
* Strong focus on quality in compliance‑sensitive environments.

**Analytical Thinking**

* Able to identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and root causes.
* Structured approach to problem‑solving across onboarding and data issues.

**Time Management**

* Capable of prioritising multiple activities in a hybrid project/BAU environment.
* Consistently meets deadlines while maintaining quality standards.

**Collaboration & Teamwork**

* Works effectively within cross‑functional and multicultural teams.
* Open to feedback and eager to learn from senior colleagues.
* Supports continuous improvement and shared team objectives.

**Adaptability & Learning**

* Proactive in learning new tools, connectors, and onboarding patterns.
* Comfortable adapting to evolving processes and technologies.
* Strong interest in identity, security, and governance disciplines.

title: Staff enterprise Application Engineer - Web Apps
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova baut Betriebsteams auf, die sich auf die Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der von allen Geschäftsbereichen genutzten Computing- und Netzwerkinfrastruktur konzentrieren. Diese Teams setzen sich aus hochtalentierten Mitarbeitern zusammen, für die Verfügbarkeit oberste Priorität hat. Der ideale Mitarbeiter hat eine Leidenschaft für die Automatisierung von Prozessen und ist absolut darum bemüht, den Kunden ein einzigartiges Erlebnis zu liefern.
  
  
**Job Description**
Rollen und VerantwortlichkeitenIm Rahmen dieser Rolle werden Sie:
  
  

* Verfügbar, um schnell zu reagieren und kritische Serviceausfälle zu beheben, die die Verbraucher stark beeinträchtigen
* Legt Leistungsbasis und Kapazitätsschwellen fest, korreliert Ereignisse und definiert Überwachungs- und Alarmierungskriterien
* Entwickelt automatisierte Lösungen, um potenzielle Probleme zu beheben, bevor sie zu einer Betriebsunterbrechung führen
* Stellt einen Plan zur Folgenabschätzung und Schadensbegrenzung für Änderungen in der Produktionsumgebung bereit
* Untersucht die Ursache schwerwiegender und systembedingter Ausfälle, ermittelt Korrekturmaßnahmen und wendet sie unternehmensweit an
* Entwickelt Verfügbarkeitsmaßnahmen, die auf die Kundenerfahrung abgestimmt sind, um die Verwendbarkeit wichtiger Dienste genau zu bewerten
* Erstellt Kapazitätsmodelle, um die Transaktionslast mit der Ressourcenleistung zu vergleichen, und nutzt Daten, um die Gesamtsystemkapazität vorherzusagen und die Lastplatzierung zu automatisieren, um Ausfälle zu vermeiden
* Ermittelt Schwellenwerte für alle kritischen Links im Datenpfad, um schnell zu ermitteln, wo Ungleichgewichte zu potenziellen Ausfällen führen können
* Analysiert Fehlerstellen in Diensten, um die Risikostufe und die Lösungsschritte zu modellieren, wenn ein Fehler auftritt.
* Unterstützung beim Einbringen von Architekturverbesserungen in das System, um mögliche Fehlerquellen zu minimieren
* Überwacht und behebt programmgesteuert Konfigurationsveränderungen kritischer Geräte
* Entwickelt Reaktionspläne für potenzielle Fehlerquellen und bewertet die Wirksamkeit bei geplanten Tests
* Führt umfassende Betriebsprüfungen der gesamten Services durch, um Problembereiche zu identifizieren und Aktivitäten zu verfolgen, um Verbesserungen auf allen Ebenen der Architektur voranzutreiben
* Bietet technisches Coaching und Anleitung für Junior-TeamkollegenGrundqualifikationenDiese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung im Enterprise Application Engineering. Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor-Studium in Informatik, den MINT-Hauptfächern (Mathematik, Ingenieurwesen, Naturwissenschaften und Technik) oder vergleichbarer AbschlussGewünschte Eigenschaften
* Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Skripterstellung oder Entwicklung von Software und Diensten für die Cloud Ruby, Python, Go, Java, Node.js, .NET usw.
* Besessen von Verfügbarkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit, während Sie alles proaktiv angehen
* Fundiertes Verständnis von Cloud Computing, einschließlich Sicherheit, Nutzungsszenarien und Infrastrukturgrundlagen
* Hervorragende Kenntnisse gängiger Betriebssysteme (Unix/Linux, Windows)
* Umfassende Kenntnisse der Netzwerkprotokolle (TCP/IP, SNMP, FTP, Syslog, TFTP usw.)
* Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Versionskontrollsystemen wie Git
* Erfahrung in Bereitstellung und Verwaltung von Infrastrukturen in öffentlichen Clouds wie AWS oder Azure
* Erfahrung mit einem automatisierten Konfigurationsmanagementsystem (Terraform, Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Salt usw.)
* Hervorragende Kenntnisse des Netzwerkmanagements (SNMP, MIB)
* Erfahren mit dem Konfigurieren, Anpassen und Erweitern von Überwachungstools (Datadog, Sensu, Grafana, Splunk)
* Hervorragende Kenntnisse in TCP/IP-Netzwerken und Inter-Networking-Technologien (Routing/Switching, Proxy, Firewall, Load Balancing usw.)
* Begeistert, Wege zu finden, um Kunden erfolgreich zu machen
* Fähig, innerhalb eines kleinen Teams gut zu arbeiten und sich auf die schnelle Bereitstellung von Ergebnissen zu konzentrieren
* Leidenschaft für kontinuierliches Lernen und die Fähigkeit, sich schnell anzupassen und in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu gewinnen
* Behaglich darin, Kollegen zu befähigen und andere zu inspirieren, ihr Bestes zu geben
* Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse in einem sich schnell ändernden dynamischen Umfeld zu liefern

title: Senior Business System Support Analyst
description:
**Senior Business Systems Support Analyst (Workday Specialist)**
Location: Bangalore
  
  
**About Mimecast**
Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42,000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions.
  
  
We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance & Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions.
  
  
**AI-First Engineering at Mimecast**
Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
  
  
Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI tooling and AI-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Senior Business Systems Support Analyst with strong Workday expertise to own Workday administration and production support as the core of this role. You will be the go-to specialist for Workday functional and admin support, including business process configuration, security groups, reporting, and troubleshooting, while also extending that support to other business platforms such as NetSuite, Boomi integrations, Partner Portal, and Docusign. This role is ideal for someone with deep hands-on Workday knowledge, strong application support experience, and the ability to manage support tickets, work with cross-functional teams, and support business operations across the wider systems landscape.
  
  
What You Will Work On
  
  
As a Senior Business Systems Support Analyst, you will support day-to-day business operations across key systems and processes, including:
  
  

* Workday Support (Primary Focus): user queries, access/security group requests, business process configuration, condition rules, calculated fields, HR data and reporting issues, workflow and approval errors, and process-related support across Workday.
* Workday Integrations Support: initial triage of Workday integration failures, data load issues, and coordination with technical/HRIS teams for resolution.
* Reporting & Dashboards: support users with Workday reports, dashboards, KPIs, saved views, and operational reporting requirements.
* Other Business Platforms: secondary support across connected platforms, including NetSuite (finance-related user requests, role/access issues, approval workflows, and transaction queries), Boomi integrations (initial investigation of failed syncs and data flow issues), Partner Portal (partner user access, login, and visibility support), and Docusign.
* Ticket & Incident Management: triage, prioritization, SLA-based resolution, escalation handling, documentation, and user communication.
* Process Improvement: identify recurring issues, support gaps, and opportunities to improve user experience and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary functional and administrative point of contact for Workday, supporting HR, Finance, Customer Experience, Partner Operations, and Go-To-Market teams.
* Investigate issues related to Workday business processes, security groups, condition rules, reports, calculated fields, workflows, approval steps, and data visibility.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve Workday-related support tickets within agreed SLA timelines, and support users with how-to queries, troubleshooting, and process guidance.
* Collaborate with Workday admins/HRIS teams, QA, business stakeholders, and technical teams to resolve complex or recurring Workday issues.
* Support Workday system enhancements, feature rollouts, process changes, testing activities, and business adoption.
* Extend support as needed across other business platforms, including NetSuite (access, approvals, finance workflows), Boomi integrations (initial issue analysis and coordination with technical teams), and Partner Portal (access and visibility support).
* Maintain SOPs, FAQs, resolution notes, knowledge articles, and support documentation, with a primary focus on Workday.
* Identify support trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across Workday and other platforms, and recommend improvements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in business systems support, application support, or IT support operations, with a strong focus on Workday.
* Hands-on experience supporting Workday (HCM, Core HR, or related modules) in a production environment — this is a core requirement for the role.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security groups, condition rules, calculated fields, and reporting.
* Experience working with ticketing tools such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of incident management, SLA-based support, prioritization, and escalation handling.
* Ability to troubleshoot user issues, identify root causes, and provide clear resolutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced support environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Good to Have
  
  

* Familiarity with Workday integration tools such as EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, or reporting (RaaS) from a functional support perspective.
* Workday Pro certification (e.g., HCM, Core Compensation, Absence, or Security) or similar Workday certification.
* Experience supporting teams across HR, Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Partner Operations, Support, or Go-To-Market functions.
* Exposure to other business platforms such as NetSuite, Boomi, Partner Portal, ERP systems, or other HRIS/finance platforms.
* General understanding of integrations from a functional support perspective.
* Experience creating SOPs, support documentation, knowledge articles, and user training material.
* Experience supporting UAT, system enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate is a Workday expert first — someone with strong Workday functional and admin knowledge who can own Workday support end-to-end, from business process configuration to security, reporting, and troubleshooting. They should also be comfortable extending that support to other business platforms as needed, understanding business impact, communicating clearly with users, coordinating with technical teams, and contributing to continuous improvement across support operations.
  
  
**Belonging at Mimecast**
Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
  
  
We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
  
  
We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
  
  
*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

title: Senior Support Specialist
description:
**About Copado**
Copado is the leading DevOps platform for Salesforce, revolutionizing how the world's largest organizations achieve success in their Salesforce deployments. Our mission is to accelerate the Salesforce development lifecycle, support digital transformation, and deliver unparalleled value to our customers. We continuously innovate, ensuring our platform meets the evolving needs of Salesforce developers and operations professionals.
  
  
**About The Role**
As part of our Copado Way and RAPID Support initiative, we are revolutionizing customer support by eliminating traditional, slow tiered escalation structures. Why should a customer wait through multiple support tiers to get the best help? At Copado, we ask: "Why wait? Let's get you the best, the fastest."
  
  
In this high-impact, front-line role, you will serve as a
****Senior Support Specialist****
. You will execute all frontline functions of DevOps support — including rapid triage, queue management, directing technical traffic, and troubleshooting — but with senior-level technical depth. You will connect directly with customers live on video/voice within our strict
****10-minute SLA****
, providing immediate, expert-level resolution and ensuring no customer ever sits waiting for technical answers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* 10-Minute SLA & Rapid Live Triage: Act as the first responder for customer queries, meeting a strict 10-minute SLA to connect live (via Google Meet/voice) with human expertise right away.
* Frontline Traffic Control & Ownership: Walk case queues on a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) basis. Take immediate ownership of cases to ensure zero backlog and direct technical traffic efficiently.
* Technical Diagnosis & Problem Solving: Leverage senior-level technical knowledge to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex issues with Salesforce environments, Copado deployments, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and version control.
* The Copado Way Customer Engagement: Manage customer expectations with empathy, maintaining continuous engagement on critical issues and adhering to the "Rule of 3" (what we are doing now, what we are doing next, and when we will do it).

title: HPC Operations Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
As an HPC Operations Engineer at NVIDIA, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the flawless operation of our high-performance computing (HPC) environment. This opportunity is outstanding as you will be part of a world-class team that powers semiconductor build and advanced engineering workflows. By joining us, you will help develop the future of computing while being immersed in an innovative and encouraging environment.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Provide first-line support for HPC users across scheduling, compute, storage, and access-related issues
* Troubleshoot job failures, scheduler errors, resource constraints, and performance concerns, driving issues to resolution or appropriate customer concern
* Perform triage of infrastructure incidents, gathering diagnostics and advancing to subject matter experts (SMEs) when issues extend beyond defined ownership
* Monitor system health, queues, node status, and service availability to ensure stable daily operations
* Complete established operational procedures for maintenance, patching, and configuration updates
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge base articles, and guidelines for users and internal teams
* Contribute to improving team processes by identifying recurring issues and proposing practical workflow refinements

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 2+ years of experience supporting Linux-based production environments
* Solid Linux systems administration fundamentals (RHEL/CentOS and/or Ubuntu)
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically and determine when a customer concern requires attention
* Experience interacting directly with users in a technical support or operations role
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear documentation and procedural guides
* Demonstrated ability to follow established processes while maintaining attention to detail

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Foundational scripting or automation experience (e.g., Bash or Python) sufficient to support routine operational tasks
* Solid understanding of workload schedulers such as LSF, Slurm, or similar systems
* Strong grasp of network computing supporting infrastructure (NFS, automounter, LDAP)
* Experience supporting HPC or large-scale compute environments
* Familiarity with EDA workloads

NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world on our team and our collaborative talent continues to drive NVIDIA's growth. We are seeking creative and independent engineers with real passion for technology!
  
  
Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com
