title: Network Operations Engineer - L2
description:
**Description**
**Company Overview:**
When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM
  
  
Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a
**Network Operations Engineer (L2 – SD-WAN)**
to support and optimize enterprise WAN environments. In this role, you will handle escalated incidents from L1 teams, troubleshoot SD-WAN and network-related issues, and ensure high availability and performance across multi-site environments.
  
  
You should have strong troubleshooting skills, hands-on experience with SD-WAN technologies, and a solid understanding of routing, switching, and network security. Your goal will be to ensure operational stability, proactively identify issues, and drive resolution within SLA timelines.
  
  
**What you’ll do as the Network Operations Engineer (L2):**
The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
  
  

* Handle escalated incidents from L1 support related to SD-WAN environments (Meraki, Aruba, CATO).
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues including underlay/overlay, VPN tunnels (IPSec, GRE), and SD-WAN fabrics.
* Diagnose routing issues (BGP, OSPF, static routes) and application performance degradation.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and drive permanent fixes.
* Monitor SD-WAN infrastructure using tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, and ThousandEyes.
* Analyze alerts, correlate events, and identify service-impacting issues proactively.
* Drive incidents to resolution within SLA timelines and provide timely status updates.
* Implement standard configuration changes including routing policies, QoS, and path selection.
* Execute approved changes through established change management processes.
* Collaborate with L3/architect teams for complex issues and deployments.
* Work with OEM vendors (Cisco TAC, VMware, Fortinet, etc.) and ISPs for critical issues.
* Analyze network performance metrics such as bandwidth utilization, latency, jitter, and packet loss.
* Recommend optimization techniques for network performance and failover strategies.
* Maintain documentation including incident logs, SOPs, runbooks, and Known Error Database (KEDB).
* Participate in incident trend analysis, SLA tracking, MTTR improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**What You Will Bring To The Team**

* 5–6 years of experience in Network Operations / NOC environment.
* Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience with SD-WAN technologies.
* Strong understanding of:

+ TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
+ Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP
+ VPN technologies: IPSec, DMVPN
+ NAT, ACLs, and QoS

* Hands-on experience with SD-WAN platforms (Meraki, Aruba, CATO).
* Experience in monitoring tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios) and packet analysis (Wireshark).
* Proficiency in CLI troubleshooting (Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, F5).
* Experience working with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
* Exposure to enterprise-scale multi-site WAN environments.
* Proven ability to work in a 24x7 support model.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex scenarios.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/IT or equivalent.
* Certifications preferred: CCNA / CCNP.

**Zones Offers a Comprehensive Benefits Package.**
While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.
  
  
At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.”

title: Akeneo PIM & SFCC L2 Support
description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
  
  
**We Are Proud Of**

* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

**The Role**
As a
**Akeneo Support**
, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
**6+ Years**
of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
  
  
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are**

* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)
* Role Responsibilities
* Experience Level: 6+ Years

Primary Technology: Akeneo PIM - hands-on experience in identifying and resolving PIM contribution/data issues
  
  
**Secondary Technology:**
Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFB2C) — hands-on experience in identifying and resolving storefront/data reflection issues
  
  
(Both skills require actual hands-on issue resolution experience, not just conceptual/functional familiarity.)
  
  
**Good to have:**
MuleSoft, Content Management Systems (e.g., Oracle Commerce Business Control Center (BCC)), Oracle SQL
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Engineer for a rotational support team, responsible for hands-on troubleshooting of issues across both Akeneo PIM and Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFB2C) — analyzing problems from the point of PIM data contribution through to final data reflection on the storefront.
**Key Responsibilities**
Hands-on troubleshooting of Akeneo PIM issues — data contribution errors, workflow failures, enrichment/export issues
  
  
Hands-on troubleshooting of SFB2C issues — data ingestion, catalog sync, storefront display/reflection issues
  
  
Analyze end-to-end data flow — from PIM contribution through integration/middleware until data reflects correctly on the SFB2C storefront
  
  
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) across both systems for recurring or complex data issues
  
  
Collaborate with L1/L3 teams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive resolution within SLA
  
  
Participate in 24/7 rotational on-call/shift support
  
  
Document known issues, fixes, and runbooks for the support knowledge base.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
5+ years of overall IT/technical support experience
  
  
Hands-on experience troubleshooting Akeneo PIM issues (catalog management, product enrichment, workflows, data export/import failures)
  
  
Hands-on experience troubleshooting SFB2C issues (storefront data sync, catalog feed issues, display/reflection problems)
  
  
Ability to trace data flow issues end-to-end across PIM → integration/middleware → storefront
  
  
Familiarity with API/integration troubleshooting (REST APIs, connectors, or middleware tools) — assumed relevant, confirm if applicable
  
  
Strong analytical and RCA skills
  
  
Willingness to work 24/7 rotational shifts
  
  
**Good to Have**
Experience with e-commerce data governance or catalog data quality processes
  
  
Exposure to ticketing/ITSM tools (JIRA Service Management, ServiceNow, etc.)
  
  
Basic scripting/SQL knowledge for data validation
  
  
**Soft Skills**
Strong communication skills to interface with client/stakeholder teams
  
  
Ownership mindset for issue resolution until closure
  
  
Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment
  
  
**Scope Of Work**
) L2 Incident Resolution: Manage daily tickets in the support queue, including initial analysis, implementing workarounds, and ensuring timely acknowledgment and resolution within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  
  

* Troubleshooting & Diagnosis: Resolve advanced technical issues escalated from L1 support, conducting in-depth troubleshooting and diagnosing complex problems across SFCC, PWA, and associated commerce applications. This includes analyzing application logs, errors, and alerts.

Client Interaction: Serve as a primary technical contact for clients, providing clear and timely communication on incident status, resolution plans, and technical explanations.
  
  
War Room Leadership: Lead and actively participate in "War Room" situations during critical outages or incidents, coordinating efforts with cross-functional teams (development, QA, L2, DevOps, client) to drive rapid resolution. High reactivity and availability are key during these times.
  
  
On-Call Support: Provide dedicated on-call support outside of standard business hours on a rotational basis to ensure 24/7 coverage for critical incidents. This is not shift-based, but rather dedicated on-call availability.
  
  
Knowledge Management: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, knowledge base articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides to empower L1/L2 teams and improve incident resolution efficiency.
  
  
Collaboration: Work closely with development, QA, and DevOps teams to escalate complex issues, provide insights for permanent fixes, and support new feature deployments or platform upgrades.
  
  
If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.
  
  
Commitment to reaching all kinds of people
  
  
We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
  
  
**The Benefits**
This is a
**Full Time**
position based in
**Bengaluru/Pune/ Ahmedabad /Gurugram in India.**
**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer**

* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.
  
  
**Your application process**
Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.
  
  
⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.
  
  
We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.
  
  
**About Valtech**
Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.
  
  
At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.
  
  
At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.
  
  
Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities.Learn more at betsol.comJob DescriptionThe IT Support Manager leads the IT support operations and owns major incident management end to end. This person keeps day to day support running well, acts as the senior escalation point, and takes command when an incident impacts a client or our agents. This is a working manager role: you lead people and process, and you go deep in the technical detail when an incident demands it.Why this role exists: Support and incident work currently escalates to a single point. This role takes ownership of that work, matures the incident process, and gives the team an escalation path and a leader of its own.Key Duties And ResponsibilitiesIT Support OperationsOwn IT support operations end to end: queue health, escalation, and service quality against SLA and CSAT targets. Working fluency across identity, endpoint, collaboration, and cloud in a multi cloud (AWS and Azure) environment. Experience running or maturing an incident process, ideally in Jira. title: Cloud Service Engineer III
description:
**Job Title: Cloud Service Engineer III**

  
  

**Role Overview**

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Collaboration Technology Engineer, Video & Meeting Rooms, Voice, to support the delivery, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise video, meeting-room, audio-visual and voice services across a global estate. The role is intended for a hands-on technical professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and technical work, rather than an entry-level or developmental position.

  
  

The successful candidate will support Microsoft Teams Rooms, professional AV systems, Zoom, online event management platforms and connected workplace technologies across a global estate. They will work with regional support teams, engineering colleagues and suppliers to deploy, maintain and troubleshoot meeting spaces, executive environments and business-critical collaboration services.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  
* Deploy, commission, maintain and troubleshoot Microsoft Teams Rooms and associated AV systems, from standard rooms through to complex boardrooms, presentation spaces and executive environments.
  
  
* Diagnose issues across Microsoft services, accounts and licensing, Windows/MTR compute, networking, USB, cameras, microphones, DSPs, amplifiers, loudspeakers, displays, video transport and room control.
  
  
* Monitor service health and room performance using Microsoft Teams Admin Centre, Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal, Call Quality Dashboard and relevant vendor management tools.
  
  
* Provide hands-on support for high-visibility meetings, presentations, Town Halls, webinars and online events, including rapid service restoration and practical contingency planning.
  
  
* Own the support and administration of Microsoft Teams Phone, including user enablement, number assignment, calling policies, voice routing, Direct Routing, PSTN connectivity, call queues and auto attendants.
  
  
* Lead or contribute to meeting-room builds, upgrades, technology refreshes and global deployments with internal teams, local technicians, integrators and vendors.
  
  
* Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes.
  
  
* Create and maintain accurate designs, runbooks, system diagrams, procedures, asset information and knowledge articles.
  
  
* Support digital signage and connected collaboration devices, including platforms such as ScreenCloud.
  
  
* Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to users, regional support teams and other engineers.
  

  

**Role Scope & Technical Ownership**

  
  

This is an experienced engineering role with responsibility for independently handling complex work, making sound operational decisions and contributing to the technical direction of collaboration services. The role includes broad technical ownership and continued professional development across:

  

  
* Microsoft Teams Rooms, shared-space devices and associated professional AV systems.
  
  
* Professional AV design principles, audio and video signal flow, DSP configuration, room control and integration with Microsoft Teams and Zoom.
  
  
* Online event management, webinars, Town Halls and business-critical presentation support.
  
  
* Microsoft Teams Phone, including Direct Routing, telecom integration, number management, voice routing and policy configuration.
  
  
* Monitoring, fault isolation and service improvement using Teams analytics, CQD, room-management data and vendor tools.
  
  
* Networking, telephony, identity, endpoint and licensing dependencies underpinning collaboration services.
  
  
* Technical leadership during complex incidents, including deciding when to repair, work around, move a meeting, escalate or engage a specialist.
  
  
* Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
  
  
* Automation using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform and workflow tools to improve support processes and user experience.
  
  
* Mentoring less-experienced technicians and sharing practical knowledge where required.
  

  

**Skills & Experience**
**Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom & Professional AV**

  

  
* Hands-on professional experience deploying, commissioning, maintaining and troubleshooting physical Microsoft Teams Rooms. Logitech room-system experience is strongly preferred.
  
  
* Experience supporting complex meeting rooms, boardrooms, presentation spaces and large-scale online events, not only basic all-in-one rooms.
  
  
* Experience supporting Zoom meetings or Zoom-enabled collaboration environments alongside Microsoft Teams.
  
  
* Practical knowledge of cameras, microphones, loudspeakers, displays, controllers, compute systems, USB signal paths, cabling and physical infrastructure.
  
  
* Understanding of audio signal flow, gain structure, acoustic echo cancellation, mixing and digital signal processing.
  
  
* Experience with one or more AV ecosystems such as Biamp Tesira, Q-SYS, Crestron or Shure IntelliMix.
  
  
* Experience with installed and wireless microphones. Shure wireless, Microflex Wireless or similar conferencing experience is desirable.
  
  
* Understanding of video switching, routing, distribution and scaling, including HDMI interoperability, EDID, HDCP, resolutions and refresh rates.
  
  
* Ability to read AV system drawings and trace signal paths through interconnected devices.
  

  

**Microsoft Collaboration & Voice**

  

  
* Demonstrable experience supporting Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 and enterprise unified communications services.
  
  
* Practical experience administering Microsoft Teams Phone, including Direct Routing, PSTN services, number assignment, voice routing, policies, call queues and auto attendants.
  
  
* Working knowledge of identity, resource accounts, licensing and service dependencies relevant to Teams Phone and Teams Rooms.
  
  
* Experience using Teams Admin Centre, Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal and Call Quality Dashboard.
  

  

**AV Networking & Troubleshooting**

  

  
* Working understanding of IP addressing, VLANs, QoS, PoE and relevant multicast concepts.
  
  
* Basic knowledge of Dante networked audio, HDBaseT and professional AV transport technologies is desirable.
  
  
* Ability to distinguish between faults in AV hardware, networking, Windows/MTR compute, cloud services, accounts, licensing, USB or peripherals.
  
  
* Strong systematic troubleshooting skills, with the ability to restore service first and complete root-cause analysis afterwards.
  
  
* Experience managing incidents through ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform.
  

  

**Communication & Customer Support**

  

  
* Ability to explain technical issues clearly, adapt detail to the audience and provide concise, actionable updates.
  
  
* Comfortable working under time pressure while maintaining sound judgement and a calm, customer-focused approach.
  
  
* Professional written and spoken English suitable for global engineering, support and business teams.
  

  

**Personal Attributes**

  

  
* Accountable and able to own technical issues from initial diagnosis through restoration, escalation and closure.
  
  
* Calm, methodical and decisive during live incidents and mission-critical meetings or events.
  
  
* Confident supporting Microsoft Teams and Zoom meetings, with a practical, service-focused approach to online event management.
  
  
* Curious and committed to keeping knowledge current across collaboration, AV, video, networking and workplace technologies.
  
  
* Confident making recommendations while comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and engaging specialists.
  
  
* Collaborative and non-territorial, with a willingness to help outside an immediate speciality when capable.
  
  
* A clear communicator who listens carefully before proposing solutions.
  
  
* Organised, reliable and detail-oriented, with a commitment to documentation, standards and knowledge transfer.
  
  
* Respectful and constructively challenging, able to question assumptions without undermining colleagues or customers.
  
  
* Comfortable working independently on site while remaining connected to a geographically distributed global team.
  
  
* Focused on service reliability, user experience and practical outcomes.
  

  

**Desired Overall Candidate Profile**

  
  

The ideal candidate will be a strong technical generalist spanning Microsoft Teams Rooms, professional AV, video collaboration, online events and Microsoft collaboration technologies, rather than exclusively an AV technician or exclusively a Microsoft Teams or Unified Communications administrator.

  
  

They do not need expert-level knowledge of every technology. More important is the breadth to understand how technologies interact, isolate the likely problem domain, communicate effectively, recognise the limits of their expertise and engage the right resources when necessary.

  
  

Hands-on meeting-room experience, strong troubleshooting instincts, calm decision-making, effective communication, customer focus and the ability to contribute at an experienced engineering level within a collaborative global team are essential.

  
  

**Desirable Qualifications & Vendor Experience**

  

  
* Relevant Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, networking, telephony or AV certifications.
  
  
* Vendor training or certification from organisations such as Logitech, Biamp, Q-SYS, Crestron, Shure, Zoom or Dante/Audinate.
  
  
* Experience in a large enterprise with a globally distributed meeting-room, video, voice or collaboration estate.
  
  
* Experience working with AV integrators, telecom providers, managed service partners and equipment manufacturers.
  

  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

  
  

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. title: Senior Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
  
  
At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by
**our commitment to empowering our employees around the world**
.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
We are seeking an enthusiastic, personable, and qualified Senior Network Operation Center Engineer (Network Monitoring) to join our amazing team! In this role, you will be part of the Network Services Team (NOC) that provides 24x7 monitoring, operations, and support services.
  
  
The Senior NOC Engineer – Network Monitoring will provide monitoring and troubleshooting of
**network infrastructure devices**
for global customers, supporting LAN/WAN/Firewalls /SD-WAN environments. While responding to Level 1 and 2 service tickets, you will work closely with the team to address complex network problems escalated by NOC engineers. You will be responsible for escalating issues to next-level support and engaging third-party vendors for any
**network or connectivity impairments**
.
  
  
This is an
**onsite**
role.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Resolve level 1 and 2 network support cases, incidents, and work orders associated with routing, switching, WAN, SD-WAN and firewall environments following ECI defined SLAs.
* Set client expectations appropriately throughout the troubleshooting process, ensuring clear communication.
* Resolve incidents and requests from centralized monitoring systems related to, but not limited to the following:
* Alarm validation and alert correlation
* Routing protocol (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) and switching issues (VLAN, STP)
* WAN/MPLS/VPLS/Express Route/Internet circuit issues
* SD-WAN related alerts (tunnel status, edge device health, policy issues)
* Connectivity issues, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization
* Firewall issues (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet — NAT, policies, sessions)
* Wireless network-related issues (controllers, AP connectivity)
* Perform troubleshooting, problem analysis, and isolation of network events in accordance with incident management guidelines.
* Follow ECI change control process for performing changes such as PAN-OS, IOS and Meraki upgrades, configuration changes, and SD-WAN updates during approved maintenance windows.
* Incident Management via ServiceNow tool.
* Follow client escalation procedures and handle customer calls for diagnosing network-related issues.
* Provide timely and accurate end-to-end support via phone, email, and ticketing documentation.
* Accurately document incidents, diagnostics, correlations, and resolutions in the ticketing system.
* Maintain WAN links and engage ISPs and vendors for circuit outages, latency, packet loss or bandwidth issues.
* Escalate outage events and network impairments to appropriate stakeholders when unresolved within SLA timelines.
* Monitor and track scheduled network maintenance activities, analyzing impact and ensuring alignment with approved windows.
* Coordinate with internal teams and respond to communications promptly.
* Act as an escalation point for NOC Engineers on network related issues.
* Produce reports such as RCA, investigation reports, and network health summaries.
* Provide training for new hires in lower roles on network troubleshooting and monitoring.
* Provide feedback for continuous improvement of NOC network operations.
* Ability to work on Major Incident Management (MIM) tickets (P1/P2) for Network related issues.

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology/computer science or related field.
* 5 years of relevant experience in network support & monitoring.
* Minimum 2 years as a NOC Engineer in network operations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical network issues clearly.
* Strong prioritization and customer centric mindset.
* Strong troubleshooting skills: ability to identify and analyze network issues, traffic behavior and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to multitask in a high-volume NOC environment.
* Ability to prioritize tasks in high-pressure situations.
* Highly self-motivated and proactive.
* Willingness to work in 24x7x365 operational environment.

title: Customer Engineer (Implementation & Technical Support)
description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)**
is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Customer Engineer within FICO's Customer Support organization, you'll be the technical bridge between FICO's platform and the customers who depend on it to make better decisions, faster. FICO's mission is to help businesses in more than 100 countries use data, analytics, and decision management technology to improve outcomes, from credit risk to fraud prevention, and in this role you'll help turn that mission into working, reliable solutions in customers' hands. You'll own moderately complex customer engagements end to end, from configuration and integration through deployment and incident response, operating with meaningful autonomy while continuing to build the deeper platform expertise, judgment, and mentoring skills that define more senior Customer Engineers.
  
  
**What You'll Contribute**

* Lead customer engagements involving configuration, integration, environment setup, and solution deployment — working from moderately-defined requirements and using sound judgment to fill in the gaps. Guide customers through onboarding, data integration, and troubleshooting, escalating only when complexity exceeds your scope.
* Contribute to AI-enabled customer solutions, including integrations involving Generative AI, LLM-based capabilities, intelligent automation, and AI/ML workflows. Independently evaluate practical use cases and integration patterns, and help shape how emerging AI capabilities get built into reliable customer solutions.
* Execute technical work to a high bar of quality, security, resilience, scalability, and performance, applying FICO-defined patterns while identifying where they need adapting. Proactively surface technical risks, dependencies, data gaps, and environment constraints — and resolve the more routine ones yourself before they reach senior engineers. Represent Customer Engineering in cross-team syncs with Product Support, Professional Services, and Engineering.
* Build and improve reusable configuration templates, integration patterns, automation, and playbooks used across customer environments. Identify recurring implementation challenges and drive the tooling, documentation, and process improvements that reduce delivery effort for the whole team.
* Develop solution guides, API examples, automation scripts, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks that other engineers rely on. Lead brown-bag sessions, peer reviews, and onboarding support for newer Customer Engineers.
* Take primary ownership of incident response for assigned accounts — assessing severity, driving triage, and resolving moderately complex issues yourself, escalating only the genuinely hard cases. Own clear, timely communication with customers and internal stakeholders throughout, and drive post-incident documentation and lessons-learned.
* Actively mentor and coach newer Customer Engineers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge-sharing, while continuing to seek out feedback from Lead/Senior Customer Engineers to keep growing your own scope.

**What We're Seeking**

* 4+ years of experience in a technical implementation or customer-facing role, with a track record of independently translating ambiguous or partially-defined requirements into working solutions across configuration, integration, and deployment.
* Solid working fluency with enterprise software platforms, APIs, and integrations, plus real hands-on exposure to FICO Platform (or comparable decision management/analytics/fraud platforms) — or the ability to ramp quickly given prior similar experience.
* Demonstrated ability to write solutions, runbooks, and support documentation that others can rely on, and to independently identify risks (data gaps, environment constraints) before they become customer-facing problems.
* Comfortable operating with a good deal of autonomy, communicating clearly with both customers and internal teams, and making sound calls under ambiguity without waiting for step-by-step direction.
* A track record of mentoring or informally guiding less experienced teammates, plus continued curiosity and professionalism in customer-facing situations, even under pressure.

**Our Offer to You**

* A culture and work environment strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make a difference by leveraging your unique strengths.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

title: Senior Igloo Support Specialist
description:
Position Description
  
  
Job Title: Senior Igloo Support Specialist
  
  
The Senior Igloo Support Specialist is responsible for providing advanced functional and technical support for the Igloo Intranet platform. The role acts as the expert escalation point for complex incidents, recurring problems, configuration questions and implementation related topics. The specialist ensures that Igloo remains stable, secure, well governed and aligned with business needs across the organisation.
  
  
In addition to resolving advanced support issues, the role advises IT, business stakeholders and project teams on the right direction for Igloo changes, integrations, authentication, user provisioning, access management, platform improvements and implementation choices. The Senior Igloo Support Specialist contributes to operational excellence by documenting standards, improving support processes and guiding less experienced support colleagues.
  
  

* Key Accountabilities

Advanced Support and Troubleshooting
  
  

* Act as senior escalation point for complex Igloo incidents, access issues, authentication problems, provisioning failures, performance concerns and platform behaviour that cannot be solved by first or second line support.
* Analyse root causes of recurring issues and propose structural improvements to prevent repeated disruption.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across internal IT teams, service desk, infrastructure, identity management, security teams and external vendors where needed.
* Ensure incidents are handled according to agreed priorities, service levels and business impact.

Platform Expertise and Advisory
  
  

* Provide expert advice on Igloo configuration, authentication, user provisioning, access groups, platform structure and governance.
* Advise stakeholders on the best direction for platform changes, improvement initiatives and implementation choices.
* Assess the operational impact, risks and dependencies of proposed changes before implementation.
* Translate business needs into practical and supportable Igloo solutions while ensuring alignment with IT standards and security requirements.

Implementation and Change Support
  
  

* Support Igloo related implementations, enhancements and configuration changes from assessment through testing, deployment and operational handover.
* Prepare implementation guidance, validation steps, rollback considerations and operational acceptance criteria.
* Participate in change management activities and ensure changes are properly documented, communicated and approved.
* Verify that support teams are ready to operate new or changed Igloo functionality after go live.

Knowledge Management and Process Improvement
  
  

* Create and maintain clear support documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles and operational procedures for Igloo support.
* Identify gaps in existing support processes and propose improvements to improve service quality, response time and user experience.
* Coach and guide service desk and application support colleagues in resolving common Igloo issues.
* Contribute to standardisation of ticket handling, escalation routes and communication towards business users.
* Performance Indicators
* Resolution time for complex Igloo incidents and escalations.
* Reduction of recurring Igloo related incidents through effective problem management.
* Quality and completeness of support documentation and knowledge articles.
* Successful implementation of agreed Igloo changes without avoidable disruption.
* Stakeholder satisfaction with advisory support, communication and solution quality.
* Compliance with security, access management and change management standards.
* Communications and Working Relationships

Internal: Service Desk, Application Support, Infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, Security, IT Service Delivery, business stakeholders, key users and project teams.
  
  
External: Igloo vendor support, implementation partners, managed service providers and other technical suppliers involved in authentication, user provisioning, integrations or platform support.
  
  

* Boundaries and Decision Making Authority

The Senior Igloo Support Specialist operates within agreed IT governance, security policies and change management processes. The role is authorised to analyse complex issues, recommend technical or functional solutions, coordinate troubleshooting activities, advise on implementation direction and validate operational readiness. Strategic platform decisions, budget decisions, major architectural changes and supplier contract changes are escalated to the responsible manager or governance body.
  
  

* Qualifications, Experience and Skills
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Management or equivalent working experience.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in application support, digital workplace support, service management or enterprise platform support.
* Strong experience resolving complex incidents and coordinating cross functional troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of digital workplace platforms, Microsoft identity concepts, Active Directory, SSO, user provisioning and access group management.
* Strong understanding of ITIL based incident, problem, change and request management processes.
* Ability to advise stakeholders, explain technical concepts clearly and translate business needs into practical solutions.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Hello, we're IG Group. We are a publicly-traded FTSE250 FinTech company who run mobile, web and desktop platforms that help our clients trade stocks & shares, leveraged products, Futures & Options and Crypto.
  
  
We are ambitious. Over 340,000 people already use our platforms. We're global with offices in 18 countries and products in 16 regions. We're hungry to move faster, ship better product for our customers and grow our user base. * Strong organisational and time management skills
* Fluency in English and Mandarin, written and spoken

Desirable
  
  

* Previous experience with financial products, derivatives, or trading platforms

* Lead and Inspire: Drives trust, alignment, and enthusiasm
* Think Big: Focus on the problems that most impact commercial outcomes
* Champion the client: Understand and prioritise client's needs
* Deliver at pace: Push for fast, sustainable growth;
* Raise the bar: Take ownership, be accountable and share feedback

We believe that diversity is vital to success, it fuels creativity, drives innovation and sets us up for global success. We're committed to building teams with a variety of perspectives and skills to help us realise our vision and strategy, that's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us on this journey. Learn more about our D&I approach here.
  
  
**The Perks**
Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.
  
  
Learn more about the Perks here!

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide onsite and remote Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for employees, executives, and administrative assistants across hardware, software, AI and Microsoft Copilot, identity, connectivity, collaboration, mobile, printing, and meeting-room technologies.
* Deliver discreet, responsive and high-touch support that creates a consistently positive customer experience through active listening, empathy, proactive readiness, clear expectations, timely updates, and follow-through until the customer confirms service is restored.
* Own incidents and requests end to end: assess impact, ask targeted questions, diagnose root cause, implement or coordinate resolution, validate functionality, and document outcomes in the corporate ticketing system.

* Participate in technology rollouts and IT projects by testing solutions, documenting results, communicating impacts, supporting deployment, and helping users adopt new capabilities.
* Create procedures, knowledge articles and training content; coach peers and customers on applications, hardware, AI and Copilot capabilities, responsible-use practices, security requirements and support processes.
* Act as a dependable onsite technology contact for network-connectivity triage, AV equipment, inventory, secure device handling, decommissioning and other operational tasks.
* Participate in a global Follow-the-Sun support model, providing clear cross-regional handovers and coordinating unresolved incidents and requests across time zones. Maintain flexibility for business-critical early morning, evening, weekend or holiday coverage on a rotational basis, and travel between offices or event locations when required.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of experience
* Demonstrated experience providing enterprise IT support, including independently resolving complex end-user technology issues.
* Experience supporting senior executives and administrative assistants with a customer-first, confidential and composed service approach.
* Hands-on experience supporting Windows and Mac environments, mobile platforms, collaboration tools, identity and access services, network connectivity, endpoint management, conferencing and workplace AV.
* Experience with process improvement or project delivery, including testing, rollout support, documentation and user enablement.
* Excellent customer-service, troubleshooting, judgment, organization and communication skills, with the ability to listen actively, set expectations, explain technical steps clearly, and adapt support to customer needs.

* Experience in a multinational life-sciences or other regulated business environment
* Familiarity with enterprise AI assistants such as Microsoft Copilot, including effective prompting, user enablement, troubleshooting and responsible-use principles.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, maintain professionalism under pressure, protect confidential information, recover the customer experience after service disruptions, and build trusted relationships across technical and business teams.

**Productivity, AI & collaboration**
Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot and enterprise AI assistants, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Exchange, Zoom, Webex, Adobe Acrobat
  
  
**Endpoints & mobility**
Windows 11, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, Android, Dell, Microsoft Surface, Intune, JAMF, Apple Business Manager, SCCM

title: Technical Support Engineer II
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara is looking for an experienced
**Technical Support Engineer**
to provide world-class hardware and software support experience to our customers. You will be a part of our
**Tier 2 support team**
within the umbrella of the Global Technical Support organization. You will be responsible for resolving complex customer problems and improving support across all teams. Your work will be collaborative in nature, working together with other support engineers in multiple support locations to serve our customers and troubleshoot complex issues.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background with experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong communication skills. You understand the day-to-day aspects of customer support including managing tickets, building knowledge base articles, and providing product feedback to Engineering and PM teams.

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:**
  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:**
  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You’re energized by our opportunity:**
  The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:**
  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Product Expertise**
  : Become an expert on Samsara’s product portfolio of complete Internet of Things (“IoT”) solutions combining hardware, software, and cloud to bring real-time visibility, analytics, and AI to operations across multiple industries.
* **Technical Troubleshooting**
  : Use your technical knowledge and product expertise to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with medium to high complexity.
* **Responsiveness & Resolution**
  : Respond to customers and resolve their inquiries in a timely and helpful manner with a primary focus on meeting our SLA goals.
* **Documentation**
  : Partner with Enablement to author and maintain customer-facing knowledge base articles to help improve the self-servisablity for our end users.
* **Partnerships**
  : Work closely to develop partnerships with our Engineering and Product teams in order to reproduce bugs and build testbeds as necessary.
* **Feedback Loop**
  : Provide direct feedback to Support Management for product and process improvements to help enhance the customer experience.
* **Team Player**
  : Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a hybrid position based in our Bengaluru office, requiring you to participate in an on-call rotation schedule to triage and manage high-severity issues and outages.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in support, engineering, or other technical roles.
* Fluent English is a must.
* Technical know-how - you’re comfortable interfacing with engineers, translating complex technical concepts into everyday language, and working with SaaS systems.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills coupled with the ability to influence individual contributors and leaders across the company.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, you can speak both Engineer and Human.
* Strong bias for action, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.
* Ability to work in a hyper-growth environment with shifting priorities.
* Willingness to work flexible hours during nights and weekends is preferred.
* We are looking for someone with strong API/Mobile Apps experience

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience with industrial systems, electronics, tinkering with cars or IoT devices, or similar hands-on work is a big plus.
* Trilingual English, Spanish and French is a big plus.
* Strong familiarity with using CRMs like Zendesk or Salesforce.

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Engineer, NOC
description:
**About Consilio**
Consilio's consulting and services teams assist legal departments of multinational corporations and their outside counsel in responding to legal matters, reducing legal spend, minimizing risk, and operating more efficiently. Across eDiscovery, document review, and legal consulting services, Consilio is committed to delivering service excellence globally and applying proven knowledge and technology to help clients solve challenges with lower cost, lower risk, and improved speed.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The NOC Engineer provides first-line operational monitoring and incident response for Consilio's global technology environment. The role monitors infrastructure, networks, servers, storage, applications, and supporting services; validates and triages alerts; executes approved runbooks; and coordinates timely escalation and communication to minimize service disruption. The NOC Engineer contributes to reliable 24x7 operations through disciplined ticket documentation, shift handoffs, monitoring improvement, and collaboration with infrastructure, application, security, and service management teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Continuously monitor the health, availability, performance, and capacity of infrastructure, network, server, storage, cloud, application, and environmental services using approved monitoring and observability platforms.
* Validate, correlate, prioritize, acknowledge, and triage alerts based on business impact, severity, service dependencies, and documented operating procedures.
* Perform first-level troubleshooting and approved remediation, including service or job restarts, basic connectivity checks, log review, health validation, and execution of established runbooks.
* Create and maintain accurate incident and service tickets, including timestamps, affected services, troubleshooting performed, evidence collected, actions taken, escalation details, and final resolution.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact incidents to the correct technical team, vendor, incident commander, or management contact in accordance with defined SLAs and escalation paths.
* Initiate or support major incident bridges, maintain a clear incident timeline, provide concise stakeholder updates, and ensure ownership remains clear through service restoration.
* Complete structured shift handoffs that identify active incidents, degraded services, pending follow-ups, maintenance activities, and operational risks.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal support teams to resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and platform issues.
* Support planned maintenance and change windows by completing readiness checks, monitoring service health, documenting checkpoints, validating recovery, and communicating exceptions.
* Maintain and improve operational documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, monitoring inventories, and service ownership records.
* Assist with monitoring onboarding for new or changed services by validating dashboards, thresholds, routing, dependencies, ownership, and actionable alert content.
* Review false positives, duplicate alerts, missed detections, stale monitors, and recurring noise; recommend threshold, routing, suppression, or runbook improvements to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute incident data and timelines to problem management and post-incident reviews; track assigned corrective actions and knowledge updates to completion.
* Monitor operational performance indicators such as service availability, alert volume, mean time to detect, mean time to acknowledge, mean time to resolve, SLA compliance, and repeat incidents.
* Follow approved access control, data handling, change management, incident management, security, and audit requirements, and promptly escalate suspected security events to the appropriate response team.
* Participate in rotational shifts, weekend or holiday coverage, after-hours maintenance, and on-call support as required by business needs.

**Operational Tools and Technologies**

* Monitoring and observability: Grafana, Prometheus, and Uptime Kuma or comparable platforms.
* Incident alerting and coordination: JSM (Jira service management) or comparable on-call and incident management tools.
* IT service management and documentation: ServiceNow or another ITSM platform; SharePoint or Confluence for knowledge management.
* Operating systems and infrastructure: Windows and Linux fundamentals; server, virtualization, storage, network, and cloud concepts.
* Automation and configuration: Working knowledge of Windows PowerShell; familiarity with YAML syntax, PromQL (Prometheus Query Language) and API-based integrations is desirable.
* Core networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, latency, packet loss, and common connectivity diagnostics.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
* At least one year of experience in NOC, infrastructure operations, Service Now, systems administration, network support, or another 24x7 technical support environment is preferred. Entry-level candidates with relevant internships, labs, or certifications may be considered.
* Foundational understanding of incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge management practices.
* Ability to interpret alerts, dashboards, logs, system events, and basic performance or capacity indicators.
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, follow technical procedures, recognize operational risk, and escalate with complete and accurate context.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise technical updates to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, prioritization, and time management in a high-volume environment with shifting priorities.
* Ability to work independently within established procedures and collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones.
* Ability and willingness to work rotational shifts, weekends, holidays, and scheduled maintenance windows as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, event management, or incident response tools.
* Experience supporting network, Windows, Linux, virtualization, storage, cloud, or enterprise application environments.
* Experience with ITSM ticketing platforms, CMDB concepts, service mapping, and operational knowledge management.
* Experience using PowerShell or another scripting language to automate repetitive operational tasks.
* ITIL Foundation and (or) relevant monitoring-tool certification.
* Experience in a regulated, audited, legal technology, eDiscovery, or globally distributed services environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Operational ownership and accountability
* Analytical troubleshooting and sound judgment
* Calm, structured response during high-impact incidents
* Customer and service orientation
* Clear communication and active listening
* Collaboration across technical teams
* Documentation discipline and attention to detail
* Continuous improvement and learning agility

Client Experience | Listen for the “why." Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  
  
Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect . Welcome diverse views . Partner across geographies, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  
  
Innovation | Always be curious (ABC) . Challenge the status quo . Experiment and fail forward . Build for the future.
  
  
Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you’re proud of.

title: Support Engineer III, AMC, Ad-Tech Solutions
description:
**Description**
Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a new secure, privacy-safe, and dedicated cloud-based environment in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across multiple, pseudonymized data sets to generate insights. Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.
  
  
Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Providing support directly to data analysts who are using Amazon Marketing Cloud.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of software development, or 1+ years of technical support experience
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Customer Engineer
description:
**Nexla, briefly**
Nexla is the data connectivity layer for enterprise AI. Over 1,000 bidirectional connectors give agents real-time access to data and actions over MCP. Nexla's Agentic Data Integration handles high-volume streaming ETL, CDC, and Document ETL. At the core of the platform is Helix, a context engine that continuously learns from metadata, schemas, telemetry, and documentation to give agents accurate context and keep pipelines reliable. Nexla processes over a trillion records a month for enterprises including DoorDash, LiveRamp, LinkedIn, and J&J. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running.
  
  
**Role, briefly**
You would be the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering teams. When a customer’s pipeline breaks, or our Ops team spots something before the customer does, you take it: dig through logs and connectors, find the actual cause, and see it through to a fix. This is not ticket triage. You own the resolution, including the engineering conversations it takes to get there. Python, SQL, and REST APIs are the tools you reach for daily.
  
  
**What you’ll own**

* Technical resolution, end to end. Cases raised by customers and issues surfaced by our Ops and L1 team: first investigation, root cause, and the fix, including driving it with the engineering teams who own the code.
* The investigation itself. Logs, connectors, the Nexla environment, and whatever Python or shell you need to write to see what is actually happening. Written fast, often thrown away.
* What you learn, written down. Known and newly found solutions in the knowledge base so the next person does not start from zero, plus the Global Alerts and visibility updates that go to Sales and Customer Success when an issue reaches past one customer.
* The customer’s experience of all of it. Clear updates across email, tickets, Slack, and calls, and support through product releases.

**The hard problem**
Most of what lands on you will not be a bug in our code. It will be a third-party API that changed without telling anyone, a file that arrived malformed, an auth token that quietly expired, or a schema that moved. Across more than a thousand external systems, each with its own quirks, the hard part is working out which side of the boundary the problem sits on, and proving it, while the customer is waiting and reasonably assumes it is ours.
  
  
**Must-haves**

* 3 to 6 years in data engineering, technical support, or a closely related role.
* Strong Python. You write scripts quickly to debug something or set up an alert, and you are comfortable throwing them away afterwards.
* Solid SQL and hands-on with databases: Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* REST APIs and the authentication around them: OAuth2, SSO, and token-based. You have debugged an auth failure that was not documented anywhere.
* Comfortable on both Linux and Windows, and with data formats including CSV, XML, JSON, and Parquet.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

**Bonus points**

* Apache Airflow.
* You have worked a support or on-call rotation before and know what good looks like.
* Data integration, ETL, or iPaaS background.

**You’ll thrive here if**

* You can write a clear update to a frustrated customer and a clear one to a busy engineer, and you know those are different jobs.
* You like digging. Logs, traces, and the part where it finally makes sense.
* You do not handle a problem half-understood.
* You work well with people who are under pressure, without adding to it.

*One thing to be clear about: this role runs on a shift rotation with weekend coverage shared across the team. We do not run late-night shifts, but your week will not always be Monday to Friday. If that does not fit your life, this is not the right role, and it is better to know now.*
**The practical stuff**
Bengaluru preferred, and we are open to candidates working remotely elsewhere in India. The role runs on a rotational shift pattern with weekend coverage shared across the team. We do not run late-night shifts. Compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title.
  
  
**Worth a look before you apply**

* **What we are building now.**
  MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets.
* **Who uses us, and why.**
  nexla.com/customers
* **The product you would be supporting.**
  docs.nexla.com
* **Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously.**
  Read the founder story
* **Everything else.**
  nexla.com
* Blog
* All open roles

Why Nexla? Why now?
  
  
A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably.
  
  
The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone.
  
  
A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one.
  
  
That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires.
  
  
The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

* Knowledge and experience with both Salesforce Classic and Lightning UI's.

* 1 year experience in Salesforce CPQ cloud would be advantage.
* The team provides support coverage to clients across multiple regions on a 24/5 basis. This role is primarily aligned to US business hours and will participate in an on-call rotation, including occasional weekend support as required.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* Work closely with senior and junior engineers in Service Excellence Team and coordinate the efforts with lead and manager of the team.
* Must interact with global teams in time zones spanning UK, US, APAC areas.
* Resolve customer service issues and thoughtfully handle complex customer service problems.
* Lead customers: expectations and experience in a way that results in high customer satisfaction.
* Assist with the design and delivery of product and other technical training.
* Review support cases for technical and troubleshooting accuracy.
* Define and describe technical standard processes.

* Create/maintain user accounts and interact with end-users to fix and resolve issues and questions.
* Day to day maintenance and support of Salesforce including complex product and pricing rules and guided selling workflows.
* Solve and fix defects for planned releases and production issues, research and find opportunities to apply SFDC standard processes, guidelines to improve system productivity, scaling, and monitoring.
* Understanding of Incident Management, Problem Management processes.

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises.
