title: Associate Field Engineer
description:
Ctrl Alt Experience (CAX) builds immersive experience centres, museums and interactive installations across India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Touch tables, projection, large format displays, interactive exhibits, real time 3D.

We are hiring an Associate Field Engineer: the person who goes to site, makes the system work, and represents CAX while doing it.

We are not looking for someone who already knows our stack. We will teach you AV, media players, networking and real time 3D. What we cannot teach quickly is the ability to think clearly when something is broken and the client is standing next to you.

Location: Bengaluru, with frequent travel to project sites across India and occasional travel to the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Site stays of two to three weeks during installation are normal.

WHAT WE ARE ACTUALLY HIRING FOR

Communication. You will be on site with the client, the contractor and their IT team while our developers are in Bangalore. You need to describe what you are seeing accurately, in writing and on a call, to people who cannot see it. "It is not working" is not a report. "Station 4 shows the Windows desktop, the app does not launch, this started after the power cut last night" is.

Reading a situation. Knowing when something is a five minute fix and when it needs escalating now. Knowing when to tell a client you do not have an answer yet, and when the next update will come. Knowing what matters three hours before a walkthrough and what can wait.

Troubleshooting instinct. Changing one thing at a time. Checking the obvious before the exotic. Swapping in something known to work. Noticing what changed since it last worked. This is a way of thinking, not a list of facts.

Ownership. On site you are often the only CAX person there. Nobody will assign you the next task.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Site surveys and readiness checks: power, network, mounting, access, dimensions

- Install and mount displays, touch tables, media players, PCs, projectors and sensors

- Run, terminate, test and label network and AV cabling

- Configure PCs and media players: OS setup, displays, kiosk mode, startup behaviour, remote access

- Deploy software builds to site machines and verify each station works as specified

- Work through the commissioning checklist station by station and drive the snag list to zero

- Diagnose faults on site and either fix them or report them precisely enough that a remote developer can

- Be the on site point of contact for the client, contractors and their IT team

- Report daily site status with photos and a clear list of what is open

- Maintain handover documentation: device inventory, IP schedules, cable schedules

- Support client walkthroughs, UAT and handover

WHAT YOU NEED

- 1 to 2 years in a hands on technical role with direct customer or user contact: IT support, field service, AV, ELV, electronics, networking, equipment service, retail or hospitality technology. Strong fresh graduates with real hands on project work will be considered

- Clear spoken and written English. You will be talking to enterprise clients and writing reports they read

- Comfortable with Windows, willing to learn macOS. Able to install software, change display settings, find logs

- Basic networking: what an IP address is, static versus DHCP, using ping to check whether something is reachable. You will learn the rest here

- Comfortable with hardware: mounting, cabling, opening things up

- Willing and able to travel, with a valid passport or willing to get one

- Able to work in an active construction or fit out environment, including late nights before a client walkthrough

- Diploma or degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science or similar is useful but not required

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN HERE

- AV systems: signal paths, extenders, matrix switchers, projection setup and alignment, audio

- Media players and digital signage platforms including BrightSign

- On site network configuration: VLANs, switches, static addressing, device connectivity

- Deploying and troubleshooting Unity and Unreal Engine builds

- How a large experiential project is delivered end to end, from survey to handover

WHO THIS SUITS

Someone early in their career who would rather be on site than at a desk. Someone who checks the input selection before escalating, changes one variable at a time, and labels the cables properly because they know who has to fix it at 2am six months from now. Someone who can stand in front of a client and give an accurate status instead of a reassuring one.

If you want to learn this industry from the inside and you are not precious about long days and unglamorous work, this is a good place to start.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Work on some of the most ambitious experiential projects in the region

- A small, senior team. You will learn AV, software and real time 3D from people doing it hands on

- Real ownership of sites early, rather than a slot in a large delivery machine

- A clear path toward Field Engineer and full site ownership

To apply, send your CV and a short note answering this: describe something technical that stopped working, and how you worked out why. It does not have to be from a job.

title: Escalation Engineer - SDWAN
description:

Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

* You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.

title: Premium Support Engineer- Fortify
description:

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. **EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have over 300,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Technology (ET) – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the most affordable possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
The SharePoint Operations Engineer is part of a global SharePoint team in a large, complex, and multinational environment. They have expert knowledge in SharePoint (both Cloud and On-Prem). The individual will be providing Level 3 Operational/Engineering support for areas involving SharePoint Online, with a good understanding of SPO and associated technologies, SharePoint On-Prem, MS Teams, OneDrive for Business, and other M365 services.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* In-depth knowledge of SharePoint, OneDrive and Power platform its features, and related M365 services.
* Experience in installing and configuring SharePoint 2016,2019 & SE.
* Good troubleshooting skills in both sharepoint on-prem (2016/SE) along with SPO.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft PowerShell scripting & automation.
* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of CSOM, MSMQ & Provider Hosted Apps (PHA).
* Intermediate experience with continuous integration systems.
* Understanding of multiple access and authentication models such as NTLM, Kerberos, Claims-based, ADFS, SSL, card services, TMG, UAG, etc

* Detailed understanding of both Classic and Modern SharePoint functionality including Lists, Document Libraries, Pages, Search, Permissions, and Settings
* In-depth support knowledge and experience in providing 24/7 support for SharePoint
* In-depth knowledge in troubleshooting SharePoint end user/client issues.
* In-depth knowledge in SharePoint permissions, webparts, lists, views and any other site level issues.
* Expert knowledge in Incident management, Service requests, Change requests and ServiceNow processes for SP support.
* In-depth knowledge on SharePoint support workflow, level 1, level 2 and level 3. This role is for Level 3 support.
* Capability to help customer to fix the issue and/or create tickets for Microsoft for further troubleshooting.
* In-depth knowledge on PowerShell scripting and automation experience using scripts.
* Desirable - Knowledge in deploying SharePoint solutions, updating automation scripts and html pages.
* Desirable – Knowledge of Power Platform products, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI
* Experience with SCRUM/Agile development process is a plus.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
How your skills and experience will make an impact:
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* History of working credibly within teams and delivering high level of support services on the SharePoint platform
* Proactively anticipates service issues before they occur and able to make recommendations around resolution.
* Proactively monitor outages within a small group or wider group.
* Ability to communicate platform capabilities to customer and provide appropriate recommendations.
* Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications
* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Utilizes all aspects of Emotional Intelligence to navigate the interactions and complexities of the business environment and drive leadership performance in oneself and in others.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* This role does not have a direct supervision responsibility but should proactively own tasks/issues and drive towards resolution independently.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent work experience required
* 2-5 years of experience in support role with at least last 1 year in SharePoint support.

**What We Look For**

* Passionate, committed and determined
* Candidate must be flexible to the demands of the services we provide and any project to which they are assigned. The role may require out of office hours work.
* This role is for 24/7 support and requires working in night shift periodically.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Support Engineer III
description:
**Who We Are**
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
  
  
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Mobile Product Support Engineer to join our Global Technical Support organization. This role is ideal for a technical leader who thrives on solving highly complex mobile-related issues, with a strong focus on customer impact, operational workflows, and regulatory considerations.
  
  
As a Product Support Engineer, Mobile Experience, you will serve as a senior technical escalation owner responsible for leading complex investigations end-to-end across Samsara’s mobile ecosystem. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering and Product teams to drive issue resolution, improve product quality, and influence roadmap decisions that enhance the reliability, compliance, and supportability of Samsara’s mobile applications.
  
  
PSE III is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical depth, ownership, and leadership. You will be expected to set a high bar for technical investigations, mentor and guide L2 engineers, and take ownership of high-impact, multi-customer issues spanning multiple products and regions.
  
  
**You should apply if:**

* You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* Act as primary L3/PSE owner for high‑impact and ambiguous mobile issues (Driver, Fleet, routing and dispatch flows; Asset Maintenance, Connected Workflows, mobile‑to‑cloud data mismatches)
* Lead structured, hypothesis‑driven investigations: define the problem, build reproducible cases, analyze logs and telemetry, and drive to clear root cause and mitigation across mobile clients, backend services, and configuration layers.
* Partner closely with engineering teams (Mobile Experience, Driver Management, Routing & Dispatch, Connected Workflows, Asset Maintenance, Compliance, Product Security) to Assess impact and risk, Prioritize fixes or mitigations, Influence roadmaps for reliability, observability, and operational guardrails.
* Own customer and stakeholder communication for critical issues:

+ Craft clear business impact assessments and timelines,
+ Provide concise, periodic updates to Support, CSMs, Sales, and Product,
+ Deliver customer‑ready narratives and post‑incident summaries suitable for senior audiences in EMEA and globally.

* Proactively identify patterns across customer tickets,and incidents to recommend and drive product and tooling improvements (e.g., improved logging, app‑state capture, diagnostics, in‑app surfaces, guardrails) that reduce future volume and time‑to‑resolution.
* Contribute to and maintain internal runbooks, incident playbooks, and knowledge base content for mobile workflows, ensuring they reflect regional nuances (EMEA regulations, language support, rollout status).
* Mentor and coach L2 engineers, raising the bar on Troubleshooting depth and documentation quality, Reproduction and scoping of issues, Escalation criteria and communication with engineering.
* Advocate for the voice of the customer in discussions with product and engineering, grounded in real data from escalations, patterns, and frontline feedback.
* Analyze device telemetry and fleet-level patterns using internal tools, translating raw data and logs into clear, actionable technical narratives.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
* 8+ years of experience in technical support, solutions engineering, or similar roles working directly with complex SaaS products; at least one major area of depth in mobile applications or fleet/telematics workflows.
* Proven expertise troubleshooting mobile apps across Android and/or iOS, including device/OS constraints, network behavior, authentication flows, app configuration, and data synchronization with backend services.
* Strong debugging and root‑cause analysis skills: able to decompose ambiguous, multi‑system issues, quickly identify high‑leverage logs and signals, and drive toward a clear root cause and mitigation.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with engineering and product: reading JIRA tickets/RFCs, validating hypotheses in lower environments, and influencing prioritization using data and customer impact.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, comfortable presenting complex technical narratives to both engineers and non‑technical stakeholders (CSMs, Sales, customers, leadership) across regions.
* Strong ownership mindset and bias for action—able to lead investigations, make pragmatic decisions under time pressure, and follow through until issues are fully resolved and learnings are captured.
* Demonstrated strong resourcefulness, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
* Adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.
* Experience in direct customer interaction, incident response, and participation in a rotational after-hours/on-call support cadence is essential.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience in the Telematics industry is a plus.
* Data Analysis skills; Databricks, Python, SQL and Tableau.

**Total Rewards**
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
  
  
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
  
  
**Flexible Working**
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
  
  
**Belonging at Samsara**
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
  
  
**Accommodations**
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Authenticity**
We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
  
  
**Fraudulent Employment Offers**
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Junior Site Engineer
description:
Ctrl Alt Experience (CAX) builds immersive experience centres, museums and interactive installations across India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Touch tables, projection, large format displays, real time 3D, interactive exhibits.

We are hiring a Site Engineer to help take these from a packed crate to a working, signed off installation.

This is a site role and an early career one. You will spend most of your time at project sites, learning from people who have done this for years. We are not looking for someone who already knows our stack. We are looking for someone who thinks clearly under pressure and can be trusted in front of a client.

Location: Bengaluru based, with frequent travel to project sites across India and occasional travel to the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Site stays of two to three weeks during installation phases are normal.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

Communication. You will be on site with the client, the main contractor and their IT team while our developers are in Bangalore. You need to describe what you are seeing accurately, in writing and on a call, to people who cannot see it. "It is not working" is not a report. "Station 4 shows the Windows desktop, the app does not launch, this started after the power cut last night" is.

Reading a situation. Knowing when something is a five minute fix and when it is a problem that needs to be escalated now. Knowing when to tell a client you do not have an answer yet, and when the next update will come. Knowing what matters three hours before a client walkthrough and what can wait.

Troubleshooting instinct. Changing one thing at a time. Checking the obvious before the exotic. Swapping in something known to work to narrow down the fault. Noticing what changed since it last worked. This is a way of thinking, not a list of facts, and it is the thing we cannot teach quickly.

Ownership. On site you are often the only CAX person there. Nobody will assign you the next task.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Site surveys and readiness checks: power, network, mounting, access, dimensions

- Install and mount displays, touch tables, media players, PCs, projectors and sensors

- Run, terminate, test and label network and AV cabling

- Set up PCs and media players: OS configuration, displays, kiosk mode, startup behaviour, remote access

- Deploy software builds to site machines and verify each station works as specified

- Work through the commissioning checklist station by station and drive the snag list to zero

- Diagnose faults on site and either fix them or report them precisely enough that a remote developer can

- Report daily site status with photos and a clear list of what is open

- Maintain handover documentation: device inventory, IP schedules, cable schedules

- Support client walkthroughs, UAT and handover

WHAT YOU NEED

- 1 to 2 years of experience in any hands on technical role: IT support, AV, systems integration, ELV, electronics, networking, field service, hardware support. Fresh graduates with real hands on project work will be considered

- Comfortable with Windows, and willing to learn macOS. Able to install software, change display settings, find logs

- Basic networking understanding: what an IP address is, the difference between static and DHCP, how to use ping to check whether something is reachable. You will learn the rest here

- Comfortable opening things up, mounting hardware, running and terminating cable

- Clear written and spoken English. You will be writing site reports the client reads

- Willing and able to travel, with a valid passport or willing to get one

- Able to work in an active construction or fit out environment, including late nights before a client walkthrough

- Diploma or degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science or similar is useful but not required

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN HERE

- AV systems: signal paths, extenders, matrix switchers, projection setup and alignment, audio

- Media players and digital signage platforms including BrightSign

- Network configuration on site: VLANs, switches, static addressing, device connectivity

- Deploying and troubleshooting Unity, Unreal Engine and real time 3D builds

- How a large experiential project actually gets delivered, from survey to handover

WHO THIS SUITS

Someone early in their career who would rather be on site than at a desk. Someone who checks the input selection before escalating, changes one variable at a time, and labels the cables properly because they know who has to fix it at 2am six months from now. Someone who can stand in front of a client and give an accurate status instead of a reassuring one.

If you want to learn this industry from the inside and you are not precious about long days and unglamorous work, this is a good place to start.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Work on some of the most ambitious experiential projects in the region

- A small, senior team. You will learn AV, software and real time 3D from people doing it hands on

- Real ownership of sites early, rather than a slot in a large delivery machine

- A clear path toward Project Engineer and site ownership

* To apply, send your CV and a short note answering this: describe something technical that stopped working, and how you worked out why. It does not have to be from a job.

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior Support Engineer to join our Cloud Customer Support organization. In this role, you will independently investigate and resolve complex cloud and infrastructure challenges, driving customer issues through timely and effective resolution. You will collaborate with Engineering and Operations, mentor fellow engineers, and drive continuous improvements that strengthen service reliability and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
As a Senior Support Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical interface for OCI customers, applying strong technical judgment and structured troubleshooting to challenging production issues. You will work across cloud infrastructure technologies, analyze technical evidence, identify potential causes, and engage the appropriate teams when an issue requires cross-functional expertise.
  
  
You will own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, maintaining clear and proactive communication while balancing technical depth, urgency, and customer impact. Your work may involve complex or multi-technology scenarios where the resolution path is not immediately known, requiring independent investigation, effective technical judgment, and timely collaboration with subject matter experts to drive issues toward resolution.
  
  
Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will contribute to the effectiveness of the broader Support organization by sharing technical knowledge, mentoring engineers, improving troubleshooting practices and documentation, and identifying opportunities to improve support processes and customer outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer issues involving cloud infrastructure and related technologies.
* Own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, driving timely progress while maintaining high standards of technical quality and customer communication.
* Apply structured troubleshooting methodologies using logs, telemetry, diagnostic tools, technical documentation, runbooks, and engineering experience to isolate problems and determine appropriate next steps.
* Troubleshoot across multiple infrastructure technologies, including compute, networking, operating systems, storage, virtualization, and related cloud services.
* Work effectively with customers during complex or business-impacting incidents, providing clear technical guidance, meaningful progress updates, and well-defined next steps.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Service Operations, and other technical teams to investigate cross-service issues, identify product-related issues, and restore customer services.
* Escalate issues appropriately when additional expertise is required while continuing to maintain ownership of the customer experience and support engagement.
* Identify recurring technical and operational issues and contribute recommendations that improve troubleshooting effectiveness, service reliability, support processes, and customer experience.
* Create and improve technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks that enable consistent and efficient issue resolution.
* Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices with peers and mentor less-experienced engineers.
* Contribute to team projects and initiatives that improve support quality, operational efficiency, case handling, and customer outcomes.
* Capture key technical findings and lessons learned from customer incidents to improve organizational knowledge and future troubleshooting effectiveness.
* Continuously develop expertise across OCI services, cloud infrastructure, and technologies relevant to the supported environment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or a related technical filed.
* At least 4 years of relevant technical experience and at least 6 years of overall professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience supporting, operating, administering, or troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, enterprise infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing and infrastructure concepts, with demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving capability.
* Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and drive effective resolution.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as compute, networking, operating systems, storage, and virtualization.
* Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, diagnostic information, and other technical evidence to isolate issues and determine appropriate actions.
* Strong customer orientation and the ability to manage technically challenging customer situations with professionalism, urgency, and empathy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Support, Engineering, Operations, and other technical teams.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, apply that knowledge to customer problems, and share technical knowledge with others.
* Atleast 2 completed cloud certifications from recognized cloud providers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in cloud technical support, infrastructure support, production operations, NOC, SRE, systems engineering, or a comparable technical environment.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), particularly Compute, Storage and Networking.
* Hands-on troubleshooting experience with Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of networking concepts and technologies such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, and network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with virtualization, storage, and distributed cloud infrastructure.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers and managing complex or business-impacting production incidents.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, or operational runbooks.
* Familiarity with scripting, automation, diagnostic tooling, APIs, or software development concepts.
* Understanding of cloud security, operational best practices, and relevant industry security and compliance standards.

**Location & Work Schedule:**

* This is a full-time, permanent position based in Bengaluru, India.
* The role supports a global customer environment and requires flexibility to work assigned shifts, including rotational weekend and holiday coverage, based on business needs.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. The Customer Advocate provides operational ownership for a small portfolio of key global voice customers as part of a shared Customer Advocate model. Each advocate develops a strong understanding of their customers' voice estate, traffic flows, service configuration and operational dependencies, while working closely with the wider team to share knowledge and provide continuity of support.
  
  
The role owns service governance, operational performance and technical escalations, acting as the link between the customer and our technical teams. When service is at risk, the Customer Advocate coordinates the response and provides clear ownership through to resolution.
  
  
Unlike traditional account management or service desk functions, the role brings together customer relationship ownership and technical understanding. The shared model provides customers with clear accountability while also giving them access to the knowledge, experience and resilience of the wider Customer Advocate team.

* Coordinate technical and operational teams during complex incidents and drive issues through to resolution.
* Proactively review service performance, incidents and trends to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Support customer migrations, changes and service improvements from an operational perspective.
* Maintain accurate customer technical documentation and share knowledge across the wider Customer Advocate team.
* Work within a shared Advocate model, providing cross-account support and continuity when other advocates are unavailable.
* Represent the customer's operational priorities internally and ensure customer impact is understood during incidents and changes.

5+yrs experience with below skills
  
  

* Strong customer relationship and communication skills, with confidence managing service and technical escalations.
* Good understanding of Global Managed Voice services and customer call setups, including SIP, GSIP, ICG, PSTN, call routing, numbering, Webex, Genesys, Five9, CCaaS/CaaS and other cloud contact centre solutions.
* Ability to take ownership of complex issues and drive them through to resolution.
* Strong incident and escalation management skills, particularly for business-critical services.
* Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, priorities and actions effectively.
* A proactive approach to identifying service risks, trends and improvement opportunities.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to understand issues and their customer impact.
* Ability to work collaboratively across technical and operational teams to achieve the right customer outcome.
* Confidence communicating technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* A commitment to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across the shared Customer Advocate team.

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
**Description**
*Position at Ziff Davis*
Product Support Specialist
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. You understand user pain points firsthand because you talk to customers every day, and you have the technical and strategic skills to build permanent solutions into our software or service offerings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Customer Service & Advocacy
  
  

* Customer Support Response Management: Handle approximately 200 customer support tickets per week for Dwell brand subscribers, including email tickets and phone support for customer voicemails
* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.
* Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with subscribers, gathering qualitative feedback on product experience.

Product Management
  
  

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing urgent customer fixes with long-term strategic product goals.
* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including Customer Satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Retention/Churn, and Feature Adoption Rates.
* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

Job Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience: 3+ years of combined experience in customer service management, customer success, or technical support, alongside 2+ years in an associate product manager or product-adjacent role.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Customer Empathy: Exceptional listening, patience, and written/verbal communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating frustrated clients.
* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).
* Preferred: basic technical literacy (familiarity with API logs, SQL, or web technologies) to effectively communicate tradeoffs with engineering teams.

**About Dwell**
For over two decades, Dwell has been the definitive voice of modern architecture and design, exploring how smart, intentional design makes everyday life better across print, Dwell.com, and social channels.
  
  
**About Ziff Davis**
Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is focused on seven key verticals – Technology, Connectivity, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. **Job Title : IT Depot Support Engineer**

**Role Summary / Job Purpose**

The IT Depot Support Engineer (L2) is responsible for providing hands-on End User Computing (EUC) support and managing depot operations to ensure high-quality incident resolution, asset accuracy, and smooth IT hardware lifecycle management. The role contributes to operational efficiency, SLA adherence, and customer satisfaction by delivering timely technical support and maintaining compliance with security and data protection standards.

* Provide L1–L2 troubleshooting support for Windows 10/11, macOS, mobile devices, email, VPN, and enterprise applications.

* Manage ticket queues ensuring SLA compliance, accurate documentation, and timely escalations.
* Perform asset check-in/check-out, tagging, staging, configuration, and lifecycle tracking.
* Coordinate vendor warranty claims and RMA processes for faulty equipment.
* Support deployment projects, refresh programs, swap events, and break/fix activities.
* Maintain CMDB accuracy and conduct regular inventory cycle counts and reconciliation.
* Ensure secure data wiping, disposal compliance, and adherence to GDPR and company policies.

**Required Skills**

* Technical Skills:
* Windows & macOS troubleshooting
* Hardware break/fix & imaging tools
* Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi)
* Functional Knowledge:
* IT asset lifecycle management
* SLA management & ticket handling
* GDPR & data security compliance

**Tools / Systems / Technical Knowledge**

* ServiceNow or equivalent ticketing systems
* Asset management / CMDB systems
* Imaging & deployment tools
* Microsoft 365 environment
* Basic networking tools

**Decision-Making Authority**

Authorized to resolve L1–L2 technical incidents independently, prioritize ticket queues, and escalate complex L3 issues. Responsible for asset status updates and operational decisions within defined depot policies.

**Problem-Solving Complexity**

Handles routine to moderately complex technical issues requiring diagnostic skills and structured troubleshooting. Operates within established SOPs with limited ambiguity.

**Stakeholder Management / Influence**

Interacts with end users, depot teams, field engineers, vendors, and service delivery managers. Client-facing at operational level with moderate cross-functional coordination responsibilities.

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Minimum 2+ years of experience in IT support, service desk, desktop engineering, or depot operations with strong exposure to EUC environments and hardware lifecycle management.

title: Staff Technical Support Engineer
description:
Our Purpose
  
  
At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
  
  
**About Us**
SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
  
  
Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
  
  
**What Are We Looking For?**
We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
  
  
As a Staff Technical Support Engineer, you will be tasked with providing responsive, high-quality technical assistance to customers across our global customer base, investigating and resolving technical issues across Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud, networking, and security environments while communicating clearly with customers throughout the troubleshooting process. Technical Support sits on the front line of SentinelOne's commitment to customer outcomes, where every interaction is an opportunity to solve a customer problem, build confidence in SentinelOne, and create knowledge that makes the next customer experience even better. This role is about more than responding to tickets, as great Support Engineers combine technical curiosity, disciplined troubleshooting, customer empathy, strong documentation, and a desire to continuously increase what can be solved at the frontline.
  
  
What Will You Do?
  
  
Primary responsibilities include:
  
  

* Provide customer support through phone, email, chat, and other Support channels, communicating clearly, proactively, and professionally throughout the customer experience.
* Troubleshoot technical issues across SentinelOne products and supported operating environments, gathering the technical information, logs, reproduction steps, and environmental context required to diagnose issues effectively.
* Perform performance tracing and system-level diagnostics, kernel debugging (Mac, Linux), and memory dump and crash analysis.
* Reproduce issues by building scripts, automation, and test environments.
* Own customer cases from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation, meeting established response and resolution service levels and documenting troubleshooting activity and customer interactions clearly and consistently.
* Apply existing knowledge, documentation, diagnostics, and tooling before escalating issues.
* Collaborate with senior Support engineers, escalation specialists, and more specialized technical teams on complex technical problems that require deeper investigation, and with Support, Product, Problem Management, and Principal Engineers on large-scale investigations.
* Identify recurring issues and repeatable solutions, and contribute knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, videos, and other reusable resources to the collective knowledge of the Support organization.
* Provide structured feedback when product usability or supportability improvements could reduce customer effort.
* Continuously expand your technical knowledge of SentinelOne products, operating systems, cybersecurity, and troubleshooting methodologies.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
  
  
Ideal candidates will have:
  
  

* Strong customer orientation and desire to solve technical problems, with strong collaboration skills and a willingness to learn from others.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to systematically investigate technical issues and clearly document findings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple customer issues while maintaining quality and urgency.
* Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux, and an understanding of networking and basic security concepts.
* Mastery of networking protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPsec VPNs, SSL/TLS, and Web proxy, and proficiency in network and API troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, MTR, and Curl.
* The ability to deliver timely, high-quality customer resolutions; maintain strong SLA performance and high customer satisfaction; demonstrate strong case ownership and communication; increase first-line resolution whenever technically appropriate; produce clear, complete, and technically accurate case documentation; reduce avoidable escalations; contribute reusable knowledge that improves Support at scale; and continuously expand technical proficiency.
* Previous technical support or customer-facing technical experience is highly desirable.
* Experience with endpoint security or enterprise security products, or troubleshooting endpoint or server environments, is highly desirable, as is familiarity with cloud platforms or SaaS technologies.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar tools is highly desirable.
* Cybersecurity education, certifications, or professional experience is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?
  
  
AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
  
  
We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
  
  
**Equity & Rewards**

* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

**Time Off & Wellbeing**

* Competitive leave benefits
* Gender-neutral parental leave

**Insurance & Financial Security**

* Medical and insurance benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**Work Perks & Flexibility**

* Global home office allowance
* Internet allowance
* LinkedIn Learning license
* Social Connect program
* Food allowance (Bangalore office)
* Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

**Wellness & Lifestyle**

* Health & wellness benefit

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

title: Sr Associate, Charles River Support
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
ISS NTAM Production Maintenance and Support organization is looking for a Technical Support Analyst who can work under general supervision (but works independently), responsible for day-to-day production support for Asset Management Trading applications. ISS NTAM Production maintenance and Support organization is responsible for 24x7 production support across globe (APAC, EMEA and North America) for various applications of the Asset Management business units at Northern Trust Company.

This role will support our NTAM business and operations partners and clients and will liaise with upstream and downstream application teams.
  
  
The ideal candidates will be self-starters with excellent communication skills and a solid understanding of technology in a financial institution, including trade applications. Some night/weekend may be required from time to time. Candidate should be available Monday – Friday with individual schedules based on coverage rotation/duties.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Candidate will be responsible to provide L1/L2/L3 Support, Monitor and provide support to production streams and provide expert knowledge on all workflow designs for supported applications.
  
  
Candidate should be able to troubleshoot (review, analyze and resolve) production issue including job failure, and able to apply code fix on need basis.
  
  
Candidate should be able to work with Business partners to analyze and resolve their queries and ensure compliance to all controlled processes according to business and IT requirement.
  
  
Develop and maintain professional relationship with all stakeholders within IT and Business teams and provide support.
  
  
Monitor and attend to all alerts and escalate production issues as needed to relevant teams and management.
  
  
Coordinate with various teams including offshore support staff and raise support ticket for all issues, analyze root cause and assist in efficient resolution of all production processes.
  
  
Candidate will be responsible to attend on-call after office hours including weekend to support High and Critical production issue.
  
  
Actively contribute to the supportability of the applications as well as continuous service improvement projects.
  
  
Develop understanding of NT’s systems and products utilizing reference materials and support procedures.
  
  
Present IT in a professional manner, exhibit customer service values in line with NT’s A Approach.
  
  
Adherence to corporate standards at all times.
  
  
**Experience**
6-9 years of experience in a technical business facing (face to face) role within a financial institution or similar preferred.
  
  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, along with a solid technical background are essential as is the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate can explain technical issues in layman’s terms and translate business needs to technology teams and back.
  
  
In depth knowledge of Investment Banking, Trading applications (Charles River IMS) and trading functional knowledge
  
  
Experience in incident management, understanding of ticket workflows and use of escalation. Experience with ServiceNow is beneficial.
  
  
Problem resolution in an analytical and logical manner, to troubleshoot root cause and resolve production incidents.
  
  
Works closely with other technology teams such as Development, Infrastructure and vended software support teams.
  
  
Extensive Knowledge of SQL and PL/SQL
  
  
Extensive Knowledge of Unix/Linux Commands and scripting
  
  
Knowledge of DataStage

Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

The role coordinates closely with Mythic HQ IT on standards, security, infrastructure, tools, and support processes, and follows global IT policies and architecture rather than defining separate local processes. The ideal candidate is a strong, hands-on senior engineer who can manage local vendor relationships and act as the local resource and liaison for India IT needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Site IT Operations & Global Coordination Provide and own day-to-day, on-site IT support for the design center and act as the local point of contact and liaison for IT matters; implement and follow Mythic's global IT policies, asset management processes, and support standards rather than defining separate local processes; coordinate closely with Mythic HQ IT/security teams on standards, security, infrastructure, tools, support processes, audits, and compliance; manage local vendor relationships for hardware, software, networking, and EDA licensing; support and coordinate any additional India-based IT resources as part of the broader Mythic IT function.
2. End-User Computing Support (Must Have) Maintain and troubleshoot Windows, Mac, and Linux laptops/desktops and peripherals for the local design engineering team; manage the full hardware lifecycle including procurement, imaging, patching, warranty, and asset tracking; ensure minimal downtime through proactive monitoring and rapid issue resolution; standardize OS images, software deployment, and security configurations across all three platforms.
3. Identity, Endpoint & Security Administration (Must Have) Administer Mythic's global identity and access standards locally, including single sign-on and multi-factor authentication enrollment, group-based access and local approval of access requests; operate unified endpoint management, disk encryption and patch compliance across the local fleet; execute onboarding and offboarding in line with global joiner, mover and leaver processes; produce the evidence required for customer and third-party security assessments.
4. Networking & Security Configure and maintain networking equipment (switches, routers, firewalls) in coordination with the global IT team; manage and troubleshoot site-to-site VPN connectivity between our sites; administer firewall rules, access policies, and network security configurations; monitor network performance and proactively resolve connectivity issues affecting design workflows.
5. Linux Server, Remote Desktop & Cloud Infrastructure (Must Have) Install, configure, and maintain Linux servers supporting design and compute workloads; own the local remote desktop and virtual workstation experience that the design team depends on, including performance troubleshooting across long-haul links to our other sites; provision and manage cloud computing resources as required by project needs; perform server administration including user management, storage, backups, patching, and performance tuning; support compute farm and job scheduling environments used for EDA workloads where applicable.
6. Containers & Automation (Must Have): Build, run, and maintain container images and container-based build and CI environments used by local engineering teams; troubleshoot containerized workloads; use scripting and configuration management to automate routine administration rather than performing it by hand.
7. EDA Tool Support (Good to Have): Assist with installation, configuration, and licensing of EDA tools on Linux servers and workstations; support license server troubleshooting; coordinate with design teams and EDA vendors during upgrades or issues.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related field
* 8–10 years of progressive IT infrastructure experience, with at least 2–3 years in a senior/lead capacity
* Strong hands-on expertise across Windows, Mac, and Linux desktop support
* Solid Linux server administration skills (installation, configuration, troubleshooting, security hardening) across both major distribution families
* Hands-on experience with Docker and containers, including building and maintaining images and running container-based build or CI environments
* Working knowledge of networking: VPN, firewalls, switches, routing, VLANs
* Experience administering an enterprise identity provider (SSO and MFA) and an MDM or unified endpoint management platform
* Exposure to cloud platforms for compute provisioning
* Experience supporting remote desktop or virtual workstation environments for technical users
* Proven ability to run on-site IT operations for a site/center while working within a central/global IT team, including vendor and stakeholder management
* Excellent communication skills to coordinate with global (US) teams across time zones
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and process-orientation

**Good to Have**

* Experience with EDA tool installation and license management
* Familiarity with compute farm/job scheduler tools
* Certifications such as CCNA, RHCE, Apple Certified support, or cloud certifications
* Experience supporting semiconductor/VLSI design flows
* Scripting skills (Bash, Python) for automation

title: AI Support Engineer
description:
About the Role The Support Engineer is the technical frontline for our enterprise AI platform operations. You will own the support queue, resolve platform configuration and integration issues, and maintain service reliability for a user base composed primarily of experienced software developers and senior technical professionals. The expectation is peer-level technical depth: developers will arrive with specific, well-formed problem statements and expect substantive, technically grounded responses. You will work closely with the Team Lead and Adoption Engineer, and interface directly with AI platform vendor support teams on escalations.

Scope boundary: This role resolves platform operational and integration issues. Questions about AI model behavior, prompt design, RAG implementation, or AI engineering techniques are out of scope and should be directed to the Engineering team. The boundary is platform operations vs. AI engineering practice.

Responsibilities • Own and resolve the AI platform support queue: authentication and SSO failures, IDE and CLI integration issues, proxy and network configuration, API access and rate limit errors, license provisioning problems, and platform-specific behavioral anomalies. • Triage issues accurately — distinguish platform configuration problems (this team's scope) from AI model behavior questions or engineering design questions (Engineering team's scope) and route accordingly. • Diagnose and document recurring platform issues; build a knowledge base of root causes, resolution steps, and workarounds that reduces repeat ticket volume over time. • Escalate complex issues to AI platform vendors (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI) with precise reproduction steps, environment details, and diagnostic data; track to resolution. • Support platform administration tasks: license provisioning and deprovisioning, access audits, SSO configuration changes, and policy enforcement in coordination with the Team Lead. • Partner with the Adoption Engineer to distinguish systemic adoption barriers from discrete support issues; feed patterns into platform evaluation and vendor feedback loops. • Participate in incident reviews for platform outages or service degradation events that impact developer productivity.

Required Qualifications • 3+ years in a technical support, platform operations, or site reliability role supporting a developer or engineering user base — not general IT helpdesk. • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot at the intersection of: SSO/SAML/OIDC, developer CLI tools and IDE extensions, API authentication and rate limiting, proxy and network configuration, and SaaS platform administration. • Able to read API responses, error logs, and network traces independently; comfortable forming and testing hypotheses without step-by-step escalation guidance. • Clear, technically precise written communication; able to manage a support queue with SLA commitments while maintaining quality of response for a demanding technical audience. • Working familiarity with at least one enterprise AI platform at an operational level — sufficient to distinguish a user configuration error from a platform bug.

Preferred Qualifications • Hands-on experience across multiple enterprise AI platforms — Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise — at an integration and troubleshooting depth. • Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms (Okta, Azure AD, PingFederate, Google Identity) and their integration with third-party SaaS tools. • Experience supporting developer toolchains: VS Code extensions, JetBrains plugins, GitHub/GitLab integrations, and CI/CD pipeline tooling. • Background supporting large-scale developer environments (1,000+ engineers) where support quality directly impacts engineering velocity.

As our Markets business scales in volume, complexity, and transaction throughput, the integrity of digital asset custody, settlement accuracy, and liquidity availability become mission-critical. title: AIX Development Support Intern
description:
**Introduction**
As an AIX Development Support Intern at IBM, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and work with technologies supporting IBM Power systems and the AIX operating system. You will apply your academic knowledge of operating systems, C programming, networking, and system software to real-world technical problems. Through hands-on learning, laboratory exercises, technical projects, and collaboration with experienced engineers, you will develop skills in system troubleshooting, debugging, problem determination, and root-cause analysis.
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to explore operating-system internals, virtualization, networking, system-level programming, and debugging, while learning how enterprise software issues are analyzed and resolved in a development-support environment.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an AIX Development Support Intern, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop skills in troubleshooting issues related to the AIX operating system and its components. You will work with experienced AIX Development Support professionals to learn problem determination, debugging, and root-cause analysis techniques.
  
  
You will be part of the AIX Development Support Organization (DSO), working in the AIX operating system environment and gaining exposure to IBM Power systems, virtualization technologies, operating-system internals, networking, and system-level debugging. The AIX Development Support team works closely with the AIX Development organization and Power AIX customers to analyze and resolve complex operating-system issues. As an intern, you will have opportunities to contribute to problem investigation, reproduce issues in laboratory environments, analyze system behavior and diagnostic data, and learn how issues can be traced to their underlying code or system component. You will also gain exposure to technical documentation, debugging tools, and collaboration with development and support teams while developing your technical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
**Preferred Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Foundational knowledge of operating-system concepts, with familiarity with AIX, Linux, or UNIX environments.
* Knowledge of C programming, including data structures, advanced data structures, compilation stages, and basic system-level programming concepts.
* Familiarity with UNIX/Linux commands and shell scripting.
* Understanding of operating-system internals, including process management, memory management, file systems, I/O, inter-process communication (IPC), synchronization, shared memory, semaphores, mutexes, and Process Control Blocks (PCB).
* Familiarity with socket programming and basic client-server communication concepts.
* Familiarity with binary, octal, hexadecimal, and ASCII representations, including basic concepts of interpreting and decoding data packets.
* Awareness of system troubleshooting, crash analysis, and operating-system boot processes.
* Understanding of Virtual Memory Management (VMM) concepts, including virtual and physical memory, virtual addressing, memory management, memory leaks, DMA, process states, CPU scheduling, page tables, page-frame mapping, and page replacement concepts.
* Foundational knowledge of networking concepts and commonly used network protocols.
* Understanding of the TCP/IP protocol stack and basic device-driver concepts.
* Familiarity with system and network analysis tools such as tcpdump, iptrace, Wireshark, and KDB, with an understanding of their basic purpose.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving aptitude, with an interest in operating systems, networking, system software, and low-level technologies.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to understand and articulate technical concepts clearly.
* Eagerness to learn new technologies, develop practical skills, and apply academic knowledge to real-world technical problems.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Exposure to AIX, VIOS, IBM Power systems, or Power virtualization technologies through coursework, projects, laboratory exercises, or self-learning.
* Familiarity with AIX file systems, backup concepts, system cloning, and mksysb.
* Exposure to AIX/VIOS networking concepts, including EtherChannel, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA), SR-IOV, vNIC, and Virtual Ethernet Adapter (VEA).
* Familiarity with HMC concepts and its GUI/CLI interfaces.
* Exposure to server architecture and virtualization concepts, including the interaction between operating systems, hardware, and virtualized environments.
* Familiarity with TCP/IP protocols, RFC concepts, IPv4/IPv6, routing, broadcasting, and multicasting.
* Familiarity with commonly used networking protocols including TCP, UDP, ICMP, and ARP.
* Exposure to Wireshark or similar packet-analysis tools, with an interest in understanding packet flows and basic network troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with debugging and system-analysis tools such as GDB, KDB, truss, trace, and LMT Analyzer through coursework, projects, or laboratory exercises.
* Exposure to switching concepts, VLANs, and basic network configuration.
* Exposure to advanced C programming, shell scripting, or Perl scripting through academic or personal projects.
* Academic or project exposure to setting up laboratory environments, reproducing technical problems, troubleshooting, and validating solutions.
* Exposure to Linux/AIX laboratory environments, virtualization platforms, or system-level projects.
* Participation in academic projects, technical competitions, open-source projects, or self-learning activities related to operating systems, networking, C programming, virtualization, or system software.
* Demonstrated curiosity and interest in debugging technical problems, understanding system behavior, and learning low-level operating-system and networking concepts.

SafeBreach is seeking a

**👋 Who We Are**
SafeBreach is the only Adversarial Exposure Validation solution built for large, complex environments—validating defenses before and after a breach. With proactive control testing (Validate), live post-breach propagation (Propagate), and an AI engine that accelerates analysis and remediation, we simulate attacker behavior to show not just where defenses could fail, but exactly how a threat actor could move and their potential impact. Powered by SafeBreach Labs and the industry's largest threat library, we help teams continuously validate and strengthen their cyber resilience.
  
  
**🚀 THE IMPACT YOU WILL HAVE**

* Act as the technical point of contact for SafeBreach Support
* Set-up/create customer environments in the support lab
* Replicate customer environments to troubleshoot and resolve problems, file defects, etc
* Manage high-profile escalations to resolution, working with internal and field personnel
* Deliver product training to support staff and others as required
* Resolve customer escalations and drive process/policy improvements through root cause analysis.
* Build strong relationships with partner teams: engineering, technical operations, product management, and quality assurance.

**🧬 What Sets You Apart**

* Professional Experience. 2–5 years in technical support (Tier 2/3) or a similar customer-facing technical role in cybersecurity or SaaS
* Security Fundamentals & Tools. Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and familiarity with detection engineering concepts. Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: SIEM, EDR, firewalls, threat intelligence platforms, or vulnerability management
* Infrastructure Knowledge. Comfortable troubleshooting across cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises systems (Windows, macOS, Linux)
* Troubleshooting Skills. Methodical approach to problem-solving, including log analysis and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, proxies, certificates)
* Case-Queue Experience. Experience with case management and ticketing tools (e.g., Salesforce, Jira)
* Customer Focus. Experience supporting enterprise customers, with a commitment to clear, timely, and accurate case communication

💥
**EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE**

* Deep expertise in offensive security methodologies: BAS, pentesting, threat hunting, red teaming, CTEM, or AEV
* Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages to customize and extend SafeBreach capabilities
* Experience working in a startup or rapidly scaling company environment
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, CEH, or similar security credentials

**😎 What's In It For You**
Our offering includes a competitive selection of health & wellness policies (health, dental, vision, and more), highly competitive salary, 100% remote work flexibility, flexible time off, and excellent growth opportunities.

We view interviewing as a two-way street. We want you to interview us just as much as we interview you! (Avg. timeline: 21 days)
  
  
**Step 1: The Intro (15 min)**

**Step 2: The Vision (45 min)**
Connect with your future Manager to discuss the role, the challenges, and how you can make an impact.
  
  
**Step 3: The Squad (35-60 min each)**
Meet the people you’ll be in the trenches with—your peers and cross-functional partners. You will be evaluated on your technical skills, and you will be able to ask them anything!
  
  
**Step 4: The Big Picture (45 min)**
Discussion with our People team to ensure our values and long-term goals align with yours.
  
  
**Step 5: The Offer**
If the vibe is right, we make it official!

* Support system maintenance activities including configuration updates, access audits, and operational readiness tasks.

**Reporting, Dashboards & Operational Insights**

* Create, maintain, and enhance utilization reports and dashboards for HR, AI, and Compliance platforms.
