* Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and translate them into actionable, repeatable outputs.

**Process Documentation & UAT Support**

* Develop and maintain process documentation, workflows, and operating models aligned to system capabilities.
* Prepare for and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test case creation, execution support, defect tracking, and validation of fixes.
* Ensure documentation remains current as systems, integrations, and policies evolve.
* Support go-lives and releases by validating readiness across procedures, access, and training materials.

**Training & Enablement**

* Create and maintain training materials, job aids, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for system users and administrators.
* Support user onboarding and adoption through clear, consistent, and accessible enablement content.
* Partner with HR, Compliance, and IT teams to ensure training accurately reflects system behavior and policy requirements.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with HR Systems, Compliance, Legal, AI governance, IT, and vendor partners to support operational execution.
* Participate in compliance- and AI-related initiatives by providing system expertise, reporting, and operational support.
* Act as a reliable execution partner to ensure projects move forward without overloading onshore resources.

**Business Impact / Expected Deliverables**

* Accelerates delivery of critical compliance and AI initiatives through strong operational execution and administrative support.
* Ensures process documentation, SOPs, and training materials remain current and aligned with system changes.
* Reduces risk of operational bottlenecks, single points of failure, and team burnout by providing consistent, scalable support.
* Improves visibility into system utilization and performance through reliable dashboards and reporting.

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
* Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (not required).
* 4-7 years of experience supporting enterprise HR, Compliance, or business systems in an administrative or operations role.
* Proven experience with ServiceNow configuration and development
* Proven experience performing system administration tasks, including user provisioning and access management.
* Experience creating reports, dashboards, and operational metrics for leadership or business users.
* Strong documentation skills, including creation of SOPs, process flows, training materials, and job aids.
* Experience supporting UAT, testing cycles, or system releases.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach.
* Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships.
* Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends.
* Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience supporting compliance-focused or highly regulated systems.
* Familiarity with HR technology ecosystems and cross-system integrations.
* Experience supporting AI-enabled tools or platforms within a governance framework.
* Comfort working with data visualization or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, system-native reporting).
* Experience working with vendors and IT partners to resolve system issues.

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.

**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. **Why join?**

* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.

title: IT Service Desk Technician
description:
Role: IT Service Desk Technician

Position Summary

We are looking for a motivated and experienced full-time IT Service Desk Technician who is looking to take the next step in their career in a dynamic and international business setting.

Your role will be to resolve IT issues of varying complexities, across a range of IT systems for domestic and international remote staff. You will be working collaboratively within a global IT team and will be reporting directly to the Service Desk Manager.

You will need to take ownership and full responsibility for logging and handling your work, as well as monitoring the business systems and resolving issues.

Key job responsibilities include, but and not limited to:

● Providing 1st line IT support for incidents and service requests in person or via remote support tools.

● Taking ownership and a proactive approach to ensure all incidents or service requests are resolved or closed within the agreed upon SLAs.

● Recording, tracking, and documenting the lifecycle of an incident or request within the ITSM system following ITIL best practices.

● Fixing causes, not just symptoms, and doing what is necessary to prevent problems from recurring.

● Investigating and implementing ways of reducing calls to the Service Desk.

● Managing end-user accounts, permissions, and access rights to various technology platforms while ensuring that all InfoSec, Compliance, SOX and GDPR requirements are consistently observed.

● Providing 1st line Microsoft 365 support.

● Supporting KI’s business systems and 3rd party applications.

● Contributing to our knowledge base and writing support documentation.

● Working effectively and productively within a team and with vendors as required.

● Setting up and configuring new hardware to meet business requirements.

● Monitoring and maintaining network equipment, servers, VOIP telephony systems and AV technologies.

● Keeping peers and the Service Desk Manager informed of trends, significant problems, and unexpected delays.

● Recognizing when to escalate IT issues to 2nd line support or other IT groups.

● Following the ITIL Framework when managing an Incident life cycle.

● Supporting the collection and administration of faulty devices with 3rd party supplier, while monitoring the process from collection to return of device.

● Carrying out maintenance on AV technologies used in our meeting rooms and supporting meetings when and where required.

● Delivering results set against individual and team KPIs.

Minimum Experience and Skills

● Good written and verbal communication skills.

● Strong problem-solving skills.

● Self-motivated and able to work effectively within a team.

● Strong multi-tasking skills.

● Proven customer service skills within a diverse population.

● Demonstrated ability to learn new systems and technologies.

● Ability to analyse, understand and effectively communicate deep technical materials.

● Working knowledge of SOX, GDPR, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 regulations and standards.

● Working knowledge of ITIL’s ITSM framework.

● Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, on prem & Azure AD, network technologies, and VOIP systems.

● Sound knowledge of Win 11, Mac OS, MS Office productivity suite, and general desk support.

● Working Knowledge of mobile OS e.g. Android/iOS and Mobile Deployment Management.

● Ability to operate effectively and professionally under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

● ITIL V4 Foundation Certification.

● Microsoft Azure or any Microsoft 365 Certification.

● CompTIA A+.

● Experience with network Troubleshooting, routers, switches, WAP’s, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, Firewalls, WAN, and LAN.

* Compliance with agreed SLAs and ticket resolution timelines.
* Availability and reliability of factory IT infrastructure.
* Timely resolution of network, wireless and CCTV incidents.
* Effective support for Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and end-user computing.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and operational downtime.
* User satisfaction and adherence to IT service management processes.

**Job Description:**
The Senior Service Desk Analyst acts as a technical escalation point and team anchor within the IT Service Desk, handling incidents beyond first-line scope, and driving process and quality improvements. This role combines hands-on technical resolution, ensuring SLA adherence, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across the service desk function.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a senior point of contact and technical escalation path for complex or high-priority IT incidents and service requests received via phone, email, chat, or ticketing systems.
* Review, re-prioritize, and reassign tickets in the ITSM tool to ensure accurate categorization and SLA compliance across the queue, not just individual tickets.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting for hardware, software, network, and application issues that junior analysts have been unable to resolve at first level.
* Own and resolve complex technical issues, including:
* Advanced account, identity, and access management issues (Okta)
* Microsoft 365 administration-level support / Google Workspace Administration (mailbox, licensing, and configuration issues)
* VPN, network connectivity, and remote access troubleshooting
* Endpoint, OS, and peripheral device issues requiring deeper diagnostics
* Email, collaboration tool, and application integration issues(Slack, Zoom)
* Act as the primary escalation contact between the service desk and Level 2/3 support teams, ensuring context is properly handed off and following up to closure.
* Monitor ticket queues and SLA dashboards proactively, intervening on at-risk tickets and backlog before breaches occur.
* Author, review, and maintain knowledge base articles and SOPs; audit team-submitted articles for accuracy and completeness.
* Provide on-the-job training to junior and mid-level Service Desk Analysts, including shadowing and quality reviews of their tickets/calls.
* Lead or actively participate in shift handovers, team huddles, and stakeholder meetings, representing the service desk's operational status.
* Take ownership of key service desk performance metrics like First Contact Resolution (FCR), SLA compliance, Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Average Resolution Time (ART), and lifecycle management.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives: identifying recurring issues, proposing automation/self-service opportunities, and contributing to process documentation.
* Support major incident management by coordinating communication and technical response until Level 2/3 teams take over.
* Assist with onboarding, training material development, and coverage planning for the shift roster.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk, or Technical Support role demonstrated experience handling escalations or guiding analysts
* Knowledge of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing systems.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Customer-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills.

**Shift Pattern:**
U.S. Business Hours / Rotational Shifts (Flexible based on business requirements)
  
  
Role is onsite and expected to work from office for 5 days

**Job Summary**
Job Summary As a Senior Technical Support Engineer for Focused Services - XDR, you will be a dedicated partner to our customers, ensuring their success with our Cortex XDR products. You will leverage your deep technical expertise to proactively mitigate risks, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide personalized support as a virtual member of their team. This role is pivotal in managing escalations, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with internal teams to drive swift resolutions and enhance the customer experience. Key Responsibilities Respond to and triage user-reported issues via ticketing system, phone, or remote sessions, adhering to established Service Level Agreements. Collaborate effectively with development and other teams to identify fault areas (code, environment, configuration) and drive the implementation of fixes. Facilitate comprehensive root cause investigations and manage the implementation of corrective and preventative measures to prevent future occurrences. Proactively engage with customers to address Cortex XDR technical needs and provide escalation management for enterprise deployment issues. Document all actions and solutions meticulously in tracking systems and account-specific repositories to ensure alignment and knowledge sharing. Reproduce customer issues in a lab environment to assist developers in resolving technical challenges and provide timely product feedback.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you’ll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You’ll be embedded in the Engineering department, working directly with customers as they hit edge cases, digging into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source. You’ll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so that customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you’ll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS), and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.
  
  
**Some Examples Of Our Projects**

* A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues
* A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting
* A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns
* A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com

**What You’ll Do**

* Support a mix of Self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS) customers, resolving complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.
* Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmap, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.
* Investigate and troubleshoot issues using Linux systems administration tools, logs, and the GitLab codebase, creating merge requests when needed to resolve customer problems.
* Create and update clear, reusable documentation and support content based on real customer interactions and edge cases.
* Partner with Support team members through pairing sessions and cross-team collaborations (such as Support Stable Counterparts) to solve challenging cases and share knowledge.
* Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations (daytime only), providing emergency support for Self-managed and SaaS customers and coordinating incident communications with the SaaS Production team.
* Contribute to improving support processes, tools, and automation within our issue tracker to make troubleshooting and case handling more efficient.
* Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience managing customer-facing technical cases from first contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, and resolution.
* Strong Linux systems administration knowledge comparable to LFCE or RHCE certification.
* Ability to use scripting languages such as Ruby or Bash and work with MVC frameworks such as Ruby on Rails.
* Hands-on experience with Git and CI/CD in production or customer environments.
* Skill in writing clear, accurate support content and documentation based on real customer scenarios.
* Ability to explain complex technical topics to people with varying levels of technical expertise.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and Serverless, and how different GitLab implementations operate and impact customers.
* Openness to learning, collaborating across teams, and applying transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.

**About The Team**
We are a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across AMER, EMEA, and APAC who help GitLab customers keep their Self-managed and GitLab.com environments running smoothly. We own front-line technical support, working on support tickets, digging into code and logs to diagnose complex issues, and collaborating closely through pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack to stay connected while working asynchronously. We are trusted to structure our shifts in a way that supports our personal lives while ensuring customer needs are met. Thanks to GitLab’s transparency value, you can see what we are working on and how we operate on our Support Team page.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: IH Salesforce Production Support - Cigna Healthcare
description:
**Technical Support Analyst**
**Position Information**

* Job Title: Technical Support Analyst
* Function: Production Support / Salesforce Support
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Location: Bangalore
* Reports To: Cloud Support Manager

**Role Purpose**
The Technical Support Analyst is a hands-on member of the Production Support team, responsible for supporting and maintaining Salesforce applications used across Cigna International Health.
  
  
The primary focus of the role is day-to-day Salesforce administration across
**Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud**
, including user lifecycle management, access and permissions, declarative configuration, data maintenance, reporting, and operational support. The role also investigates and manages application incidents through ServiceNow, working with business users, technical teams, and senior support colleagues to restore service, meet agreed service levels, and provide a high standard of customer support.
  
  
The successful candidate will work with appropriate autonomy, prioritize their workload, and deliver accurate, controlled, and well-documented outcomes. They will escalate work requiring development, architecture decisions, elevated privileges, or higher-risk production changes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Salesforce Administration and User Access
  
  

* Create, update, activate, freeze, and deactivate Salesforce users in accordance with approved access requests and user lifecycle procedures.
* Maintain user access through profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, public groups, and other approved access mechanisms.
* Investigate and resolve common login, visibility, permission, object-access, field-access, and record-access issues.
* Maintain access hygiene by reviewing assignments, identifying inappropriate or obsolete access, and supporting periodic access reviews.
* Apply least-privilege and segregation-of-duties principles, escalating privileged, unusual, or high-risk access requests to the appropriate security, identity-management, or senior Salesforce resource.
* Maintain clear evidence of approvals and completed access changes where required for audit or control purposes.

Declarative Configuration and Platform Maintenance
  
  

* Configure and maintain Salesforce using approved declarative, “clicks-not-code” capabilities.
* Support routine changes to standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, queues, assignment rules, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and other administrative configurations.
* Assist with basic Salesforce Flow configuration and troubleshooting where the requirement is within the role’s approved administrative scope.
* Perform configuration and operational support across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
* Validate changes in an appropriate lower environment before production implementation, following established testing, approval, deployment, and post-implementation validation procedures.
* Monitor the impact of routine Salesforce releases and support low-risk readiness or validation activities.
* Escalate requirements involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, complex integrations, architecture changes, or development-intensive solutions.

Data Maintenance and Reporting
  
  

* Maintain Salesforce data accurately and securely, including approved record creation, updates, corrections, ownership changes, and controlled bulk activities.
* Support data imports, exports, and mass updates using authorized tools and documented procedures.
* Complete appropriate validation and reconciliation before and after data changes.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, obsolete, or inconsistent information and work with data owners to improve data quality.
* Create and maintain standard reports and dashboards to support operational and business requirements.
* Protect sensitive information and avoid unapproved data deletion, extraction, or other high-risk data activity.
* Maintain traceable records of approvals, test results, data files, outcomes, and rollback information where required.

Incident and Application Support
  
  

* Monitor and manage incidents and support requests assigned through ServiceNow.
* Review ticket information, confirm the reported symptoms and business impact, and gather any additional information required to investigate the issue.
* Validate that the correct application or configuration item is recorded and ensure the incident is assigned to the appropriate support group.
* Investigate common Salesforce and supported application issues, including user access, permissions, configuration, data, workflow, and functional errors.
* Reproduce issues where appropriate, review available documentation and known issues, and identify a resolution, workaround, or appropriate escalation path.
* Maintain accurate ticket states and remain aware of applicable responses and resolution of SLAs.
* Record meaningful internal investigation details, actions taken, dependencies, and escalation of information in work notes.
* Provide clear and timely customer updates through the appropriate customer-visible ServiceNow fields.
* Reassign incidents promptly when another team is required, documenting the reason for reassignment.
* Complete accurate resolution information and clear resolution notes before resolving a ticket.
* Escalate major, high-impact, recurring, security-related, or technically complex incidents in accordance with established support procedures.

Documentation, Automation, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone activities that may be suitable for controlled automation.
* Contribute to the design, testing, documentation, and ongoing monitoring of low-risk automation solutions.
* Recommend improvements that increase support efficiency, data quality, customer experience, control effectiveness, or service reliability.

Collaboration and Customer Service
  
  

* Work effectively with geographically distributed colleagues across business, production support, identity and access management, security, product, engineering, and development teams.
* Translate technical issues into clear, practical information for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned work with appropriate autonomy, balancing priorities, risk, business impact, and SLA commitments.
* Provide accurate, professional, and customer-focused communication throughout requests and incidents.
* Seek guidance when requirements are unclear and escalate promptly when an issue exceeds the role’s authority or technical scope.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Minimum of three years of professional experience working as a Salesforce Administrator.
* Practical administration experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Experience Cloud
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce user provisioning, deactivation, access management, profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, and public groups.

* Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, ticket records, change evidence, and audit trails.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to security, data protection, operational risk, and change control.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritize assigned work, work independently within defined procedures, and recognize when escalation is required.

**Preferred Or Desirable Skills**

* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including incident handling, work notes, customer updates, resolution information, and SLA awareness.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
* Experience supporting Salesforce in a health insurance, healthcare or other regulated environment.
* Experience with access reviews, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties controls, or identity and access management processes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, Jira, Confluence, knowledge management, release-readiness activities, user acceptance testing, and smoke testing.
* Exposure to application-monitoring or log-analysis tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate recurring administrative or support activities.

Behaviors and Competencies
  
  

* Customer focused: Provides responsive, accurate, and professional support.
* Team player: Collaborates openly across geographic, business, and technical boundaries.
* Problem solver: Investigates methodically and uses evidence to reach sound conclusions.
* Autonomous: Takes ownership of assigned work while escalating appropriately.
* Process minded: Follows documented controls and maintains complete, traceable records.
* Security and risk aware: Protects access, data, system stability, and audit integrity.
* Curious and adaptable: Learns unfamiliar applications and business processes confidently.
* Continuous-improvement driven: Challenges inefficient manual processes and proposes safe, practical improvements.
* Clear communicator: Explains technical matters effectively to different audiences.
* Dependable: Manages priorities and delivers work to agreed time and quality expectations.

Scope of the Role
  
  
This is primarily a
**Salesforce administration and production-support position**
, not a Salesforce developer or solution-architect role. The analyst is expected to complete routine declarative configuration and operational support independently within approved procedures. Custom development, complex integration work, architecture decisions, privileged actions, and high-risk production changes must be referred to the appropriate senior administrator, engineering, architecture, security, or development team.
  
  
Measures of Success
  
  
**Success In The Position Will Be Demonstrated Through**

* Timely and accurate completion of user lifecycle and access requests.
* Achievement of applicable incident and request SLAs.
* High-quality investigation notes, customer communications, and resolution records.
* Secure, accurate, and controlled Salesforce configuration and data maintenance.
* Complete change, approval, testing, and audit evidence.
* Effective escalation of work outside administrative scope.
* Current, usable operational documentation and knowledge articles.
* Measurable contribution to automation, process improvement, and reduced recurring support efforts.

**About The Cigna Group**
Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Incident Response Analyst
description:
Why Join Us?
  
  
**Why Join Us**
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
  
  
Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
  
  
This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
  
  
We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
  
  
What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
  
  
If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Troubleshoot and resolve endpoint installation, configuration, connectivity, and performance issues across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
* Perform deep-dive analysis using system logs, traces, and debug data to identify root causes.
* Document all reported issues, diagnostic steps, and resolutions in the ticketing system for knowledge sharing and trend analysis.
* Escalate unresolved or complex cases to Tier 3 Engineering or R&D teams with detailed findings and replication steps.
* Proactively identify recurring problems and recommend product or process improvements to reduce break/fix volume.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Support, QA, R&D, Product Management) to drive rapid resolution of high-impact incidents.
* Maintain high standards of communication with customers, ensuring timely status updates and clear explanations of findings and solution

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in technical support , end point administration or troubleshooting
* Perform incident response and forensic analysis of compromised systems, identify and provide recommendations for remediation
* Formulate and direct incident response efforts, prioritize those response efforts, and create legible incident reports that describe the compromise vector, attacker methodologies and artifacts
* Strong knowledge of OS troubleshooting (Windows, macOS, Linux), including tools like Wireshark and Windows debugging.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Linux, macOS) and directory services (EntraID/Active Directory).
* Understanding of threat prevention tools and SIEM integration.
* Knowledge of hardware components (BIOS, EFI, hard drives) and MDM/UEM platforms.
* Experience with ServiceNow or Salesforce ticketing systems.
* Ability to manage multiple support cases under tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.

**Preferred Skills**

* Previous experience with Check Point Products.
* Experience with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Python, batch scripting).
* Experience with MDM tools such as Intune, JAMF, and WorkSpace One.
* Experience with forensic investigation and CIRT processes.
* API integration and web developer tools knowledge.
* SQL and database querying experience.
* Cybersecurity certifications such as Security+, CISSP, CEH are a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong teaching and communication abilities—able to translate technical jargon into clear language.
* Creative problem-solving and customer-focused mindset.
* Team-oriented with a collaborative approach.
* Humble and curious—willing to ask questions and learn.

title: Helpdesk Analyst
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
* Provide local, on\-site support for the Bangalore office five days a week.
* Provide global support for all Sprinklr users.
* Track and document all support activities.
* Support macOS, Windows, AV, common office software, Microsoft and Adobe applications, and cloud SaaS products.
* Perform laptop setup, user inductions, hardware troubleshooting, and repairs.
* Support general office IT, including conference rooms, telephones, office networks, and printer setups.

* Perform endpoint management deployments and antivirus security support.
* Work with IT Management to continually monitor and improve the delivery of IT systems and support.
* Proactively understand, analyze, and research new technical problems when required.
* Support high\-level events and proactively monitor meeting rooms.
* Support new\-hire onboarding by preparing and provisioning devices, creating user accounts, and guiding users through the IT setup process.
* Assist with employee offboarding, ensuring the secure return of assets and revocation of system access in coordination with HR and Security.
* Collaborate with cross\-regional IT teams to troubleshoot and resolve complex or escalated issues.
* Maintain SOPs, knowledge\-based articles, and user guides to promote self\-service and knowledge sharing.
* Support VIP users and executives with high\-priority responses and proactive care during events or travel.


**AV \& Event Support Responsibilities**
* Set up and manage AV equipment for executive meetings and high\-profile events, ensuring smooth operations.
* Configure and troubleshoot displays, video and audio connections, mixers, computers, and peripherals.


**About You**
* 1\-2 years of IT experience, or a bachelor’s degree.
* Self\-motivated, with the ability to work with minimal supervision.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience supporting high\-level executives.
* Good understanding of Microsoft 365, Copilot, AI and computer networks.
* Experience with Jamf Pro and enterprise Mac\-management concepts.
* Strong end\-user support experience and technical knowledge of macOS, Windows, and other Microsoft products.
* Ability to use customer\-service\-oriented techniques to diagnose and resolve problems, responding with the appropriate urgency.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with professionals at all levels.
* Quick learner and proactive contributor who can work effectively in a dynamic, fast\-changing environment.
* Ability to priorities tasks and manage multiple assignments.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

 Customer Support and Training teams are responsible for resolving customer issues, ensuring any customer experience is delivered to high quality standards and training, and working amongst cross\-functional teams for the best solutions.  This role is for the DGM business unit within AspenTech, which focuses on software for the power and utilities industry.

* Provide loyalty\-inspiring customer service that drives user engagement and sustains product usage.
* Troubleshoot \& resolve complex technical and/or engineering related problems reported by customers using AspenTech’s proprietary software.

* Develop and/or maintain customer focused training materials for new releases and new applications in the industry.
* Develop strong relationships with customers, building an understanding of their business needs and challenges.
* Collaboration with other AspenTech functions to maintain and develop business opportunities.
* Function as a subject matter expert in AspenTech’s pre\-release software testing program to drive improved product quality.

 What You'll Need
   

  

* 4\+ year(s) Relevant/industry experience preferred. University experience may count.

* Knowledge of SCADA protocols such as ICCP, IEC 60870\-5\-104 (IEC104\), and DNP3\.
* Knowledge of SQL databases including Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, general DBMS concepts, and Cassandra concepts.

* Ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner utilizing strong written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.
* Ability to travel. Travel is usually less than 25% and may occasionally be international.
* Bachelor’s Degree required in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering or related field. Masters’ degree preferred.
* Strong technical background in automation and computers preferred.
* Knowledge of public utilities is a plus.

description:

 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.  In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Job Summary As a Senior Technical Support Engineer for Focused Services, you will deliver a personalized customer experience to ensure the successful adoption and operation of Palo Alto Networks products. You will develop a strategic partnership with customers and their Technical Account Manager to mitigate risks, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and provide proactive guidance. In this role, you will provide escalation management for critical technical issues, acting as a virtual member of the customer's team to accelerate their time to value. Key Responsibilities Provide reactive and proactive technical support, including configuration reviews and best practice guidance, to a dedicated portfolio of high\-value customers. Manage and prioritize support cases effectively, ensuring all issues are meticulously recorded, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner. Perform advanced fault isolation and root cause analysis for complex, multi\-faceted technical issues across diverse network environments. Proactively collaborate with internal teams, including development, to reproduce customer issues and drive resolutions for complex problems. Develop and publish technical documentation, such as support bulletins and knowledge base articles, to simplify complex topics for customers and internal teams. Maintain secure, detailed, and customer\-specific documentation to streamline current and future troubleshooting efforts. Travel to customer sites as required to partner with Technical Account Managers and provide hands\-on support for key accounts.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications 5\+ years of experience in a client\-facing technical support, network engineering, or systems engineering role. Demonstrated experience with TCP/IP and advanced routing \& switching protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP, VLAN, STP). Hands\-on experience with Palo Alto Networks products and technologies. Proven ability to independently debug broad, complex, and unique networks with mixed media and protocols. Flexibility to work non\-standard shift hours as required, including afternoons, evenings, and weekends. Preferred Qualifications Experience with authentication protocols such as RADIUS and TACACS\+. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Experience summarizing critical situations and presenting technical findings to senior stakeholders
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 Job Description
   

  

**Department:**
 Business Technology – Atlassian Products
   

  

**Reports To:**
 Manager, Atlassian Products
   

  

**Location:**
 India (On\-site) – Bangalore
   

  

**Level:**
 Individual Contributor – Entry/Mid
   

  

**About HealthEdge**
 HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud\-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale – and Atlassian is at the center of how work gets done across the organization.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Atlassian Administrator is a hands\-on platform administration role responsible for the day\-to\-day configuration, maintenance, and user support of HealthEdge's Atlassian environment, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence. Working within the Atlassian Products team and reporting to the Manager, Atlassian Products, you will be a key execution resource for platform requests, project configuration, user management, and basic automation – ensuring that thousands of users across the organization can work effectively in Atlassian tools every day.
   

  

 This is a great role for someone with solid Atlassian fundamentals who wants to deepen their platform expertise in a complex, high\-scale environment. You'll work closely with Senior Atlassian Administrators, Architects, and the team manager, taking on well\-defined configuration tasks and growing toward more advanced solution design and automation work over time. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, this role will grow to include working with AI\-native features like Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo — making content governance and platform hygiene directly connected to AI quality.
   

  

**What You'll Do** 
**Platform Administration \& Configuration**
* Administer Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence in a cloud environment
* Create and maintain Jira projects, boards, workflows, permission schemes, notification schemes, and screens under the guidance of senior team members
* Configure and manage JSM service desk projects including request types, queues, SLA configurations, and portal settings
* Manage Confluence spaces, page permissions, templates, and basic macros to support team knowledge management
* Perform user and group management including account creation, license assignments, group membership, and access reviews
* Process and fulfill Atlassian support requests from end users, maintaining SLA compliance in the team's JSM queue


**Automation \& Reporting**
* Build and maintain native Jira and JSM automation rules for common workflows – ticket routing, notifications, field updates, and status transitions
* Create and maintain dashboards, saved filters, and basic reports to support team and stakeholder visibility
* Assist with Confluence automation and page template maintenance
* Support testing and rollout of automation changes developed by Senior Administrators


**User Support \& Enablement**
* Serve as a first point of contact for Atlassian support requests, resolving common configuration and usage questions
* Escalate complex or high\-impact issues to Senior Atlassian Administrators with clear documentation and context
* Assist in onboarding new users and teams to Atlassian tools, including basic training and guidance on project setup
* Contribute to and maintain Atlassian knowledge base articles and how\-to documentation for end users


**Governance \& Housekeeping**
* Perform routine platform hygiene tasks including inactive user cleanup, stale project reviews, and unused field or scheme audits
* Assist with license usage tracking and reporting to support renewal planning
* Follow and help enforce Atlassian governance standards for project naming, permissions, and configuration consistency
* Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access and configuration


**Project \& Team Support**
* Assist Senior Administrators and the team manager with larger configuration projects, migrations, and platform improvement initiatives
* Participate in testing and validation of Atlassian upgrades, app changes, and configuration rollouts
* Document changes accurately in accordance with team change management practices


**What You'll Bring** 
**Required**
* 2–4 years of hands\-on Jira and/or Confluence administration experience in a corporate environment
* Working knowledge of Jira Software project types, workflows, permission schemes, and issue configuration
* Experience configuring and supporting Jira Service Management (JSM) service desk projects
* Familiarity with Confluence space administration, page permissions, and content organization
* Experience with native Jira automation rules
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills – platform hygiene and accuracy matter in this role
* Good written and verbal English communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests and prioritize effectively


**Preferred**
* Experience with Atlassian Cloud (vs. Data Center/Server only)
* Atlassian certification (ACP\-120 Jira Administration or equivalent)
* Familiarity with Atlassian Marketplace apps (ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, or similar)
* Familiarity with Atlassian Intelligence or Rovo
* Exposure to ITIL frameworks or service management best practices
* Basic scripting or REST API exposure (not required, but a strong differentiator)
* Experience working in a global, multi\-time zone organization


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within 90 days, you are independently handling the majority of day\-to\-day Atlassian support requests, have a solid working knowledge of HealthEdge's project and space structure, and are contributing to platform hygiene initiatives. Within six months, you are building and maintaining automation rules confidently, your queue work is consistently within SLA, and stakeholders are getting reliable, well\-configured solutions from you. Within a year, you have grown your platform depth meaningfully, are contributing to larger configuration projects, and are beginning to take on more complex solution design work with senior team support.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team within Business Technology, focused on making Jira, JSM, and Confluence work well for thousands of users across a complex global organization. The team values platform rigor, clean governance, and user\-focused solutions – and invests in growing the skills of everyone on it. This role is an excellent entry point into a team where strong administrators can grow into senior and lead positions over time.
   

  

**Geographic Responsibility: This position is located in Bangalore**
**Type of Employment: Full\-time, permanent**
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**
**Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:**
* The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
* Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
* May require travel dependent on company needs.


 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990\. Candidates may be required to go through a pre\-employment criminal background check.
   

  

 HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

***worldwide***

***150\+ partners***

* ***Winning as One Team:***
*We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes*
* ***Customer Driven Innovation:***
*We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers*
* ***Agility in Action:***
*We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change*



  





*Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.* 




  





**Role Summary:** 




  





 The Senior Support Specialist is a senior security practitioner responsible for defending the organization’s network, infrastructure, and cloud environments against internal and external threats. This role operates at the intersection of security engineering and operations, with direct ownership of network security controls, threat detection, and incident response. Support responsibilities exist to enable security outcomes, not as an end in themselves.
 



 This position requires hands\-on expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to identify systemic risk before it becomes an incident.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




  





**Network Security Ownership** 



* Architect, deploy, and continuously harden network security controls including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models.
* Own network perimeter and internal trust boundaries, including firewall policy design, rule lifecycle management, and access validation.
* Actively monitor network traffic and telemetry to identify indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and policy violations.
* Lead vulnerability discovery and remediation for network and infrastructure components.



  





**Threat Detection \& Incident Response** 



* Serve as the primary escalation point for all security incidents involving network intrusion, unauthorized access, malware, or data exposure.
* Perform deep forensic analysis using logs, packet captures, and endpoint data to determine scope and impact.
* Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents while preserving evidence and maintaining operational continuity.
* Drive post\-incident root cause analysis and ensure corrective controls are implemented, not merely documented.



  





**Security Operations Engineering** 



* Maintain and tune security tooling including SIEM, NDR, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Define detection logic, alert thresholds, and response playbooks aligned to real threat models rather than checkbox compliance.
* Reduce noise and false positives while improving time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-contain metrics.



  





**Security\-Driven Support \& Escalation** 



* Handle only the most complex escalations where security risk, system integrity, or availability is at stake.
* Enforce secure configuration standards across systems, networks, and cloud services.
* Mentor support and IT staff on secure operational practices and adversarial thinking.



  





**Risk, Governance \& Assurance** 



* Translate security policy and control requirements into enforceable technical reality.
* Support audits and assessments by producing defensible, technically accurate evidence.
* Continuously assess gaps between documented controls and actual security posture.



  





**Architecture \& Strategic Hardening** 



* Influence infrastructure and application design decisions to reduce attack surface and blast radius.
* Identify architectural weaknesses and advocate for durable, long\-term security improvements.
* Track emerging threats and adjust defensive strategies accordingly.



  





**Required Experience:** 




  




* 7\+ years in security engineering, network security, SOC, or infrastructure defense roles.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and security architectures.
* Proven incident response experience involving real\-world security events.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, lateral movement, and network\-based threats.
* Experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




  




* Security certifications (CISSP, GSEC, GCIA, CySA\+, or equivalent).
* Experience operating within SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks.
* Scripting or automation capability to improve detection, response, or control enforcement.
* Background supporting SaaS, high\-availability, or distributed environments.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




  




* Security incidents are detected earlier and contained faster.
* Network access is tightly controlled, auditable, and aligned with least\-privilege principles.
* Recurring issues are eliminated through structural fixes rather than repeated response.
* Security is embedded into daily operations, not bolted on after failures.



  





**Benefits:** 




  





 As a full\-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:
 



  




* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents\-in\-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000
* Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

description:
**About Clean Harbors**
 Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $4\.3 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
   

  

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

**Job Overview**
 Customer Success Associate will be the primary point of contact for our customers. Through the interactions, they will help our customers see the value in our product/services and ensure they are able to use it to its fullest potential. The prime responsibility of this position is to manage inbound calls from our existing customers and assist in an efficient, courteous, professional manner. The key role involves providing customer support via phone, email/chat \- processing payments, scheduling services, handling general queries and cross sell our products across North America.

* Being the first point of contact for customers and handling all customer inquiries and focusing on First Call Resolution.
* The team will be responsible to ensure that our customer data is secured while taking payments/ billing queries, scheduling services, or sharing any documents requested by the customer.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Twara Robotics is an Indian industrial robot manufacturer and part of the ACE Micromatic Group. We design and build articulated robot arms and turnkey robotic welding systems, with both hardware and software developed in\-house in Bengaluru.
 



 Our focus is on making automation accessible to Indian manufacturers. Our welding robots are lightweight, work with the welding power sources customers already own, and can be set up by welders and shop\-floor engineers without a dedicated robot programmer. Systems are deployed across heavy engineering and auto component plants, and are backed by service support through the ACE Micromatic network of 70\+ offices nationwide.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Service Engineer role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Pune/Pimpri\-Chinchwad area. The Service Engineer will perform installation, commissioning, and preventive maintenance of robotic arms and related systems at customer locations. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing technical issues, executing repairs, and providing hands\-on technical support to ensure high system uptime and safety. The role involves field visits, responding to service requests, documenting service activities, and collaborating with engineering and product teams to relay feedback from customers. * Candidates should possess strong Troubleshooting skills for mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
* Candidates should possess Technical Support capabilities, including remote assistance and issue escalation.
* Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, and schematics, and to use diagnostic tools and basic test equipment.
* Comfort with travel within the region, a customer\-service mindset, and the ability to work independently on\-site.

title: End User Support Engineer (L2/L3) - DWS
description:
Reference 26000HWH
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**End User Support Engineer (L2/L3\) \- Digital Workplace Services**
**Job Summary**
 The End User Support Engineer is responsible for managing, supporting, and maintaining end\-user computing infrastructure, workplace technologies, and associated services to ensure high availability, operational excellence, and exceptional user experience. The role provides Level 2 and Level 3 technical support, drives service improvements through automation and process optimization, manages printer services, coordinates with vendors, and ensures compliance with security, operational, and governance standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Profile required**
**End User Support \& Service Operations**
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for end\-user infrastructure, systems, applications, and workplace technologies.
* Install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems, authorized application software, and system management tools.
* Respond to incidents, service requests, and technical queries from users, service providers, site personnel, and external vendors.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, software, operating system, and infrastructure issues.
* Ensure timely issue resolution while meeting service level agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate with GTS teams, infrastructure teams, and external vendors for issue resolution and service improvements.
* Maintain operational stability and ensure minimal downtime across supported environments.
* Work experience in End point device management (including laptop, Mobile device) via Microsoft Intune portal.


**Infrastructure \& System Management**
* Participate in the planning, implementation, and support of IT infrastructure and operational support systems.
* Proactively monitor and maintain systems to ensure maximum availability, performance, and reliability.
* Maintain security, backup, recovery, and redundancy strategies.
* Support endpoint management activities, including device deployment, software distribution, patch management, and compliance monitoring.
* Ensure all supported systems adhere to organizational security and compliance requirements.


**Printer Management \& Support**
* Manage and support enterprise printing services, including network printers, multifunction devices (MFDs), and print servers (HP, Canon).
* Install, configure, troubleshoot, maintain, and replace printers as required by coordinating with cross functional departments like Network (HCS) and EVS (End point team).
* Coordinate printer deployment, relocation, upgrade, and decommissioning activities.
* Troubleshoot print queues, printer drivers, connectivity issues, firmware updates, and print management applications.
* Monitor printer availability and service health to minimize business impact.
* Manage printer\-related incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.


**Vendor Coordination \& Governance**
* Act as the primary liaison between IT teams and external vendors for support services and issue resolution.
* Coordinate vendor activities for hardware replacement, break\-fix support, warranty claims, and technical escalations.
* Maintain vendor contacts, support documentation, service agreements, and escalation matrices.
* Conduct Monthly Vendor Review Meetings to discuss:
+ Open incidents and escalations
+ Service performance and SLA compliance
+ Printer service performance
+ Improvement opportunities
+ Risks and mitigation plans
+ Action item tracking and closure

* Monitor vendor performance and drive accountability against contractual obligations and service expectations.


**Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**
* Develop, document, and maintain support processes, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual effort.
* Create and implement automation scripts, self\-heal solutions, DIY initiatives, and process improvements.
* Drive operational excellence by ensuring compliance with SOPs, governance standards, and operational KPIs.
* Contribute innovative solutions that improve productivity, service quality, and customer experience.


**Project Support**
* Support infrastructure and workplace technology projects.
* Ensure assigned project tasks are completed within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to achieve project objectives successfully.


**Knowledge Management \& Team Development**
* Participate in learning and development activities covering technical, process, and behavioral competencies.
* Share knowledge and best practices with team members.
* Conduct at least two internal knowledge\-sharing sessions annually.
* Pursue relevant certifications aligned with organizational and technology requirements.


**Technical Skills Required**
**End User Computing**
* Windows 10/11 Administration
* Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)
* Active Directory \& Azure Active Directory
* Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager
* Software Deployment \& Packaging
* Device Imaging \& Provisioning
* Endpoint Security Solutions


**Infrastructure Support**
* Hardware Troubleshooting (Desktop, Laptop, Docking Stations, Mobile Devices)
* VPN and Remote Access Support
* Basic Networking (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi)
* Patch Management
* System Monitoring Tools
* ITSM Tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira, etc.)


**Printer \& Asset Management**
* Enterprise Printer Support
* Print Server Administration
* Multifunction Device (MFD) Support
* Asset Lifecycle Management
* Warranty and Vendor Management


**Automation \& Scripting**
* PowerShell (Preferred)
* Process Automation
* Self\-Heal Script Development


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong customer service orientation
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking
* Ownership and accountability
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Ability to work under pressure and manage priorities effectively


**Education \& Experience**
**Education**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
   

  

**Experience**
* 4 to 8\+ years of experience in End User Computing (EUC), Desktop Support, Digital Workplace Services, or IT Infrastructure Support.
* Experience managing enterprise end\-user environments, printer services, vendor coordination, and L2/L3 support operations.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Microsoft Certified Endpoint Administrator Associate
* Microsoft 365 Administrator
* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
* ITIL Foundation
* CompTIA A\+ / Network\+


**Success Criteria**
 The successful candidate will deliver stable, secure, and scalable end\-user services, maintain operational excellence, proactively drive automation and innovation, effectively manage vendor relationships and printer services, and consistently provide a best\-in\-class user experience while ensuring compliance with organizational standards and business objectives.
   

  

**Why join us**
 “We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status”
   

  

**Business insight**
 At Société Générale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious.
   

  

 Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating and taking action are part of our DNA.
   

  

 If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!
   

  

 Still hesitating?

There are many ways to get involved.

title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
**Opportunity Overview**
 ZeroFox seeks a Sr. IT Specialist to support a growing multinational cybersecurity company. The successful candidate will work with the corporate IT team on daily operations and long\-term IT goals, covering in\-house support, global team assistance across India and other locations, and end\-to\-end employee onboarding and offboarding.
   

  

 Role and Responsibilities
   

  

* Respond to in\-house and remote IT requests from employees via walk\-in, email, and service tickets; document all interactions in the ITSM ticketing system.
* Support the India office and global teams, handling incidents and requests across time zones.
* Resolve employee issues through cross\-departmental collaboration; stay current on software and hardware updates.
* Work with employees and IT staff to gather requirements, assess impact on existing systems, and implement solutions.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and IT documentation.
* Procure, configure, and stage devices (laptops, peripherals, mobile) fully before a new hire's first day.
* Enroll devices via MDM (e.g., Jamf, Intune, Kandji) and provision accounts through IdP platforms (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) with appropriate SSO, MFA, and access rights.
* Coordinate with HR and department leads to complete onboarding tasks on schedule for local and global hires.
* Execute offboarding procedures — account deprovisioning, device retrieval or remote wipe, and license reclamation.
* Maintain an accurate catalog of hardware assets, software licenses, and user assignments.
* Administer MDM and IdP platforms for policy configuration, compliance, and user lifecycle management across global endpoints.
* Manage ITSM tools for incident tracking, change management, and asset management.
* Perform hardware installation, configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, and repairs for computers, handheld devices, and peripherals.
* Work with the systems team to ensure applications are patched on time per security and compliance requirements.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* 3\+ years of IT support or similar experience.
* 1\+ years working with various hardware and software, including Apple laptops.
* Hands\-on experience with MDM platforms (Jamf Pro, Intune, or Kandji) for device enrollment, policy enforcement, and compliance.
* Proficiency with IdP solutions (Okta, Azure AD, or OneLogin) including SSO, MFA, and user lifecycle management.
* Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk or Freshservice) for ticketing, SLA tracking, and asset management.
* Proven ability to manage IT onboarding and offboarding end\-to\-end.
* Ability to support distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and multitasking skills.
* Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Availability to work occasional evenings and weekends.


**Desired Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Prior experience supporting employees across India and global offices.


 Benefits
   

  

* Amazing Product: ZeroFOX has created a paradigm shifting cyber security product
* Awesome Culture: ZeroFOX is a community – most describe our team as a group of close knit, incredibly talented, and highly caffeinated people. All are encouraged and required to incorporate innovative ideas and prototypes into our product. Suggestions around streamlining communication, development practices and operations are welcomed
* Get Things Done: Innovation is woven into the fabric of our organization. Every aspect of our operations is purposeful; enabling us to research, develop and innovate faster than the competition
* Benefits: Competitive compensation and benefits package available
