title: Technical Analyst – Cloud Infrastructure
description:
Shape the future of work in complex industries.
   

  

 At Falkor, we help some of the world's most complex industries operate with greater clarity, confidence, and control.
   

  

 Built on more than 200 years of KONGSBERG industrial heritage, our industrial intelligence platform connects people, systems, and workflows across energy, processing, power, renewables, and other heavy\-asset industries.
   

  

 We turn complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance across the asset lifecycle.
   

  

 As industries evolve, we're building the technology that helps people see further, decide faster, and operate with confidence.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Technical Analyst – Cloud Infrastructure to join the Customer Support team. This hands\-on support role is suited to a professional with approximately 3\+ years of experience in cloud operations, technical support, or infrastructure support.
   

  

 The successful candidate will support customers with onboarding, troubleshooting, and the reliable operation of cloud\-based services. This role will work closely with Customer Support colleagues and collaborate with Cloud Architects, Solution Architects, Engineering, Product, and Delivery/Customer Success teams as escalation and delivery partners.
   

  

**What You’ll Do** 
 –
   

  

**Customer Support and Cloud Operations**
* Monitor, support, and troubleshoot cloud\-based services across Microsoft Azure and related platforms.
* Support incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, and follow\-up activities.
* Use dashboards, logs, alerts, and runbooks to identify issues, validate service health, and support customer\-facing operations.
* Maintain accurate handover notes, operational documentation, and support records.


**Customer Enablement and Delivery Support**
* Partner with Cloud and Solution Architects to support effective customer onboarding and delivery execution.
* Assist customers by troubleshooting platform usage issues, onboarding queries, and initial implementation or integration steps.
* Serve as a technical liaison between customers and internal teams to ensure issues are clearly understood and resolved efficiently.
* Contribute to improved customer experience, customer satisfaction, and delivery confidence.


**SLA Management and Support Operations**
* Ensure support requests are managed in accordance with defined SLAs, severity levels, and operational processes.
* Provide customers with timely updates, clear communication, and effective resolution for critical incidents.
* Follow SOPs for ticket prioritization, incident response, escalation workflows, and customer communication.
* Maintain operational discipline to ensure support workflows remain reliable, predictable, and scalable.


**Technical Troubleshooting and Escalation**
* Support Kubernetes\-based cloud services through basic health checks, deployment validation, and first\-level troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot common issues related to access, configuration, connectivity, workload failures, resource utilization, logs, and monitoring alerts.
* Hands on experience on Grafana, GitOps, no\-SQL DB’s, CI/CD tools, service mesh concepts and hybrid infrastructure.
* Escalate defects, feature gaps, or complex platform issues with clear context, reproduction steps, logs, and diagnostics.


**Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement**
* Develop and maintain troubleshooting guides, support playbooks, root cause summaries, and customer\-facing explanations.
* Identify recurring issue patterns and recommend improvements to reduce repeat incidents.
* Collaborate with Support, Engineering, Product, and Delivery/Customer Success teams to strengthen product quality and internal troubleshooting capability.


**Shift\-Based Support Coverage**
* Provide cloud support coverage as part of a planned shift roster.
* Work rotational shifts in alignment with Customer Support coverage requirements and business needs. Indicative shift timings include 5:00 AM–2:00 PM, 12:00 PM–9:00 PM, and 8:00 PM–5:00 AM.
* Provide weekend coverage when assigned, ensuring timely handovers and continuity of service.


**What We're Looking For**
* Approximately 3\+ years of experience in cloud support, infrastructure operations, platform support, or a related technical support role.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and foundational exposure to Kubernetes, containers, or cloud\-native services.
* Sound understanding of incident management, monitoring and operational support processes.
* Hands on experience on full\-stack observability platforms like Grafana (including but not limited to querying logs, metrics, traces, setting up dashboards \& alerts).
* Strong ability to analyze, maintain, and develop scripts utilizing PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent tools to streamline operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, ownership, and collaboration skills. Willingness to work rotational shifts and provide weekend support when required.


**Desirable Experience**
* Exposure to AI, ML, data\-intensive workloads, or GPU\-enabled environments.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code concepts (including Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or Pulumi).
* Experience supporting enterprise, industrial, regulated, or mission\-critical environments.
* CKA certification will be an added advantage.


**Success Measure** 
 s
   

  

* Critical and complex support issues are resolved promptly, clearly, and efficiently.
* Customers experience minimal disruption, timely communication, and high service reliability.
* Customer satisfaction and response times show continuous improvement.
* Support knowledge, troubleshooting guides, and playbooks are structured for effective reuse.
* Recurring issues are identified, escalated, and reduced over time.


**Why join Falkor?**
 You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.
   

  

**At Falkor, You'll Have The Opportunity To**
 Work on meaningful challenges with real\-world impact
   

  

 Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains
   

  

 Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation
   

  

 Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally
   

  

 Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries
   

  

 We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.
   

  

**About Falkor**
 Falkor is a KONGSBERG company that enables organizations in heavy\-asset industries to expand human capability and redefine how assets are designed, operated, and optimized across their lifecycle.
   

  

 By connecting people, systems, and workflows, Falkor's industrial intelligence platform turns complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping leading organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance.
   

  

**Ready to apply?**
 If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Apply today with your resume.

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: DEM_Technical Services Engineer
description:
Job Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Noida, Pune
   

  

 Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations Globally
   

  

 Req Id: 12233
   

  

 Posting Start Date: 9/10/26
   

  

 At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935\. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50\+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
   

  

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit
* Certification in at least on DEM technology to an analyst level Experience in 2nd line support and triaging issues to 3rd line resolver groups Experience in problem or incident management, with a good understanding of how the end user impact of technology issues Ideally, a good understanding of other automation technologies, such as Resolve and RPA


**Mandatory Skills**
 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.
   

  

 Relocation Supported: No
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Helpdesk Engineer
description:
**Summary:** 
 This role involves providing hands\-on L1/L2 IT support to users, enhancing the existing Helpdesk team. The primary goal is to ensure efficient technical support while maintaining system security and operational excellence.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities:**
* Provide first and second\-level technical support to end\-users, resolving hardware, software, and network\-related incidents and requests.
* Utilize ServiceNow as the primary ticketing system for incident and service request management, ensuring accurate and timely documentation, prioritization, and resolution.
* Administer and support mobile device management solutions, including AirWatch, for the deployment, configuration, and security of corporate mobile devices.
* Leverage Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) for software deployment, patch management, operating system deployment, and inventory management of end\-user devices.
* Assist in identifying and remediating security vulnerabilities on end\-user devices and associated infrastructure, adhering to established security policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and execute IT\-related aspects of office moves, new employee onboarding, and equipment changes, ensuring seamless transitions.
* Provide remote IT support and ensure the functionality of IT infrastructure in regional and satellite offices.
* Offer on\-site and remote IT support for company events, ensuring the reliable operation of AV equipment, network connectivity, and other IT resources.


**Key Requirements:**
* Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and endpoint management.
* Experience with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM/ticketing platform.
* Experience with asset and inventory management.
* Exposure to Windows migration, patch management, and vulnerability remediation.


**Nice to Have:**
* Experience with mobile device management solutions.
* Familiarity with IT compliance regulations.
* Knowledge of IT security best practices.


**Other Details:**
* Contract Duration: 6 Months
* Shift Timing: 6\.30 am to 3\.30 pm and 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Friday.
* Work Environment: Requires working from the office.

title: Senior Specialist
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That\`s why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimageable with us.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We are seeking an IT Service Solution Expert with strong expertise in
 **SolidWorks PDM,** 
 working knowledge of
 **SolidWorks Manage PLM** 
 , and proficiency with
 **SolidWorks CAD, SQL Server/T\-SQL** 
 , and reporting tools. This role supports engineering data management, reporting, and IT Service Management processes (including incidents, requests, and changes).
   

  

 The role administers the
 **SolidWorks PDM and Manage** 
 environment, aligns engineering workflows with ITIL practices, and partners with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, manage data lifecycles, and resolve Tier 1\-2 support requests.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Platform Administration and Architecture**
* Implement, configure, and optimize SolidWorks PDM workflows, vaults, archive servers, data structures, and security controls.
* Configure SolidWorks Manage dashboards, processes, objects, and metadata mappings.
* Maintain integrations with SolidWorks environments and administer related Microsoft SQL Server databases.
* Maintain and support the IIS web server.


**PLM Collaboration and Solution Delivery**
* Collaborate with SolidWorks Manage PLM IT partners to gather requirements and deliver scalable engineering data management solutions.
* Translate business needs into clear technical specifications for PDM and Manage enhancements.
* Lead requirements gathering sessions and document user stories, administrative tasks, and sprint activities in Jira.


**Reporting, Analytics, and Integration**
* Develop and optimize SQL Server and T\-SQL queries for reporting, data analysis, and process automation.
* Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using SolidWorks Manage reporting, SSRS, Power BI, or equivalent BI tools.
* Support data exchange pipelines between SolidWorks Manage and downstream ERP/MRP systems.


**ITSM Operations and Support**
* Manage IT Service Management activities for incidents, service requests, and changes within ServiceNow.
* Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues related to PDM/Manage login, local cache, replication, onboarding, access provisioning, and template deployment.
* Track SLAs, document resolutions, manage incident lifecycles, and coordinate root cause analysis with preventive actions.
* Develop and maintain best\-practice standards, templates, and documentation (SOPs, work instructions, runbooks).


**Change Management, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement**
* Design and improve approval workflows, revision control, and lifecycle states across PDM and Manage.
* Coordinate Engineering Change Orders and Engineering Change Requests through ITIL\-aligned change workflows.
* Connect ServiceNow Change Management processes with engineering design changes to support compliance, data governance, and security standards.
* Collaborate with IT and partners on server upgrades, client software rollouts, and disaster recovery testing.
* Nice to Have
* Integrations via APIs (UPTIMIZE DTI, Customer Experience Product).
* PDM Backups for Disaster recovery.
* Active Directory for PDM Professional password authentication (Single Sign\-On)
* Upgrading Server Software Components and SMTP integration for PDM Professional notifications.


**Your Role**
* Strong experience with SQL Server queries and T\-SQL; ability to optimize queries.
* Working knowledge and specialization in SolidWorks PDM.
* Preferred knowledge in SolidWorks Manage PLM.
* General knowledge of SolidWorks CAD platforms.
* Experience delivering and supporting IIS Web Sites, logs, and servers; familiarity with log viewers, monitoring, and app pools.
* Proficiency in report and dashboard generation.
* Experience in IT Service Management (incident, request, change) with ServiceNow.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills; ability to work with cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SolidWorks PDM/PLM certifications or demonstrated project experience.
* Experience integrating PLM with ERP/CRM ecosystems.
* Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and security principles in manufacturing environments.
* ITIL certification or strong ITIL\-aligned process understanding.
* Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience (including VAR backgrounds such as Trimech, Hawk Ridge, or GoEngineer).
* 2\-4 years of experience administering SolidWorks PDM Professional and SolidWorks Manage.
* Experience in a structured ITIL service desk or service operation environment.
* Certifications (highly desirable): SolidWorks CPAP, ITIL 4 Foundation or higher, and Jira for agile delivery.
* Foundational understanding of Windows Server environments and SQL database queries.
* Communication for Export/Import for ERP/SAP/MRP/Other DB systems.


 Skills \& Tools
   

  

* SolidWorks PDM
* SolidWorks Manage PLM (preferred)
* SolidWorks CAD platforms
* SQL Server, T\-SQL
* SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services)
* Power BI (or equivalent BI tools)
* ServiceNow ITSM (incidents, requests, changes)
* Data integration, data modeling, reporting
* Jira (requirements, user stories, sprint tracking)
* ITIL processes (Service Management, Change Management)
* API integrations (optional: UPTIMIZE DTI, Customer Experience Product)
* Cross\-functional collaboration, stakeholder management


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent
* 2\-4 years of relevant SolidWorks PDM/PLM experience \& total 6\-8 years of IT experience.
* Experience in ITIL\-aligned service operations


 Certifications (Highly Desirable)
   

  

* SolidWorks Certified PDM Administrator Professional (CPAP)
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher
* Jira for Agile delivery


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and believe that it drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of our diverse team!

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem \- database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Cool things you’ll do
   

  

 You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges \- resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs \- interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
   

  

 As an ideal candidate, you will have
   

  

 We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self taught, curious, and multi\-faceted. Our ideal TSE candidate should also have
   

  

* 6 plus years of experience
* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, Storage, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage


 Nice to have
   

  

* Comfortable with modern AI concepts and proficient in using AI\-assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting and enhance day\-to\-day technical support workflows.
* Experience on one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C\+\+, C\#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl


 It’s crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes
   

  

* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Genuine desire to help people
* Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real\-time
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
* Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
   

  

 We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Support Engineer – L1
   

  

**Location:** 
 Onsite – Bangalore
   

  

**Position Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Position Summary**
 To enhance our global support team, we are hiring a Technical Support Engineer – L1 with strong and proven customer service experience in the IT market to be based in our Bangalore, India office. The role will provide professional technical support to Kaseya customers through chats, phones, and tickets, while meeting or exceeding internal KPI targets and expectations. The successful candidate will bring strong problem\-solving skills, technical troubleshooting expertise, and a professional, courteous, customer\-first attitude.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide L1 technical support to Kaseya customers through chat, phone, and ticket\-based channels while maintaining a professional and customer\-first approach.
* Troubleshoot Linux/UNIX and Windows operating systems, including system boot, BIOS/UEFI, hardware, and Windows Server issues.

* Use Linux commands and PuTTY/SSH to investigate and troubleshoot technical issues, including basic system and application log analysis.
* Support Windows Server Core administration, including roles and features, disk management, Active Directory permissions/ACLs, and Group\-related administration.
* Troubleshoot storage and recovery environments involving NAS, SAN, tape, USB, RAID, virtual storage, and common file systems such as NTFS, FAT, and ext4\.
* Troubleshoot networking issues using the OSI model and TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS concepts, CLI tools, firewall rules, ports, latency, and packet\-related troubleshooting.

* Hands\-on experience with Linux commands, PuTTY/SSH, system boot troubleshooting, BIOS/UEFI, and basic system/application log analysis.
* Knowledge of Windows Server Core administration, Active Directory permissions/ACLs, Group administration, storage technologies, file systems, and backup/recovery concepts.
* Basic knowledge of networking and troubleshooting, including OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, firewall rules, ports, latency, and CLI tools such as ping, ipconfig, Nmap, and traceroute.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven customer service experience in an IT support environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry\-accepted certification or equivalent work experience in CompTIA A\+.
* CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Server\+, or CompTIA Security\+ certification or equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator certification or equivalent experience.
* Red Hat Linux certification or equivalent experience.
* VMware VCP certification or equivalent virtualization experience.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification or equivalent cloud experience.
* Additional hands\-on experience with MS Exchange Server, MS SQL, or Oracle Database.


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

**About the company** 




  





 Pixis (Leapus Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a next\-generation marketing\-AI platform that harnesses the targeting capabilities of social media and digital advertising platforms. It takes an end\-to\-end approach to the identification, creation, and optimisation of ads — collecting data, understanding target\-group behaviour, creating the ad, and delivering the right content at the right time, so every customer receives uniquely relevant advertising on a one\-to\-one basis. Pixis works with brands such as Swiggy, Amazon, Rapido, HDFC Bank, TATA AIG, Yes Bank, GoAir, Livspace, and MPL Gaming, delivering an average upside of around 50% on CPL, CPI, CPC, and CPM, along with a significant improvement in acquired customer LTV.
 



  





**Role summary** 




 The IT Executive handles day\-to\-day IT support for employees, maintains the IT asset inventory, manages the office network, and assists the IT Manager with new IT projects and system rollouts. The role requires a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on IT operations experience and a strong, practical grasp of IT infrastructure and best practices.
 



  





**Scope** 




 The role is based in Bangalore, India and supports the Bangalore office and India\-based employees, with remote support extended to other Pixis group entities as needed. The IT Executive works closely with the People team on new\-hire and exit processes and with vendors on hardware procurement and repairs.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




 Responsibilities are organised by area and are carried out under the direction of the IT Manager.
 



**IT Support** 




 • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and access issues for employees on macOS, Windows, and mobile devices.
 



 • Log and track tickets, resolve them within agreed timelines, and escalate to the IT Manager when needed.
 



 • Set up laptops and accounts for new hires; recover devices and revoke access when employees exit.
 



 • Maintain simple how\-to guides and conduct IT orientation for new employees.
 



**IT Asset Inventory** 




 • Maintain an up\-to\-date inventory of all hardware assets — assignment, serial number, condition, warranty, and location.
 



 • Coordinate laptop procurement, tagging, deployment, repairs, and secure disposal of old equipment.
 



 • Track software licenses and remove unused licenses to control cost.
 



**Network Management** 




 • Manage and monitor the office network — firewalls, switches, Wi\-Fi access points, and internet links.
 



 • Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues; make routine configuration changes as approved.
 



 • Keep network documentation current and coordinate with ISP and building IT teams when required.
 



**IT Projects \& Systems** 




 • Assist in the design and deployment of new IT systems and services — office setups, network upgrades, and tool rollouts.
 



 • Assess vendors and test new hardware and software before company\-wide rollout.
 



 • Document setup steps and standards for the changes delivered.
 



**Monitoring \& Improvement** 




 • Monitor the performance of IT systems and report issues, ticket trends, and costs to the IT Manager.
 



 • Recommend improvements to IT infrastructure, tools, and processes. • Ensure endpoint security basics are in place — device management enrolment, patching, and antivirus/EDR coverage.
 



**Vendor Coordination** 




 • Liaise with hardware suppliers, repair centres, ISPs, and software vendors for quotes, orders, warranty claims, and renewals.
 



 • Maintain vendor contact details and the renewal calendar.
 



  





**Required qualifications** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience working in IT operations or IT support.
* Excellent working knowledge of computer systems, security, network and systems administration, databases and data storage systems, and phone systems.
* Hands\-on experience with office networking — firewalls, switches, and access points — including basic configuration and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Windows and macOS troubleshooting, and of Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 user administration.
* Strong critical thinking and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent IT skills and a strong ability to prioritise across tickets, projects, and walk\-up requests.
* A firm grasp of IT infrastructure and operations best practices.
* Good communication skills — able to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical employees and leadership.

title: IT Admin and Support Specialist
description:
ReOrbit is looking for an IT Admin and Support Specialist to provide hands\-on IT support and administration for our growing Bangalore office.
   

  

 As our IT Admin and Support Specialist, you will be the primary on\-site IT presence in Bangalore, ensuring that employees, devices and local infrastructure are properly supported and ready to operate. You will take ownership of everything from hardware lifecycle management and employee onboarding to access controls, device management and local IT troubleshooting.
   

  

 You will work closely with ReOrbit's IT Infrastructure, Operations \& Support teams, particularly HQ in Helsinki, helping to implement global standards, policies and security requirements locally. You will also play an important role in establishing Bangalore as part of ReOrbit's follow\-the\-sun support model, providing remote support to colleagues across other locations when required.
   

  

 It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start\-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the local hardware inventory for the Bangalore office, including device setup, repair, replacement, lifecycle management and shipment coordination.
* Provide hands\-on support for regional IT projects, technology rollouts and infrastructure initiatives in Bangalore.
* Own the onboarding and offboarding process for Bangalore employees, including device provisioning, account setup, security requirements and access controls.
* Manage and support local physical security systems, including CCTV and access\-related infrastructure.
* Support the implementation of HQ\-driven security policies, processes and IT standards at the Bangalore location.
* Support Microsoft Active Directory design and administration, including Group Policy management and cloud or hybrid server environments.
* Manage software licences and subscriptions for Bangalore\-based users and devices.
* Deploy and maintain standardised laptop and mobile device configurations.
* Troubleshoot local server, infrastructure and end\-user technology issues.
* Manage Windows support tickets and provide timely resolution or escalation where required.
* Administer MDM enrolment and device lifecycle processes for Bangalore devices.
* Provide remote support to other ReOrbit locations as part of the follow\-the\-sun IT support model.
* Coordinate with the global IT team and escalate infrastructure, security or service issues to Helsinki when required.
* Maintain accurate documentation of local IT assets, configurations, procedures and support activities.


**Skills And Requirements**
* 3–6 years of experience in IT administration and end\-user support, ideally supporting a regional, satellite or multi\-site office.
* Hands\-on experience with hardware inventory management, device repair and replacement, and end\-to\-end device lifecycle management.
* Experience managing employee onboarding and offboarding processes, including account provisioning, security and physical access controls.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy and cloud or hybrid server administration.
* Experience with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent tools for device management and onboarding or offboarding.
* Strong Windows end\-user support and troubleshooting skills.
* Comfortable working as the primary on\-site IT presence and independently managing local priorities while escalating to global teams when needed.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to support and implement globally defined policies and processes locally.
* Strong organisational and documentation skills.


**What does ReOrbit do?**
 ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software\-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.
   

  

 ReOrbit’s top\-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in\-house software, procure hardware from the best\-in\-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Working at ReOrbit**
 At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.
   

  

 We offer
   

  

* Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.
* Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space .
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance \- but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.
* We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion.
* We support relocation and integration into Finnish society.


 Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications
   

  

 and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era.
   

  

 The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies
   

  

*For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

title: Technical Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer - SaaS Product Support
description:
Technical Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer \- SaaS Product Support
 


 Bengaluru \| Hybrid • Full\-time \| UK business hours • Compensation: up to 5 LPA
 





 Technical Support Engineer \| Application Support Engineer \| Product Support \| Software Support \| SaaS Support \| Customer Support \| Ticket Management \| Incident Management
 




 About the role
 


 Script Assist is hiring junior Technical Support / Application Support Engineers to investigate and resolve customer issues within our software platform.
 





 We are primarily looking for people with approximately 6\-24 months of professional support experience who already understand how to work from a ticket queue, respond to customer or user issues, gather information, investigate a problem, follow a support process, escalate appropriately, document what happened and keep ownership until resolution.
 





 You do not need healthcare experience. You do need some genuine professional experience supporting a software application, SaaS product or digital platform.
 




 You may currently be working as a:
 


 •  Technical Support Engineer
 





 •  Application Support Engineer
 





 •  Technical Support Analyst
 





 •  Application Support Analyst
 





 •  Product Support Analyst
 





 •  Product Support Engineer
 





 •  Product Support Associate
 





 •  Software Support Engineer
 





 •  Software Support Analyst
 





 •  Customer Support Engineer
 





 •  Technical Support Associate
 





 •  SaaS Support Analyst
 





 •  SaaS Support Engineer
 





 •  Production Support Analyst
 





 •  Support Engineer
 





 •  Support Analyst
 





 •  Customer Support Analyst
 





 •  Client Support Analyst
 





 •  Technical Customer Support Executive
 





 Your exact title is not important. What matters is that your current or previous work involved responding to software/application support tickets and helping resolve user or customer issues.
 




 About Script Assist
 


 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company. Our software supports complex private clinical and pharmacy services and connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams.
 





 Our platform contains many interconnected workflows, users and roles, permissions, statuses, customer data, configuration, integrations and operational processes. Our support team helps customers understand and resolve problems when something does not behave as expected.
 





 Healthcare is a complex environment, but previous healthcare experience is not required. We will teach you the product and healthcare workflows.
 




  





 What you will do
 


 •  Receive and manage customer support tickets.
 





 •  Respond to customers and users clearly and professionally.
 





 •  Investigate reported software problems.
 





 •  Gather the information needed to understand an issue.
 





 •  Reproduce problems where possible.
 





 •  Review application behaviour and available information.
 





 •  Identify straightforward causes and resolutions.
 





 •  Escalate more complex issues with clear notes and evidence.
 





 •  Maintain accurate ticket histories and track issues through to resolution.
 





 •  Communicate updates to customers.
 





 •  Work with Product, Engineering, QA and Operations.
 





 •  Retest issues after fixes.
 





 •  Help maintain support documentation and identify repeated problems.
 





 •  Learn increasingly complex areas of the Script Assist platform.
 




 The type of person we want
 


 You are likely to have approximately 6\-24 months of experience working in some form of software or application support. You already understand what it means to:
 





 •  Work from a queue and manage tickets or cases.
 





 •  Meet response expectations.
 





 •  Ask users the right questions.
 





 •  Document an issue properly.
 





 •  Follow up with another team and escalate when appropriate.
 





 •  Keep customers updated and close issues properly.
 





 You should also have very good spoken and written English, strong attention to detail, good organisation, a logical approach to problems, strong ownership, the ability to learn new software quickly and confidence communicating with customers and colleagues.
 




 Useful experience
 


 •  Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshdesk or Salesforce.
 





 •  CRM or ticketing platforms.
 





 •  Incident management, application support, SaaS support or product support.
 





 •  Software troubleshooting, production support or issue reproduction.
 





 •  Basic SQL, databases, APIs or software testing.
 





 •  Root\-cause analysis.
 





 You do not need all of these.
 




 Healthcare experience
 


 Previous experience with healthcare software, EHR / EMR, HIS / HMIS, Practice Management Systems, clinical software or pharmacy software would be useful, but is not required.
 





 We are deliberately open to strong junior support candidates from other SaaS, fintech, ERP, e\-commerce, workflow, logistics or enterprise software businesses.
 




 What this role is not
 


 This is not primarily desktop or infrastructure support. Experience focused mainly on laptop repair, hardware support, printer support, network support, router / switch administration, Windows installation, NOC monitoring or generic IT helpdesk is less relevant.
 





 We want candidates whose experience is primarily about supporting users of software applications or digital products. This is also not a Software Developer, QA Tester, Automation Tester or Manual Testing role. We are recruiting for Customer / Product / Application Support.
 




 Why join Script Assist?
 


 This is an opportunity to build a career inside a growing international software company. You will work closely with Support, Product, Engineering, QA and Operations and gain experience supporting a sophisticated live SaaS platform.
 





 Strong performers can progress into Senior Technical Support, Product Support, Application Support, Technical Operations, Implementation, Business Analysis, Customer Success, QA or Product.
 




  






 If you already understand ticket\-based software support and want to develop quickly inside a more complex product environment, we would like to hear from you.

title: DocuSign Application IT Owner & Integration Analyst
description:
*Schneider Digital \| Global IT \| Integration \& API Development Focus*
**About Schneider Electric**
 Schneider Electric (SE) is the global specialist in energy management and automation. SE develops connected technologies and solutions to manage energy and processes in ways that are safe, reliable, efficient, and sustainable. SE provides an integrated approach designed for the reality of the digital economy (Plant\-to\-Plug). The versatile product portfolio addresses all energy needs of industries as well as residential customers worldwide.
   

  

**About Schneider Digital**
 All IT needs for Schneider Electric are managed by a group called Schneider Digital (SD), spread across 303 locations in 60 countries with over 2,300 staff, along with various engagements with all major Global IT Service Providers. Schneider Digital drives the digital transformation agenda of the company by delivering best\-in\-class IT services, platforms, and solutions.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a driven and technically astute DocuSign Application IT Owner \& Integration Analyst to join the Schneider Digital team. This role combines application ownership accountability with deep integration and API development expertise, serving as the central technical authority for the DocuSign platform within Schneider Electric's global IT landscape.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong hands\-on experience in designing, building, and maintaining integrations between DocuSign and enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and other platforms via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware solutions, and event\-driven architectures. You will be responsible for ensuring seamless, reliable, and secure digital agreement workflows across the organization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Application Ownership
   

  

* Act as the primary IT owner and single point of contact (SPOC) for the DocuSign application across Schneider Electric globally.
* Manage the full application lifecycle including onboarding, configuration, upgrades, renewals, and decommissioning.
* Govern application SLAs, availability, and performance metrics; drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with the DocuSign vendor and internal procurement teams for license management, support escalations, and contract negotiations.
* Maintain comprehensive application documentation including architecture diagrams, integration maps, and runbooks.


 Integration \& API Development
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain integrations between DocuSign and enterprise platforms (Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow etc.) using REST APIs, SOAP, and middleware tools.
* Implement Connect notifications, and event\-driven patterns to trigger downstream business processes in real time.
* Build and maintain integration middleware pipelines using tools such as Azure Integration Services, Dell Boomi, or equivalent platforms.
* Develop and manage authentication flows using OAuth 2\.0 (JWT grant, Authorization Code grant) to securely connect DocuSign with enterprise applications.
* Create reusable integration components, code libraries, and templates to accelerate future integration delivery.


 Configuration \& Workflow Automation
   

  

* Design and configure DocuSign envelopes, templates, and signing workflows tailored to complex, multi\-stakeholder business scenarios.
* Automate contract lifecycle management processes including initiation, routing, signing, storage, and archival.
* Support DocuSign CLM and integrations where applicable.


 Support, Monitoring \& Governance
   

  

* Monitor integration health, API usage, envelope status, and failure alerts; drive rapid incident resolution.
* Provide support for DocuSign\-related integration issues, coordinating with business stakeholders, Middleware teams, and the DocuSign vendor.
* Ensure compliance with data security, GDPR, and information governance policies in all integration designs.
* Conduct regular audits of user access, API keys, connected apps, and integration configurations.
* Engage in CHRs release cycles for new integrations and significant enhancements.


 Stakeholder Engagement \& Delivery
   

  

* Partner with business team to gather integration requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Present integration designs and solution proposals to technical and non\-technical stakeholders with clarity.


**Required Technical Skills**
* DocuSign eSignature REST API
* OAuth 2\.0 (JWT Bearer Grant, Authorization Code Grant), SAML 2\.0, SSO
* REST \& SOAP API development and consumption
* Middleware / iPaaS platforms: Azure Integration Services, Dell Boomi, or equivalent
* JSON / XML data transformation and mapping
* Integration with Oracle Fusion HCM, SAP, Salesforce and ServiceNow platforms
* Scripting / programming proficiency: Python, JavaScript, or Java for API automation
* API management tools: Postman, API gateways
* Cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP (integration services context)
* Version control \& CI/CD: Git, Azure DevOps


**Required Skills (Must Have)**
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise application integration and API development.
* Proven hands\-on experience with DocuSign administration and API\-based integrations.
* Strong techno\-functional expertise — ability to bridge business requirements and technical integration design.
* Experience working in Agile / Scrum methodology.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — able to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Experience working in a highly matrixed Global MNC environment with multiple stakeholders across geographies.
* Strong design thinking and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to work across global, distributed teams.


 Rewards designed for you

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 As the Escalation Manager, Weekend Global Coverage, you will serve as the crucial command lead safeguarding customer trust during high\-stakes, critical events across AMER, APJ, and EMEA. Operating within our global follow\-the\-sun coverage model, you are the decisive voice when a Sev1 or critical customer event occurs, rapidly uniting engineering, support, and executive leadership to stabilize complex enterprise scenarios. This high\-impact role sets the standard for weekend operational excellence, turning chaotic technical crises into clear, swift paths to resolution and ensuring seamless cross\-regional transitions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Command Critical Escalations: Serve as the accountable incident commander for major customer escalations (CIEs/Sev1s) during the weekend US coverage window, establishing clear decision rights, working cadences, and swift mitigation strategies.
* Unify Cross\-Functional Teams: Mobilize and align Support, Escalations Engineering, Service Delivery, and Account teams to ensure technical responders have immediate context and unblocked paths to restore customer environments.
* Lead Executive \& Customer Communications: Translate fast\-moving, complex technical diagnostic details into precise, highly coherent updates for executive leadership and global enterprise customers, keeping stakeholders continuously aligned.
* Drive Global Follow\-the\-Sun Handovers: Execute complete, high\-quality shift handovers across regional teams, eliminating duplicated investigation, protecting customer context, and ensuring zero loss of momentum across time zones.
* Prevent Recurrent Risk: Track service restoration through to post\-incident review, capturing actionable root\-cause insights and partnering with functional owners to eliminate systemic operational or product risks.


**What You Bring**
* Incident Leadership Mastery: Proven background leading cross\-functional response teams through severe enterprise outages, data access incidents, or business\-critical infrastructure events under high\-pressure conditions.
* Strategic Communication \& Command: Superior ability to lead war rooms and synthesize complex enterprise technical issues into clear, impactful executive briefings and step\-by\-step customer action plans.
* Enterprise Tech \& Process Savvy: Functional understanding of enterprise infrastructure (such as storage, cloud platforms, or virtualization) alongside disciplined adherence to incident management frameworks.
* Operational Drive \& Ownership: High organization skills to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, establish rapid accountability, and meticulously track follow\-up commitments to complete resolution.
* Location \& Shift Availability: Ability to work a fixed Thursday–Monday operational shift structure. We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**

**Pure and simple.**

 The role requires solid SAP PP knowledge and a willingness to further develop practical expertise in embedded PP/DS through project exposure, support activities and collaboration with senior experts.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Provide functional support for SAP S/4HANA Production Planning processes in a global AMS environment.
* Support business users, key users and Business Process Owners in resolving incidents, service requests and functional questions.
* Support core manufacturing planning processes, including demand management, MRP, production orders, capacity planning and planning\-related master data.
* Provide basic support for embedded PP/DS processes, with the expectation to further develop PP/DS expertise through hands\-on work, knowledge transfer and project involvement.
* Perform initial issue analysis, business impact assessment, root cause analysis and coordination with technical teams, senior functional experts or external partners where needed.
* Support change requests and enhancements by performing impact analysis, functional testing, regression testing and documentation updates.
* Work according to ITIL\-based AMS processes, including incident management, request fulfilment, problem management and change management.
* Use support and collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira and Confluence for ticket handling, documentation, issue tracking and knowledge sharing.
* Support local deployments and hypercare activities by helping users adopt the global template and by resolving planning\-related issues after go\-live.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in areas such as Materials Management, Quality Management, Warehousing, Supply Chain and Manufacturing Execution.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, proposing improvements and supporting stabilization of the global template.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience in SAP PP implementation, support or application maintenance.
* Good functional understanding of SAP Production Planning processes, including demand management, MRP, production orders, capacity planning and planning master data.
* Basic or practical exposure to SAP embedded PP/DS, or strong willingness and ability to develop PP/DS expertise through hands\-on support and project work.
* Experience working in an AMS, production support or IT support environment.
* Good understanding of ITIL\-based support processes, especially incident management, service request handling, problem management and change management.
* Experience using support and collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to analyze functional issues, communicate clearly with business users and coordinate resolution with other teams.
* Understanding of integration points between Production Planning and related areas such as MM, QM, Warehousing, Supply Chain or Manufacturing Execution.
* Good testing skills, including functional testing, regression testing and support for change validation.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural and highly integrated business environment.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.


**Nice to Have**
* Deeper hands\-on experience with embedded PP/DS in SAP S/4HANA, including detailed scheduling, planning heuristics, alerts, resources, production versions or PDS integration.
* Experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing, MES or shopfloor integration.
* Knowledge of Advanced Variant Configuration.
* Exposure to SAP PM or SAP QM processes.
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA deployments, rollouts or hypercare.
* SAP certification in SAP PP, PP/DS or related modules.
* Experience working with global templates and standardized business processes.


**Grading Differentiators**
* Good knowledge of SAP PP processes and ability to provide independent functional support within the assigned scope.
* Basic practical understanding of PP/DS and clear motivation to develop stronger PP/DS expertise.
* Ability to resolve standard and moderately complex functional issues in an AMS environment.
* Good understanding of ITIL\-based support processes and disciplined ticket handling.
* Ability to work with business users, key users, IT teams and external partners in a structured and collaborative way.
* Contribution to documentation, knowledge sharing, testing, stabilization and continuous improvement activities.


**Everything we’ll do for you**
 You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000\+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70\+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
   

  

 Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Product Support Specialist, Education Team (Full time, 1-year contract)
description:
**Company Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, g'day, namaste, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Ready to make meaningful impact? You're in the right place.
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point. Every role supporting Canva contributes to something bigger. Here's what this contract opportunity involves and what we're looking for.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 This is a
 **12\-month** 
 independent contractor opportunity, where you'll provide services within a defined scope, with the flexibility to shape how you deliver your impact.
   

  

 Designed for a hybrid way of working, this opportunity is remote and open to candidates based anywhere in India, so you can align on key touchpoints with our internal team and our education partners across the country. While it'd be up to you to manage your time, the expected time commitment to deliver these services is approximately
 **40 hours per week.**
**About The Team**
 We're the Canva Education team in India, working to bring creativity, collaboration, and visual communication into classrooms across the country. We partner with state governments, national education bodies, and large school networks to make Canva a safe, inclusive platform for teaching and learning — from rural districts to city schools — always aligned with India's priorities like NEP 2020, foundational learning, and digital equity. AI is an accelerant to our mission to empower the world to design. We're embracing it as a powerful tool to help us move faster, spark ideas, streamline work, and unlock creativity.
   

  

 We're genuinely curious about how people are thinking about and experimenting with new technologies to amplify impact, so you can expect it to come up in conversation during the interview process.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you'll be working on**
 As Canva Education continues to grow, change is part of how we move forward. That means the services you'll provide may evolve, and we'd discuss that with you from time to time.
   

  

 Right now, most schools and school systems find the technical side of getting started harder than it should be — Single Sign\-On, domain verification, and connecting their Google or Microsoft backends can take far longer than anyone would like, and State partnerships often run across several different authentication pathways at once. You'll be the person who makes all of that smooth.
   

  

**You'll Be Engaged To Provide Services Aimed At**
* Guiding school systems and Education Depts through SSO setup, domain verification, and account provisioning, so teachers and students can get into Canva Education quickly and securely.
* Supporting integration with Google Workspace and Microsoft (Entra ID / Microsoft 365\) backends, and troubleshooting authentication, provisioning, and directory\-sync issues end to end.
* Acting as the technical point of contact for State partnership rollouts that run across different authentication pathways, making sure each one lands cleanly.
* Diagnosing and resolving onboarding blockers alongside school IT admins, DIETs, and district teams, and escalating product issues to internal Canva teams (Partnerships, Product, Engineering) when needed.
* Creating clear, localized setup guides and self\-serve resources so schools can onboard with less hand\-holding over time.
* Tracking common support issues and integration patterns, and feeding them back internally to reduce friction at scale.
* Supporting training and enablement for administrators and master trainers on account setup, access management, and everyday troubleshooting.


**Qualifications**
**You're probably a match if**
* You've supported SSO, SAML/OAuth, or identity and access setups before, and you can explain how they work to non\-technical people without losing them.
* You know your way around Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 / Entra ID administration, including domain verification, provisioning, and directory sync.
* You've spent at least 3 years in technical support, implementation, or solutions roles — ideally supporting schools, government systems, or large organizations.
* You stay calm and methodical when an integration breaks, and you're happy owning a problem until it's genuinely fixed.
* You communicate clearly in English and Hindi, both in writing and on calls.
* You're comfortable juggling multiple school systems, timelines, and stakeholders at once, and you flag risks early with a plan to fix them.


**Additional Information**
 Other stuff to know
   

  

 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

**Whats in it for you?**
  

 At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

 \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
   

  

**About Us**
 At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
   

  
   

  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
   

  
   

  We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.
