+ Define Organization Group hierarchies (tenant, sub\-OGs, staging, platform\-based, and business\-unit OGs), global UEM settings, and environment segregation across dev/test/pre\-prod/production, controlling configuration promotion between environments.
+ Plan, document, and execute upgrades for UEM, Access, UAG, Assist, and related components, including rollback readiness and post\-upgrade validation.

* Enrollment \& Device Lifecycle: Design enrollment strategies for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and rugged devices across Corporate\-Owned, Corporate\-Shared, and BYOD models, including Autodiscovery, zero\-touch, DEP/Automated Device Enrollment, Windows OOBE and PPKG provisioning, and staging scenarios.
* Policies, Profiles \& Baselines: Define profile and baseline architecture per platform; design and debug custom ADMX/OMA\-URI payloads; resolve conflicts between ADMX profiles, CIS/security baselines, custom settings, and legacy GPOs.
* Application Lifecycle: Own the application lifecycle strategy: Win32/MSI/EXE, PKG, APK/AAB and Managed Google Play, ABM/VPP delivery, Omnissa SDK integration, deployment ring design (pilot to broad), dependency and rollback planning.
* Android Enterprise \& Rugged: Architect Android Enterprise deployments (Work Profile, Fully Managed, COPE, Dedicated) including rugged fleets, Secure Launcher kiosk designs, corporate\-shared device workflows, and OS/app update strategy.
* Apple Ecosystem: Maintain the Apple ecosystem integrations: ABM/DEP profiles with supervision and user affinity, APNs certificate lifecycle, VPP token management, and resolution of ABM–VPP–UEM synchronization issues.
* Identity, SSO \& Access: Design identity and access integrations: AD via ACC/LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID, Workspace ONE Access IdPs and access policies, SAML federations with third\-party IdPs and SaaS applications, Android CertProxy SSO, iOS Kerberos SSO, conditional access design, and custom role/delegated administration models.
* UAG \& Secure Access: Architect and operate UAG: OVA/OVF deployment in vSphere, Photon OS administration, one/two/three\-NIC DMZ designs, HA behind enterprise load balancers (F5 or equivalent), session persistence design, and SSL passthrough/bridging/offloading topologies with correct certificate, cipher, and SNI handling.
+ Design and troubleshoot Per\-App VPN / Workspace ONE Tunnel with Device Traffic Rules, SEG (with/without Kerberos), Content Gateway, and ENS, including end\-to\-end network path analysis (routing, firewall, NAT, DNS, ports).

* PKI \& Certificates: Define PKI strategy for certificate\-based authentication; manage CAs, SCEP and issuance workflows, public SSL certificate lifecycles, Java keystores for AWCM, and deep trust\-chain troubleshooting using OpenSSL (chains, CSR validation, TLS handshakes, CRL/OCSP, SAN/hostname mismatches).

* Privacy \& Governance: Define privacy governance for BYOD/Corporate\-Owned/Corporate\-Shared scenarios aligned with customer contractual and data\-protection expectations (Work Profile, iOS User Enrollment, data\-collection minimization).
* L3 Troubleshooting \& Incident Ownership: Serve as final internal escalation for complex incidents across UEM, Access, UAG, ACC/AWCM, Assist, SEG, Content Gateway, and ENS; perform root\-cause analysis; troubleshoot Windows communication stack (AWCM/WNS) issues; lead service restoration across heterogeneous customer architectures.

title: IT Engineer
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an IT Engineer, you'll lead the design and evolution of our cloud\-first IT environment, building scalable, secure, and highly efficient systems that support the entire organization. You’ll partner closely with cross\-functional teams to implement modern IT solutions, strengthen our security posture, and drive operational excellence through automation, AI\-powered agents, workflow design, and thoughtful system integration. You’ll help identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual work, improve how our core platforms connect and operate, and serve as a technical bridge between IT and software engineering teams. We value proactive problem solving, technical leadership, an automation\-first mindset, and a security\-first approach, and you’ll play a key role in shaping our internal standards, integrations, and IT strategy.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and manage a fully cloud\-based IT environment, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security across a range of SaaS platforms
* Design, build, and operate workflow automation across the IT landscape using platforms such as Okta, Serval, and related iPaaS tooling.
* Build, maintain, and manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI\-powered agents and automations that streamline IT workflows, shift routine requests to self\-service, and remain reliable, monitored, and auditable.
* Engineer and manage integrations between core systems (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, HR/finance platforms, and engineering tooling) using REST APIs, webhooks, and SCIM.
* Manage API integrations across IT systems, including authentication, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Partner closely with software engineering teams to align on shared services, developer tooling, integrations, and standards.
* Build joiner\-mover\-leaver (JML) and birthright access automation, with appropriate guardrails and audit logging for SOX\- and PII\-scoped systems.
* Analyze ticketing and operational data to identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation and prioritize opportunities for implementation.
* Apply a security\-first mindset to everything you build, following least\-privilege principles and partnering with Security to keep automations compliant.
* Develop and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and integration standards so automations are maintainable and knowledge is not siloed.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT issues, conducting deep root cause analysis and implementing long\-term solutions.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, or a related role in a cloud\-first environment.
* Proven experience designing, building, and managing integrations across SaaS platforms using REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and SCIM.
* Hands\-on experience with low\-code/no\-code AI and automation tools and iPaaS platforms (e.g., Okta Workflows, Serval, Workato, Zapier, or equivalent).
* Experience building or integrating AI agents and bots
* Experience managing Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and common device management tools such as Jamf and Intune.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineering teams, with a solid understanding of version control (Git), CI/CD concepts, shared APIs, and services.
* Security\-first mindset, with familiarity applying least\-privilege principles and supporting compliance frameworks such as SOX and SOC 2\.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills, with the ability to design durable, long\-term solutions.
* Experience with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) or modern network security approaches
* Strong communication skills, able to collaborate effectively across technical and non\-technical stakeholders and across time zones.
* Strong documentation skills
* Proofpoint experience is a plus


**Nice To Have** 
  

  

* 
+ Hands\-on programming/scripting ability — Python and JavaScript preferred — for building integrations and automations.
+ Experience with AI orchestration or agent platforms (e.g. Serval, Forethought, or LLM\-based tooling).
+ Exposure to standing up or scaling a global capability centre (GCC).

title: Upgrade Engineer - Salesforce
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Are you passionate about Salesforce, solving complex platform problems, and finding smarter ways to make operational processes faster and more reliable? Sitetracker is looking for a Platform Upgrade Operations Engineer to help transform how we deliver platform upgrades.
   

  

 Our team owns the end\-to\-end Sitetracker upgrade process—from readiness and pre\-upgrade checks through execution, troubleshooting, testing, and post\-upgrade validation. The goal is not simply to execute upgrades successfully, but to continuously make the process more automated, predictable, and scalable.
   

  

 You will combine strong Salesforce Administration and Configuration knowledge with Copado, Copado Robotic Testing (CRT), scripting, automation, and practical AI capabilities. You will identify manual steps and turn them into automated checks, tests, workflows, and intelligent agents.
   

  

 You don't need to be a software developer. You do need strong Salesforce knowledge, the ability to read and understand Salesforce code, strong troubleshooting skills, and a mindset of asking:
 **“How can we make this upgrade automatic?”**
**What You'll Do**
 As a Platform Upgrade Operations Engineer, you will plan and run multi\-week phased rollouts through sandbox, UAT, and Production for enterprise customers. Your success will be measured by rollout predictability, pre/post\-upgrade validation rigor, and clean UAT hand\-offs rather than net\-new builds.
   

  

 You will methodically plan the phased rollout precisely under a release calendar, validate configurations and permissions before and after, and spot regressions early. You are expected to communicate status crisply to customers and implementation partners (such as TechM), turning every upgrade into a reusable runbook.
   

  

**The Skills You'll Have**
**Salesforce Package Upgrade Execution**
* Plan and execute managed\-package upgrades across sandbox, UAT, and Production environments
* Manage sequenced rollout steps, strict dependencies, and the final production cutover
* Own multi\-week, multi\-phase enterprise upgrades, requiring tight coordination with implementation partners to drive on\-time, regression\-free deployments


**Environment, Config \& Permission Validation**
* Perform rigorous pre/post\-upgrade backup comparisons to protect customer trust and prevent Sev\-1 incidents, such as permission\-set discrepancies
* Validate configurations, manage sandbox environments, and execute targeted smoke testing to confirm nothing has regressed during the upgrade
* Build and utilize repeatable data, metadata, and backup\-comparison methods capable of resolving disputed post\-upgrade incidents


**UAT Coordination \& Customer\-Facing Upgrade Comms**
* Run clean UAT hand\-offs, create smoke\-test guides, and facilitate go/no\-go governance checkpoints
* Produce controlled customer\-facing upgrade materials, communicating schedule, risks, and status updates directly to enterprise customers and partners
* Lead advance\-notice processes for production\-impacting changes to ensure phased rollouts land smoothly


**Release Management \& Salesforce Platform Aptitude**
* Demonstrate strong fluency in release trains, versioning, and dependencies to shorten planning cycles and de\-risk cutovers
* Apply a deep understanding of Salesforce platform mechanics that directly affect managed\-package upgrades
* Utilize release\-train or DevOps tooling (such as Copado) alongside Salesforce certifications to streamline operations


**Within 90 Days, You'll**
* Understand the Sitetracker upgrade lifecycle and Salesforce platform
* Become proficient with the upgrade playbook, Copado, CRT, and existing automation
* Execute defined portions of standard upgrades
* Identify high\-value opportunities for automation and AI
* Begin using AI tools as part of your daily technical workflow


**Within 180 Days, You'll**
* Independently execute standard and moderately complex upgrades
* Troubleshoot Salesforce, Sitetracker, configuration, automation, and testing issues
* Build or enhance automated pre\- and post\-upgrade validation
* Improve automated regression coverage using CRT or comparable tools
* Create reusable scripts and automation that reduce manual effort
* Implement practical AI\-assisted workflows or agents that improve upgrade operations
* Turn recurring upgrade issues into automated checks, tests, or prevention mechanisms


**Within 365 Days, You'll**
* Become a trusted technical resource for complex Sitetracker upgrades
* Own significant areas of the upgrade automation roadmap
* Build and maintain scalable automated pre\- and post\-upgrade validation
* Expand automated regression coverage
* Develop reusable automation and AI\-assisted workflows that reduce manual intervention
* Identify opportunities to make more of the upgrade lifecycle fully automated
* Lead improvements that reduce upgrade duration, errors, and customer\-impacting issues
* Help move Platform Upgrade Operations from a manual execution model to an automated and increasingly intelligent model

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. *Enterprise Storage Platforms*

 – Bangalore, Brookfield office. Cab will be provided to the candidates within 25KM range only.
 



  





**Work Model:** 
 Work from Office
 



  





**Experience** 
 : 2\-7 years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our enterprise storage support team in a high\-touch, mission\-critical environment. This role is a great fit for someone with solid hands\-on experience in enterprise storage and infrastructure troubleshooting who genuinely enjoys solving complex customer problems.
 



 You will work on real\-world issues across storage platforms and associated infrastructure, supporting customers through phone, email, chat, and remote sessions. You'll be expected to own cases end to end, communicate clearly under pressure, and bring structured thinking to every troubleshooting scenario.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Provide technical support to enterprise customers on complex storage and infrastructure issues across a global 24x7 model.
* Own cases end to end, from initial triage through troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and resolution.
* Diagnose problems spanning storage protocols, host connectivity, controller behaviour, performance symptoms, platform interoperability, and more.
* Troubleshoot any HW and SW issues that comes up during ongoing platform use.
* Manage customer communication with professionalism and urgency, especially during business\-impacting situations.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including escalation teams, engineering, and customer stakeholders to drive timely outcomes.
* Maintain high\-quality case notes, action plans, and technical documentation throughout the support lifecycle.
* Adhere to SLA targets, escalation protocols, and quality standards consistently.



**Required Experience** 



* 3–6 years of relevant experience in technical support, infrastructure support, and enterprise storage support.
* Solid track record in customer\-facing troubleshooting roles within enterprise IT environments.
* Demonstrated hands\-on understanding of enterprise storage concepts and troubleshooting methodology.



**Technical Skills** 



* **Storage:** 
 Strong working knowledge of SAN and NAS environments (protocols \- FC, iSCSI, NFS, and CIFS/SMB), including RAID, high availability, controller architecture, disk behaviour, and failover concepts.
* **OS:** 
 Good working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration fundamentals.
* **Virtualization:** 
 Familiarity with VMware or similar virtualization platforms and their integration with storage.
* **Networking:** 
 Good grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* **Diagnostics:** 
 Ability to analyze logs, alerts, symptoms, and customer\-reported behaviour to isolate the root cause or likely fault domain.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience supporting enterprise storage platforms such as NetApp ONTAP, FAS / AFF controllers, StorageGRID, E\-Series, or equivalent (Dell EMC, HPE, Pure, IBM, Hitachi).
* Prior experience in managed service or enterprise support environments handling platform or infrastructure incidents.
* Familiarity with critical case management, and ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or equivalent).



**How You Work** 



* You communicate clearly, written and verbal and can hold your own during high\-pressure customer conversations.
* You set expectations well and follow through, even when resolution timelines are uncertain.
* You stay composed during escalations and apply structured thinking rather than guesswork.
* You take ownership seriously and don't pass problems without context.
* You work well with distributed, cross\-functional teams across time zones.

* Maintaining a Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score of 90% or higher based on support interactions.
* Providing high\-quality escalations to Advanced Support and Engineering teams with comprehensive documentation.
* Delivering a true Customer First experience in every interaction.

* Providing timely updates and complete resolutions to customer tickets.

 At Sage, you'll be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and customer success. title: Support Engineer III, SIG, Security Integrations Group (SIG)
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Worldwide Physical Security (PhySec) apart of Amazon's Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is looking for a highly motivated, detail oriented individual to provide application support, troubleshooting, and customer issue resolution for the Security Integrations Group (SIG).
   

  

 This individual will work with other engineers to support Amazon Operations' physical security system infrastructures, including: access control, video management systems, visitor management, and incident management systems.
   

  

 The Security Integrations Group is a 24/7 operation, and shift work will be required, potentially including nights and weekends.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Day\-to\-day support operations of a fast\-paced complex distributed physical security infrastructures
* Responding to telephone, ticket and e\-mail requests in a professional, efficient manner
* Performing various programming and technical project / administrative related activities on the security systems
* Following standard procedures for proper escalation of issues to the appropriate teams
* Reviewing and recommending logical and technical design as defined by documented standards
* Documenting knowledge in the form of knowledge base Wiki articles
* Ability to work shifts that include holidays and weekends
* Participating in an on\-call rotation


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day kicks off with a shift change briefing — a quick sync with the outgoing engineer(s) to review any open high\-severity tickets, ongoing projects, and overnight events. You check the team calendar for scheduled events, review your ticket queue, and log into the contact support portal. The days moves along as you and the team you are a part of are solving physical security operational issues across the Americas. You update your shift notes, brief the incoming engineering peers on any open items, and log off knowing that the global SIG team will carry the mission forward seamlessly through the night. No two days are the same, but every day matters.
   

  

 Who Thrives Here
   

  

* Problem solvers who love diagnosing and fixing complex technical issues under pressure
* Customer\-obsessed engineers who take pride in rapid, high\-quality service delivery
* Self\-starters who can prioritize competing demands and manage their time effectively
* Collaborators who communicate clearly across time zones and teams
* Lifelong learners who are energized by mastering new systems and technologies


 Ready to Protect What Matters?
   

  

 If you're passionate about physical security technology, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to make a tangible impact at one of the world's most innovative companies — SIG is looking for you.
   

  

 Join us. Secure the future.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Security Integrations Group (SIG), a part of Worldwide Physical Security (PhySec), is primarily an engineering team for Amazon's physical security systems across the globe, but also participates in the design, development, deployment, and project management aspects of these systems. SIG provides 24/7 customer support for physical security systems. SIG provides 24x7 support via support engineering teams based in North America, Australia, and Europe. Engineers are available in\-office at all times.
   

  

 Our team’s mission is to lead and unify Amazon's physical security capabilities worldwide by setting strategic frameworks, standards, and processes that enable regional physical security teams and support functions to protect Amazon's end\-to\-end supply chain. Through continuous innovation in security technology, methodologies, and automation, the organization drives consistent, scalable, and data\-driven improvements supporting Security \& Loss Prevention (S\&LP) performance while supporting business initiatives in a fast\-changing operating environment.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of software development, or 2\+ years of technical support experience
* Experience scripting in modern program languages
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
* Experience troubleshooting \& maintaining hardware \& software RAID
* Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON

description:

**Position Overview**
**Senior Unix \& Linux Infrastructure Administrator:**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Unix \& Linux Infrastructure Administrator** 
 with
 **12\+ years of hands\-on experience** 
 in enterprise server administration, infrastructure operations, virtualization, storage, automation, patching, and production support.
   

  

 The candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting large\-scale
 **Linux and Unix server environments** 
 , ensuring high availability, performance, security, and operational stability. The role requires strong troubleshooting skills, ownership of critical infrastructure, and the ability to lead complex technical activities and infrastructure projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Administer and support enterprise Linux and Unix environments across production and non\-production infrastructure.
* Perform installation, configuration, hardening, patching, upgrades, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of Linux/Unix servers.
* Provide advanced administration for Oracle Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), CentOS and Solaris environments.
* Troubleshoot complex OS, kernel, filesystem, networking, performance, boot, package, and service\-related issues.
* Manage server provisioning, decommissioning, migration, and infrastructure consolidation activities.
* Perform OS upgrades, kernel upgrades, security remediation, vulnerability remediation, and configuration management.
* Manage LVM, XFS, ext4, ZFS, NFS, iSCSI, SAN, multipath, and enterprise storage environments.
* Troubleshoot storage connectivity, multipathing, filesystem, NFS, and SAN\-related issues.
* Manage and troubleshoot DNS, NTP/Chrony, SSH, FTP/SFTP, NFS, TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, firewall, and other core infrastructure services.
* Administer and troubleshoot virtualization environments such as Oracle Linux Virtualization Manager (OLVM), oVirt, VMware, or equivalent platforms.
* Support VM creation, migration, resource allocation, host maintenance, and virtualization infrastructure operations.
* Develop and maintain automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
* Automate repetitive administration, patching, health checks, configuration validation, and operational activities.
* Work with monitoring, logging, backup, vulnerability management, and enterprise infrastructure tools.
* Analyze system performance and capacity, including CPU, memory, disk, I/O, filesystem, and network utilization.
* Prepare detailed technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge\-base articles.
* Participate in infrastructure migrations, data\-center migrations, technology refreshes, and large\-scale server consolidation projects.
* Coordinate with application, database, storage, network, security, virtualization, and vendor teams to resolve complex infrastructure issues.
* Implement security best practices and ensure servers comply with enterprise security and vulnerability standards.
* Perform change implementation in accordance with ITIL/change\-management processes.
* Participate in on\-call and after\-hours support for critical production infrastructure when required.

title: Manager, Help Desk
description:
**Description**
**Who We Are**
 Scale Computing is a global leader in edge computing, hyperconverged infrastructure, and managed networking solutions. We deliver innovative, secure, and scalable technology that powers critical operations worldwide.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Help Desk Manager is responsible for the overall operational health of Scale Computing's IT systems and the leadership of the Help Desk/System Administration team in India as well as fostering open communications with the US Help Desk/System Administration counterparts. This position's primary focus is on people management, process optimization, and service delivery. While management is the core of your day\-to\-day, you will maintain a technical edge, acting as a point of escalation for complex issues that require expert intervention.
   

  

 You will manage the lifecycle of IT tickets, ensure adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), oversee critical infrastructure (Systems/Network), and drive the professional development of your direct reports. The ideal candidate is a seasoned IT leader who can balance high\-level technical strategy with day\-to\-day operational excellence.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
 Operational Leadership: Manage the daily operations of the IT Helpdesk and Systems Administration functions, ensuring 24/7 (coordinating with the US Manager/Teams) coverage and rapid resolution of incidents.
   

  

 People Management: Recruit, train, coach, and conduct performance reviews for a blended team of SysAdmins and Helpdesk technicians.
   

  

 Strategic Planning: Assist senior leadership in planning IT budgets, resource allocation, and technology roadmaps.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Management


 Lead, coach, and manage a team of Systems Administrators and Helpdesk Support staff.
   

  

 Conduct regular 1:1s, performance appraisals, and career development planning for direct reports.
   

  

 Manage staff scheduling, on\-call rotations, and resource allocation to ensure coverage during critical business hours.
   

  

 Foster a culture of accountability, internal customer service excellence, and continuous learning.
   

  

* Helpdesk \& Service Delivery


 SLA Management: Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times using Jira Service Management.
   

  

 Incident Management: Serve as the primary point of escalation for high\-priority or complex technical issues that the team cannot resolve.
   

  

 Trend Analysis: Analyze ticket data to identify recurring issues and implement root\-cause fixes to reduce ticket volume.
   

  

 Onboarding: Oversee the "New Hire" process to ensure first\-day productivity for new employees (hardware, accounts, access).
   

  

* Infrastructure \& Systems Oversight


 System Governance: Oversee the administration of core enterprise systems, including JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Dialpad, and Atlassian Suite (Jira/Confluence).
   

  

 Network Strategy: Supervise the health of the network infrastructure (Fortinet firewalls, switches, routers), ensuring the team performs timely firmware updates and security patching.
   

  

 Asset Management: Manage IT asset lifecycle (procurement, inventory tracking, and retirement) for the India office and remote workforce.
   

  

* Security \& Compliance


 Policy Enforcement: Ensure all IT operations comply with internal security policies and external frameworks (PCI\-DSS, CIS Controls, SOC2\).
   

  

 Audit Readiness: Collaborate with the Information Security team to maintain documentation and evidence for security audits.
   

  

 Risk Management: Proactively identify risks in the IT environment and propose mitigation strategies.
   

  

**Success Metrics for the Role**
 Team Performance: High retention rates and positive feedback on team performance reviews.
   

  

 Operational Efficiency: Consistently meeting or exceeding SLAs for helpdesk ticket resolution.
   

  

 System Uptime: Maintenance of 99\.9% uptime for core internal systems and network infrastructure.
   

  

 Project Delivery: Successful oversight of completion of IT infrastructure projects on time and within budget.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Required Education and Experience:**
 Experience: 8\+ years of total IT experience, with at least 3\+ years in a people management or team lead role (managing performance, hiring, etc.).
   

  

 Technical Background: Strong background in Systems Administration (Linux, Windows, macOS) and Networking. You must be technical enough to validate your team's work.
   

  

 Process Knowledge: Demonstrated experience with ITIL frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).
   

  

 Tools: Proficiency in modern IT management stacks, specifically JumpCloud, Jira Service Management, and Google Workspace.
   

  

 Language: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are mandatory for cross\-region collaboration.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
   

  

 Certifications: ITIL Foundation/Practitioner, PMP (Project Management Professional), or technical certs like CISSP/CISM or Fortinet NSE.
   

  

 Experience managing vendors and procurement processes in India.
   

  

**Working Conditions \& Physical Demands**
 Position Type: Full\-Time, In\-Office/Hybrid
   

  

 Hours of Work: Standard business hours (7am\-4pm IST, 2pm\-11pm IST) to overlap with US operations, with flexibility required for critical escalations.
   

  

 Physical Demands: Primarily sedentary; may require oversight of physical equipment setup.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Group medical insurance
* Casual dress code
* Hybrid work schedule
* Paid company holidays
* Cab facilities
* Fully stocked snacks at office
* Vibrant and inclusive workplace atmosphere
* Flexible work environment with growth opportunities


 Scale Computing is an equal opportunity employer. Final candidates will be subject to a pre\-employment background check

You will work closely with clients to troubleshoot and resolve issues, collaborate with internal teams to improve support processes, and maintain accurate documentation. You will be part of a dedicated team committed to delivering outstanding support experiences to our clients. What you'll do: Provide technical support to clients and resolve issues in a timely manner. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure client issues are addressed efficiently. Document and track client interactions and solutions in the support database. Assist in the development and improvement of support processes and tools. Experience you'll need to have: 3\+ years of experience in technical support and client service 1\+ year(s) of experience in troubleshooting technical issues related to hardware, software, and network connectivity 1\+ year(s) of experience with Office 365, ticketing systems, and remote support tools 1\+ year(s) of experience in FTP, SFTP, and other file transfer technologies 3\+ years of an equivalent combination of educational background, related experience, and/or military experience Experience that would be great to have: Experience in the financial services industry Experience with automation tools and scripts

description:
**Title: Domestic Support Technician** 




**Reports to: Manager, Cinema Support** 




**Business Unit: Deluxe Cinema** 




**LOCATION/FACILITY: Bangalore** 




  





  





**About the Company** 




 As the world’s leading multidisciplinary service provider, Deluxe underpins the media and entertainment industry, servicing content creators and distributors including Netflix, WarnerMedia, The Walt Disney Company, Amazon, Apple, Viacom, NBCU, Google, AT\&T and many others, by providing Global Content Distribution, Localization, Accessibility and Mastering while leading end\-to\-end innovation with unparalleled scale and agility across the Streaming, Theatrical, Broadcast and Mobile landscapes. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices around the globe, the company employs some of the most talented and experienced industry individuals worldwide. For more information, please visit
 **www.bydeluxe.com** 




  





**Position Summary** 




 The Domestic Support Technician is in place to respond professionally and timely to all requests, inquiries and issues presented by exhibitor clients (theatres), motion picture studios, and all other callers contacting Deluxe Cinema Support. The technician is well versed in procedures and internal systems to resolve issues rapidly and with high efficacy. Key responsibilities include answering calls and emails to fulfill requests, troubleshoot issues and escalate as necessary in accordance with studio guidelines and SLAs.
 



**RESPONSIBILITIES – Describes the expectations of the role** 



* Possess a thorough understanding and working knowledge of the main systems and other web\-based programs used to perform the job daily.
* Establish and maintain courtesy and professionalism in all aspects of the job despite any adverse situations presented to them.
* Professionally answer inbound Cinema Support calls and resolve inquiries or concerns swiftly per guidelines ensuring resolution.
* Perform outbound calls and emails to follow up troubleshooting or confirm information as needed.
* Responsible for updating and reporting issues that arise with distressed key and/or content orders through standard communication channels including service tickets and emails. This involves problem solving with precise documentation and effective follow up.
* Create KDMs (Key Delivery Management) per studio guidelines, which give specific dates and times for play of digital features.
* Possess and exercise the ability to make sound judgment when negotiating issues that arise from troubleshooting. This includes having the skill to determine appropriate actions and rapid prioritization of issues and steps to prevent dark screens.
* Ability to generate required reports from systems, as well as read and utilize information.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to management for improved customer satisfaction, process improvements and system enhancements.



**REQUIREMENTS – Describes the professional experiences, educational background, knowledge, and behavior required to fulfill the role responsibilities** 



* Must demonstrate a positive attitude, able to handle self professionally in a high stress situation, project self as a team player, ability to accept and manage change and provide process improvement, cost saving and customer satisfaction suggestions.
* Maintain a high level of confidentiality of customer/client sensitive information and Deluxe confidential information.
* Must be organized, reliable, conscientious, flexible, and skilled at multi\-tasking.
* Work effectively under pressure and possess strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Possess strong decision making and problem\-solving skills.
* Minimum of a degree or above preferred. Two years of work related, or management related experienced would be considered.
* Experience using standard MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, and Outlook) required. Candidate must type a minimum typing speed of 40 words per minute and be capable of operating office equipment.
* Must be detail oriented, self\-motivated, possess good problem\-solving skills, ability to multitask in deadline driven environment and work with minimal supervision.
* Experience in defining, documenting, and implementing business processes and procedures.
* Knowledge of the 24\-hour clock, time zones, and state abbreviations preferred.
* Experience in a Customer Service organization, and/or Technical Operations Services including hardware/software systems and connectivity monitoring and troubleshooting highly desired.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are needed to communicate effectively to all levels of the organization as well as internal and external customers.
* Basic computer networking skills and familiarity with the cinema environment is a must.
* Understanding of basic networking technologies such as TCP/IP, FTP, multicast, etc. is a plus.
* Experience with incident management systems and web\-based applications required.
* Strong customer service skills focused on problem solving and customer satisfaction.
* Knowledge of military time, time zones, and ISO Country abbreviations.
* Be present for assigned work shift but be flexible to shift changes as required to support our customer base as it relates to high volume peak periods including week\-ends and holidays.



  





**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND OTHER INFORMATION TO CONSIDER** 




  





**Physical Requirements:** 



* Ability to sit for an extended time up to an entire shift.
* Ability to view computer screen for an extended time up to an entire shift.



  





**Language Skills:** 



* Ability to read and interpret documents, routine reports, and correspondences.
* Ability to speak clearly and professionally.
* Ability to create written communication for co\-workers, management, and customers.



  





**Environmental Considerations:** 



* Ability to multi\-task effectively around distractions and medium noise levels created by multiple conversations at the same time in a high stress, fast paced environment.
* Be present for assigned work shift but be flexible to shift changes as required to support our customer base as it relates to high volume peak periods including week\-ends and holidays.
* Use proper phone etiquette when answering phones.



  





  





**Equal Employment:** 




 Deluxe is committed to inclusivity, fostering an environment where every employee feels comfortable bringing their full selves to work. It is our policy

 and employees. Applicants will receive fair consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against, based on race, colour, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, or any other discriminations.

 Enhanced Operations Service Specialist plays a pivotal role within the SAP PCO – Global Cloud Operation Delivery (GCO) \- Enhanced Operations Service (EOS) organization, serving as a trusted advisor responsible for safeguarding and optimizing strategic customers' investments in SAP Enterprise Cloud Services.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced SAP technology professional expert for the Enhanced Operations Service (EOS) team who should have a proven track record in at least in one of the areas like SAP Basis, HANA DB, Server management, Critical Situation Handling, Project Management, with a strong technical and process background. A customer first mindset is a must.
   

  

 As an EOS Execution Service Senior Specialist \- you are responsible for:
   

  

* Ensure the execution of planned changes requested by customers are completed as per the activity schedule, tracking, and achieving various ambitious service KPI and SLA’s.
* Own and execute customer service requests, system build, migration, and operational activities across Basis, DB, and Server domains — meeting SLA/KPI commitments with a customer\-first mindset.
* Drive migration activities including system copies, OS/DB migrations, cutover planning, and go\-live support.
* Adhoc/Immediate execution of customer service request which are critical during special phases of the customer life cycle.
* Quick responses during escalations, ensure no service requests are impacted in the delivery phase, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the customer operations.
* Analyse customer feedback on the service request execution quality and bring about changes in a more structured and time bound manner.
* Drive feedback relevant to procedure and process with relevant teams and drive it to completion.
* Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams with Strong collaboration with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.
* Bring in Continuous Improvement Initiatives, to address customer pain points and enhancements in the Service Delivery
* Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities
* Streamline standard operating procedures by focussing on automation enhancements.
* Leverage AI\-driven insights to enhance process, SR delivery, system observability, reliability, and proactive issue resolution.


**What You’ll Build**
* Excellent hands\-on experience in one of the areas like SAP Basis, Lifecycle events (Upgrades / Updates). Support Knowledge of products like SAP Cloud\-Connector, S4 would be an added advantage.
* Practical knowledge with SAP technologies like SAP NetWeaver, Business Objects, SAP HANA and SAP Sybase Adaptive Server Enterprise (ASE)
* Experience with Managed/Hosting services or SAP Private Cloud or Public Cloud Operations/Support is preferred.
* Working knowledge on SAP Application Security, System Copies, DB export\-import, and disaster recovery strategy, client administration is preferred.
* Experience in working with Linux pacemaker environment is added advantage.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management.
* 8 to 13 years of work experience as a Technical SAP NetWeaver Consultant (ABAP and Java Basis Administration)
* Hands\-on expertise in SAP Basis administration, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA, Sybase ASE, and Business Objects.
* Strong knowledge of S/4HANA architecture, migration paths, high availability, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Experience with hyperscale cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and managed/private cloud operations.
* Proficiency in Linux/UNIX, Linux Pacemaker, scripting (Shell, Python, Perl), and automation tools (Ansible, Chef).
* Working knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, NAT, firewalls, LDAP) and storage.
* Familiarity with additional SAP technologies: Cloud Connector, Content Server, OpenText, IDM, TREX, MDM, and others.
* ITIL framework exposure; SAP S/4HANA conversion and OS/DB migration certifications are added advantage
* 24\*7 support model. Rotational 2 shift support of APJ and EMEA time zone. Rotational weekend support
* Analytical and solution\-oriented thinking
* Strong customer service focus with customer first Mindset.


**Where You Belong**
 SAP Private Cloud Operation (PCO) is part of the Customer Services \& Delivery board area in SAP. Enterprise Cloud Services is a business unit focusing on delivery of managed private cloud services. To provide our customers with the right level of service, we have Technical and customer facing roles within the unit along with technical delivery.
   

  

 The Enhanced Operation Service is part of SAP PCO GCO Delivery organization. This is a dedicated team which will focus on leading and optimizing strategic customers’ end\-to\-end delivery and operation model, during the customer’s cloud transformation journey. We provide a spectrum of cloud deployment options for our customers with our own infrastructure, our partners and through public cloud infrastructures.

 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Please note that Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), its direct and indirect subsidiaries and affiliated companies, and its authorized recruitment agencies/vendors will never charge a candidate a registration fee, hiring fee, or any other fee in connection with its recruitment and hiring process. We also never request personal information such as back account details, Social Security numbers, or national IDs via social media or chat applications.
   

  

 All legitimate job opportunities will come through official company channels, and candidates are responsible for verifying the credentials of any third party claiming to represent the company. Any reliance on fraudulent communication is at the individual’s own risk, and HPE disclaims legal liability for any resulting damages. If you suspect recruitment fraud, do not share personal information or make any payments and report the incident to your local authorities immediately.

description:

 Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. title: Technical Analyst (REST API, JSON, Life science domain)
description:
**Bring more to life.**
 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
   

  

 At IDBS, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
   

  

 You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
   

  

 At IDBS, we provide innovative software solutions and services that empower scientists and researchers to accelerate their discoveries, by helping them design, execute and orchestrate processes, manage, contextualize and structure their data and gain valuable insights throughout the drug lifecycle, from R\&D through manufacturing. As part of Danaher’s connected ecosystem, we partner closely with customers to solve their toughest challenges with greater speed and certainty. We work with 75% of the top 20 global biopharma companies\*. Join us at IDBS to continuously grow and make a real impact, working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about our mission and each other
   

  

* Rank measured by Market Cap, Q2 2026


 Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
   

  

 The
 **Technical Analyst** 
 is responsible for delivering technical solutions that enable global Life Sciences organizations to successfully adopt and utilize IDBS software. As part of the Professional Services organization, this role supports the implementation, integration, testing, and operational readiness of IDBS products, including IDBS E\-WorkBook and IDBS Polar, while partnering with cross\-functional teams to solve technical challenges and drive successful customer outcomes.
   

  

 This position reports to the
 **Regional Services Operations Manager** 
 and is part of the Global Professional Services team based in
 **Bengaluru, India** 
 . This is an on\-site role. You will work with enterprise integrations, APIs, data exchange, testing, and solution delivery to support complex laboratory informatics implementations for global Life Sciences customers.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Support the implementation, configuration, and integration of IDBS software solutions, including E\-WorkBook and Polar, for leading global Life Sciences organizations.
* Collaborate with customers, architects, and engineering teams to gather technical requirements, design solution approaches, and deliver integrations between IDBS platforms and enterprise applications, laboratory systems, and cloud services.
* Work with APIs, data exchange processes, authentication methods, and system configurations to support implementation activities, troubleshoot technical issues, and resolve integration challenges.
* Contribute to testing, validation, deployment, and go\-live activities, including integration testing, API validation, defect investigation, and operational readiness for customer environments.
* Create technical documentation, data mappings, knowledge assets, and customer handover materials while proactively identifying risks, improving delivery processes, and leveraging AI\-enabled tools to enhance productivity and quality.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* 1\-2 years of experience supporting SaaS or enterprise software applications in a technical analysis, application support, implementation or integration\-focused role.
* Exposure to system integrations, APIs, technical troubleshooting, testing, deployment, or production support activities.
* Foundational knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, SQL, authentication concepts, and data exchange processes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and technical documentation skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams and customers across multiple time zones.


**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**
* Experience supporting laboratory informatics, scientific software, LIMS, ELN, or other Life Sciences technology platforms.
* Knowledge of XML, CSV, data mapping, scripting, or interface troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting defect triage, go\-live, hypercare, or transition\-to\-support activities.
* Experience using Microsoft Copilot or other AI\-enabled productivity tools to support documentation, analysis, troubleshooting, or implementation activities.


**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record \& Physical/Environment Requirements**
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to \[5%] including occasional overnight travel.


**Bonus / Incentive Pay**
 This job is also eligible for bonus / incentive pay. This is the target earnings as % of base annual salary, subject to objective eligibility criteria and performance conditions as set out in the applicable scheme terms and conditions.
   

  

 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Senior IT Support Analyst
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**

 Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

 Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company\-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture\-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.
   

  

**SUMMARY** 
 Q2 is seeking an IT Support Analyst to provide end\-to\-end technical support, lead onboarding initiatives, and implement service improvement strategies. This role requires initiative, strong technical acumen, and a proactive approach to solving issues and enhancing user satisfaction.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Independently resolve complex technical issues for local and remote users
* Provide support and troubleshooting across operating systems and platforms
* Onboarding/Off\-boarding: Setting up devices for new employees, preparing accounts, and managing the process of retrieving and deactivating devices upon resignation
* Coordinate escalation of technical issues and follow through to resolution
* Maintain and enhance asset tracking and documentation processes
* Contribute to the development and improvement of support standards
* Support identity and mobile device management systems
* Assign appropriate permissions to users in Active Directory
* Participate in rotating on\-call support schedule
* Serve as the senior escalation point and subject matter expert for complex, high\-impact, or enterprise\-wide technical issues
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring or high\-impact issues and drive preventive/corrective action
* Provide support across enterprise technologies and platforms, beyond local site scope
* Design and refine IT service operations processes, proposing improvements and tailoring solutions to local/regional conditions
* Own IT asset lifecycle management: Maintain and enhance asset tracking and documentation processes, inventory management, and end\-of\-life/lifecycle management
* Support and troubleshoot A/V and collaboration tools (conferencing systems, meeting room technology, etc.)
* Liaise with and manage A/V vendors to ensure timely resolution of equipment and service issues
* Create and maintain documentation, knowledge base articles, and Confluence content to support operational continuity and knowledge sharing
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior/intermediate IT support analysts


**Experience And Knowledge**
* Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field and 5 to 7 years of related experience in IT support or a similar role; or an advanced degree with equivalent experience
* Ability to work individually, as a team, and cross functionally to resolve complex issues
* Strong customer service, written, and oral communication skills
* Experience with Active Directory
* Experience with Office 365 administrative tasks
* Experience supporting both Windows and MacOS workstations
* Experience providing effective hardware and software IT support to in office and remote users
* Experience with Identity Management tools – (Okta experience a plus)
* Experience with Mobile Device Management tools (Jamf and Intune experience a plus)
* Experience with an IT ticketing system (Remedy, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.)
* Experience with Microsoft Azure required
* Experience with A/V and collaboration tools, including managing A/V vendor relationships
* Working knowledge of enterprise networking fundamentals (Wi\-Fi, VPN, LAN, etc.), basic to advanced
* Experience designing IT service operations processes and proposing improvements, with the ability to tailor solutions to local/regional conditions
* Strong documentation skills – able to create and maintain SOPs, knowledge base articles, and Confluence content
* Experience with IT asset management: device procurement planning, inventory management, and lifecycle management
* Experience performing root cause analysis (RCA) on recurring or high\-impact incidents
* Demonstrated ability to support enterprise\-wide technologies and systems


*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

* Health \& Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents
